items.description: Mister Rogers shows the frightening machinery early: a stretcher, an ambulance, the paramedics who use them. Scary things get smaller once someone explains how they work.

items.id: mister-rogers-neighborhood-complete-50th-anniversary-tv-series/Mister Rogers' Neighborhood Season 1996 Episode 1702 Helping Part 2.mp4
items.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood: Helping, Part 2
items.description: Look for the helpers, his mother told him, and a whole week grew out of it. A toy is made right on camera, and drummers and singers come to the porch.

items.title: Reading Rainbow: My Life with the Wave
items.description: A man takes a wave home in a story from a Nobel-winning poet. Burton's tour of water runs from surfers to a manatee swim to a coral reef, and nobody ends up dry.

items.id: arthur-1996-complete_202203/Season 6/Arthur - S06E07-E08 - Muffy's Soccer Shocker + Brother Can You Spare a Clarinet SDTV.mp4
items.title: Arthur: Muffy's Soccer Shocker / Brother, Can You Spare a Clarinet?
items.description: The second title winks at a Depression-era song, which the kids won't catch and you might. Soccer first, then a boy and his clarinet, from music class to the stage.

items.id: arthur-1996-complete_202203/Season 8/Arthur - S08E07-E08 - Fernkenstein's Monster + D.W., Dancing Queen WEBDL-480p.mp4
items.title: Arthur: Fernkenstein's Monster / D.W., Dancing Queen
items.description: A friend tells scary stories and the others try to make them less scary, which is a fair summary of every sleepover. Then D.W. takes a dance lesson, queen-sized.

items.title: Ghostwriter: Ghost Story, Part 1
items.description: Messages start showing up on a boy's computer from nobody, and a worrying notice goes up at school. It begins small, which is how good mysteries do it.

items.title: Ghostwriter: Ghost Story, Part 2
items.description: A green mark on a junkyard shutter, a ghost who keeps writing back, and a group of kids holding half a puzzle. Part two is where the hooks go in.

items.title: 3-2-1 Contact: Noisy/Quiet - The Ear
items.description: The word is NOISY, and the kids take it seriously: they go hunting for sounds, and a boy signs with his hands. Underneath it's a half hour about how to listen.

items.title: 3-2-1 Contact: Noisy/Quiet - Music
items.description: A half hour called QUIET that is mostly about sound, with oscilloscopes, synthesizers and a kids' mystery about Princess Tomorrow's predictions. You get to see what a hum looks like.

items.title: Bill Nye the Science Guy: Digestion
items.description: Bill Nye follows a meal from mouth to stomach to gut, with an X-ray and a snake helping. The body is a machine worth taking apart, he insists, and he's right.

items.title: Bill Nye the Science Guy: Outer Space
items.description: Bill Nye studied astronomy under Carl Sagan, and you can tell. The Sun, the stars and light years get cut down to a size a kid can hold, then a radio telescope array rolls in.

items.title: Bill Nye the Science Guy: Balance
items.description: A seesaw, bowling and an elevator counterweight all turn out to be one idea, and the secret lives in your inner ear. Even the closing dance has to keep its feet.

items.id: come-on-and-zoom-50th-anniversary-special/ZOOM Season 1 Cast 1 - Musical Number "Zoomers in Wonderland" - Zoom Guest "David Wood" (Perkins School for the Blind) Builds a Game 1972.mp4
items.title: ZOOM (1972): Zoomers in Wonderland
items.description: Written to by kids and performed by kids. A guest from the Perkins School for the Blind shows how to build a game, and the first cast throws a musical tea party in Wonderland.

items.id: come-on-and-zoom-50th-anniversary-special/ZOOM Season 1 Cast 2 - A Zoom Song "Three Wishes" - Zoom Guest "Eddy McDevitt" Island Resident - Zoom Do "Lisa Govan & Daniel Cohen" Build A Tree Loom   1972.mp4
items.title: ZOOM (1972): Tree Loom / Three Wishes
items.description: Songs, sketches, viewer letters, and then a project: a yarn tree loom to build. This was television that wanted you to go find some yarn.

items.id: arthur-1996-complete_202203/Season 10/Arthur - S10E06-E07 - Feeling Flush + Family Fortune SDTV.mp4
items.title: Arthur: Feeling Flush / Family Fortune
items.description: Small stakes, done right: Francine, Buster and the Grebes in one story, a bike Arthur really wants in the other. The bike matters exactly as much as it did at that size.

items.id: arthur-1996-complete_202203/Season 12/Arthur - S12E07-E08 - For the Birds + Ungifted SDTV.mp4
items.title: Arthur: For the Birds / Ungifted
items.description: Binoculars and cameras in the woods first, then the gift-and-dinner kind of holiday, with the kids' segment between. All of it is very survivable.

items.title: Ghostwriter: Ghost Story, Part 3
items.description: A code of shifted letters, the kind Caesar is said to have used, and a strange boy with a mask on the back of his head. Best cracked with a pencil, and the show knows it.

items.title: Ghostwriter: Ghost Story, Part 4
items.description: Fog, a night hideout, masked figures, and kids who follow the clues in anyway. You'd have gone too.

items.title: 3-2-1 Contact: Forces and Fields
items.description: Gymnastics, figure skating, running shoes and a Jets player all get the same question: how does that actually work? Young reporters do the asking, and the answer is mostly physics.

items.title: 3-2-1 Contact: Forces and Machines
items.description: The Bloodhound Gang is after a burglar in red hair and sunglasses, a disguise any kid on the couch can see through. The real daring is the teens on the trapeze.

items.title: Bill Nye the Science Guy: Rocks & Soil
items.description: Coal and a diamond side by side, then a hard-hat rock band to explain where dirt comes from. The song is catchier than soil has any right to expect.

items.title: Bill Nye the Science Guy: Wetlands
items.description: The marsh is the planet's water filter, and Nye proves it in the lab before he gets his boots wet. The hero is the dark, smelly soil, and he says so proudly.

items.title: Bill Nye the Science Guy: Pseudoscience
items.description: A bed of nails, a famous skeptic and a plain rule for telling real from real-looking. Good advice for a kid, and better advice for anyone who has since gone online.

items.id: come-on-and-zoom-50th-anniversary-special/ZOOM Season 2 Cast 1 - Guest 'Jimmy Edmonds' Fiddle Player - Zoom Do 'Tom Pollack' Makes a Crystal Radio - Song 'On Top of Spaghetti' 1973 .mp4
items.title: ZOOM (1972): Crystal Radio / On Top of Spaghetti
items.description: The new Zoomers introduce themselves, one with a fiddle, then it's drawings, letters and a sleepover skit. Everyone on screen is about the age of the kid watching.

items.id: come-on-and-zoom-50th-anniversary-special/ZOOM Season 2 Cast 2 - Zoom Story 'The Lonesome T.V. By Danny Miller' - Guest 'Benny Wood' Glassblower  - Season Finale 1973.mp4
items.title: ZOOM (1972): The Lonesome T.V.
items.description: Games, skits and a glassblower at work, then a sponsor card at the very end. Commercial-free came with one polite footnote.

items.title: Wishbone: Homer Sweet Homer
items.description: Odysseus needs ten years to get home. David needs a town meeting to save the park's trees. Wishbone, in the middle, would like everyone to speak up.

items.title: Wishbone: Sniffing the Gauntlet
items.description: Knights, a tournament and a terrier in the lead of Ivanhoe. Back at school there's a tournament of a gentler kind, and something has gone missing.

items.title: Ghostwriter: Ghost Story, Part 5
items.description: Coded notes, a masked figure and a hideout like a fort, all on real Brooklyn blocks. Part five, so you're deep in it and the clues won't wait.

items.id: ghostwriter_1992/Ghostwriter - Season 1/GW 14 - Into The Comics pt 1 (lilazn).mp4
items.title: Ghostwriter: Into the Comics, Part 1
items.description: A comic artist's drawings pull the kids into a mystery, with clues running across Brooklyn. Part one stops on a cliffhanger, and nobody will blame you for wanting part two.

items.title: 3-2-1 Contact: Growth/Decay - Human Growth
items.description: A newborn, a baseball neighborhood, and the Bloodhound Gang on Mr. Big's trail. The sponsor cards are still in, and they're a small time machine of their own.

items.title: 3-2-1 Contact: Growth/Decay - Land Forms
items.description: A model volcano erupts in the studio, then the cameras fly off to a real lava flow to check its work.

items.title: Bill Nye the Science Guy: Space Exploration
items.description: A launch site, spacesuits and a Mars rover model, and Nye sounds like a man talking shop. He explains how astronauts live and work up there, and he'd clearly pack a bag.

items.title: ZOOM (1972): Junior Olympics Special
items.description: Kids wrote ZOOM, and the Olympic edition runs on their letters, plus running, gymnastics and sketches. Box 350 must have had a very full day.

items.id: come-on-and-zoom-50th-anniversary-special/ZOOM Season 4 - Zoom Guest 'Hal Clifford' - Zoom Tale 'A Visit To Zorrox By Terese & Bernie Jungle' 1975.mp4
items.title: ZOOM (1972): A Visit to Zorrox
items.description: Kids mailed in letters, drawings and skit ideas, and the best ones went on the air. A comments section with better manners, and a language called Ubbi Dubbi.

items.title: Wishbone: The Pawloined Paper
items.description: Wishbone steps into Dupin's shoes for Poe's tale of a stolen letter, while a boy at school hunts for a missing paper. The peek behind the scenes afterward is a bonus.

items.title: Wishbone: A Dogged Expose
items.description: A Sherlock Holmes daydream, a mystery at home, and a Jack Russell named Soccer who hit his marks like a professional.

items.title: Ghostwriter: Who's Who, Part 2
items.description: A detective show about reading, where the ghost can only speak by rearranging letters. Part two, so you arrive mid-mystery. Catch up the way the kids do, by reading closely.

items.title: Ghostwriter: Building Bridges, Part 3
items.description: The kids argue over trouble at school and on their streets, and a boy follows a trail to a cluttered hideout. Ghostwriter at its most down-to-earth, ghost aside.

items.title: 3-2-1 Contact: Fast/Slow - Rhythms of Nature
items.description: Heartbeats, drums and tide pools make an odd trio, then the Bloodhound Gang takes the case of the flying clock. A mystery tucked inside a science show was always the best idea they had.

items.title: 3-2-1 Contact: Fast/Slow - Speed and Racing
items.description: Motion is the lesson, with a motorcycle, tennis and bicycle racing. The detective serial about the trunk wraps up here, so this is the one with the answer.

items.id: barney-friends/1992-04-13 - Barney & Friends - S01E06 - Four Seasons Day (April 13, 1992).mp4
items.title: Barney & Friends: Four Seasons Day
items.description: Rain, leaves, snow and spring flowers, acted out with umbrellas and songs. The show was made in Texas, so the snow is pure imagination. The funding card stays in.

items.id: barney-friends/1992-04-29 - Barney & Friends - S01E18 - When I Grow Up... (April 29, 1992).mp4
items.title: Barney & Friends: When I Grow Up
items.description: Dress-up day: the children try on grown-up jobs and sing about who they might become. Nobody asks them to be practical yet, and it's lovely.

items.id: come-on-and-zoom-50th-anniversary-special/ZOOM Season 5 - Song “Sing A Song & Make Your Own Kind of Music”  - Zoom Guest "Billy Fournier" (Tugboat Navigator) - Zoom Story "Freddie The Frog" By Jo-Ann Brand - Zoom Guest "Alberta Couthen" Deaf Youth   1976.mp4
items.title: ZOOM (1972): Freddie the Frog
items.description: Games and poems from viewers' letters, a tugboat navigator, a frog story, and a young man who teaches a few signs. A wide world, delivered through one small mailbox.

items.title: Wishbone: Dances with Dogs
items.description: Wishbone's daydream is a woodland tale of warriors, while a boy and his family learn about a Native American dance gathering. Larry Brantley's voice makes a terrier sound thoughtful.

items.title: Wishbone: Moonbone
items.description: Wishbone steps into The Moonstone, the stolen-diamond novel often called the first English detective story, while Joe sorts out a modern mix-up. A very big book for a very small dog.

items.id: ghostwriter_1992/Ghostwriter - Season 2/GW 42 - Get the Message pt 4 (lilazn).mp4
items.title: Ghostwriter: Get the Message, Part 4
items.description: The kids race to warn the neighborhood while the ghost spells out messages on a computer screen. The final part, and he still has to type every word himself.

items.id: ghostwriter_1992/Ghostwriter - Season 2/GW 51 - Who Is Max Mouse pt 1 (lilazn).mp4
items.title: Ghostwriter: Who Is Max Mouse?, Part 1
items.description: A school computer is broken into, the suspects pile up, and everyone wants to know who Max Mouse is. A hacked school computer was big news then, and it's still a decent hook.

items.id: shining-time-station-TV-series-CompleteHighQuality/Shining Time Station - Ep. 14 - Just Wild About Harry's Workshop   60p.mp4
items.title: Shining Time Station: Just Wild About Harry's Workshop
items.description: Percy and Duck roll through, with old cartoon shorts, a butterfly-net collector and a visitor in a plaid suit. Harry's workshop is a place every kid wants to be sent.

items.id: shining-time-station-TV-series-CompleteHighQuality/Shining Time Station - Ep. 25 - Sweet and Sour   60p.mp4
items.title: Shining Time Station: Sweet and Sour
items.description: The kids sell lemonade and cookies on the platform while three big engines have their say inside. A small station, a puppet song, and an afternoon with nowhere to be.

items.id: barney-friends/1992-05-14 - Barney & Friends - S01E29 - Hola, Mexico! (May 14, 1992).mp4
items.title: Barney & Friends: Hola, Mexico!
items.description: A piñata, a guitar song and counting in Spanish, all without leaving the schoolroom. Early Barney, who has just found out a trip can happen inside a song.

items.id: barney-friends/1993-10-08 - Barney & Friends - S02E10 - Look at Me, I'm Three! (October 8, 1993).mp4
items.title: Barney & Friends: Look at Me, I'm Three!
items.description: Three candles, a few crafts and a roomful of friends singing. A show that began as home videos for one small boy knows exactly how to throw a small party.

items.title: Liberty's Kids: Green Mountain Boys
items.description: Ethan Allen's militia answers to nobody easily, and the young reporters have to decide what fair looks like. A history lesson that lets the kids argue.

items.title: Liberty's Kids: Sybil Ludington
items.description: A girl rides all night to gather the militia, and nobody agrees on how much of it happened. The show tells it as it's told and trusts you with the rest.

items.title: Liberty's Kids: Deborah Samson
items.description: A woman signs up as Robert Shurtleff and marches off with the Continental Army. The reporters follow her to a farmhouse. A true story that needs no dressing up.

items.title: Martha Speaks
items.description: Alphabet soup went to her brain instead of her stomach, and that is the whole premise. Today she plays vet's nurse while a boy chasing a big story ends up on TV.

items.title: Martha Speaks
items.description: A dog who loves words would, of course, invite a poet over. There's also a new brown puppy at the reading club, which is reason enough to stay.

items.title: Martha Speaks
items.description: A talking dog is the easy part. Here she and her boy slip through a wormhole into the past, and two other kids go digging for fossils in the desert.

items.id: ghostwriter_1992/Ghostwriter - Season 2/GW 61 - What's Up With Alex pt 3 (lilazn).mp4
items.title: Ghostwriter: What's Up with Alex?, Part 3
items.description: Part three, and the kids talk it through instead of looking away from a friend's trouble with a dealer. A hard subject, handled the way a good teacher would.

items.id: ghostwriter_1992/Ghostwriter - Season 3/GW 70 - Four Days of the Cockatoo pt 4 (lilazn).mp4
items.title: Ghostwriter: Four Days of the Cockatoo, Part 4
items.description: A missing cockatoo, a taxidermy shop and a room full of cages. Part four stops on a cliffhanger, the way a mystery for kids ought to.

items.id: shining-time-station-TV-series-CompleteHighQuality/Shining Time Station - Ep. 37 - Is Anybody There   60p.mp4
items.title: Shining Time Station: Is Anybody There?
items.description: Thomas plows through snow while the staff and three kids sort out trouble at the station. Cold on the tracks, warm in the waiting room.

items.id: shining-time-station-TV-series-CompleteHighQuality/Shining Time Station - Ep. 48 - Fortune Teller Schemer   60p.mp4
items.title: Shining Time Station: Fortune Teller Schemer
items.description: A man in a jeweled turban sets up as a fortune teller and draws a crowd. Ringo Starr and George Carlin both played the conductor, so casting here was never an afterthought.

items.id: barney-friends/1995-03-02 - Barney & Friends - S03E04 - I Can Be a Firefighter! (March 2, 1995).mp4
items.title: Barney & Friends: I Can Be a Firefighter!
items.description: A real fire crew comes to school, a child tries on the helmet and coat, and everybody sings about the job. Respect for the people who run toward it, set to a tune.

items.id: barney-friends/1995-07-28 - Barney & Friends - S03E15 - Camera Safari (July 28, 1995).mp4
items.title: Barney & Friends: Camera Safari
items.description: Nobody shoots anything but pictures: cameras up for make-believe lions and monkeys, plus a visitor in Thai costume. The gentlest safari there is.

items.id: between-the-lions-2000/Between the Lions (2000)/S1/Between the Lions - 1x17 - Something Fishy.mp4
items.title: Between the Lions: Something Fishy
items.description: Word games about fish, shine and tickle, and a Cliffhanger Hanger to keep you reading. The lions' library is the whole show, and it's a good place to sit.

items.id: between-the-lions-2000/Between the Lions (2000)/S2/Between the Lions - 2x21 - Rats.mp4
items.title: Between the Lions: Rats
items.description: A small rat visits the library for a rat-themed storybook, the at sound gets its own game, and there's a dancing song. Reading, out loud, with a beat.

items.id: curiousgeorge-season-12-15/S01 E07-Curious George, Door Monkey; Curious George Goes Up the River.mp4
items.title: Curious George: Door Monkey / George Goes Up the River
items.description: George runs deliveries in an apartment building, then follows ducklings to a silo and a treasure map. His first manuscript left Paris by bicycle, and he has been in a hurry since.

items.id: curiousgeorge-season-12-15/S01 E19-The Truth About George Burgers; Curious George in the Dark.mp4
items.title: Curious George: The Truth About George Burgers / George in the Dark
items.description: A chef's rooftop tomatoes, then a flashlight in a dark cave and a storm. Science for the three-to-five set, with a squirrel and a beaver as witnesses.

items.title: Curious George: Monkey Underground / Cat Mother
items.description: George tunnels through a farm field while the farmer fights the gophers, and then a kitten needs looking after. Frank Welker does every bit of it in squeaks.

items.id: dragon-tales-the-complete-series/Dragon Tales_S01E12_Zak And The Beanstalk & A Feat On Her Feet.ia.mp4
items.title: Dragon Tales: Zak And The Beanstalk & A Feat On Her Feet
items.description: A rhyme opens the way to Dragon Land, where the Do-Re-Mi music has gone missing and a giant lends a hand. Afterward, roller skates, because a day should have both.

items.id: dragon-tales-the-complete-series/Dragon Tales_S01E36_Ord Sees The Light & The Ugly Dragling.ia.mp4
items.title: Dragon Tales: Ord Sees the Light / The Ugly Dragling
items.description: Max and Emmy keep blue Ord company in a dark cave, then gather with the other dragons in a wooden house. The lesson goes down so softly you won't feel it.

items.id: shining-time-station-TV-series-CompleteHighQuality/Shining Time Station - Ep. 60 - Dan's Big Race   60p.mp4
items.title: Shining Time Station: Dan's Big Race
items.description: The platform gets ready for a bicycle race, with Thomas clips and a puppet story riding along. For a lot of American kids, this is how the little blue engine first rolled in.

items.title: Fetch! with Ruff Ruffman: Elephants and Skydiving
items.description: Somebody taped this off a Kansas City station, it turned up on eBay, and now it's here. Kids visit an elephant sanctuary and go indoor skydiving while Ruff waits in the studio.

items.title: Fetch! with Ruff Ruffman
items.description: Boys race girls through colonial chores in full Plymouth dress while a cartoon dog keeps score from his office. Somebody has to, and it's the dog.

items.id: between-the-lions-2000/Between the Lions (2000)/S10/Between the Lions - 10x03 - City Mouse and Country Mouse; Happy Hocky Family Moves to the Country!.mp4
items.title: Between the Lions: City Mouse and Country Mouse
items.description: Two country stories, one with the Happy Hocky Family, then an Ogden Nash poem and a Cliff Hanger serial between the word games. Even the poetry gets a seat in this library.

items.id: curiousgeorge-season-12-15/S02 E14-Curious George, Spy Monkey; Castle Keep.mp4
items.title: Curious George: Spy Monkey / Castle Keep
items.description: George plays spy in a toy shop, then reads a map in a castle on a golf course. A monkey who has never once stayed where he was told.

items.id: dragon-tales-the-complete-series/Dragon Tales_S02E19_Sneezy Does It & Try It You'll Like It.ia.mp4
items.title: Dragon Tales: Sneezy Does It / Try It, You'll Like It
items.description: The way in is a dragon scale and a rhyme. A kite, a cloud with a cold, and a fairground ride someone isn't sure about: small nerves, softly handled.

items.id: dragon-tales-the-complete-series/Dragon Tales_S03E18_All Together Now & Team Work.ia.mp4
items.title: Dragon Tales: All Together Now / Team Work
items.description: A problem by a forest river, with a spider web and a big turtle shell along the way, and everybody has to work it out together. Then home to the playroom.

items.title: Square One TV
items.description: Somebody decided math could be funny and then proved it with a kitchen phone prank and a song full of equations. The detective story stops on a cliffhanger, which is how you get a kid to come back tomorrow.

items.title: Square One TV
items.description: Two detectives, one calculator, and a missing doll. The case runs out of time before it runs out of clues, so you leave with a question and a pencil. A fair trade.

items.title: Fetch! with Ruff Ruffman
items.description: A cartoon dog gives the orders and real kids do the work: bake the cake, weigh the bricks, climb into the monster truck. The scoreboard keeps honest count, and so does the dog.

items.title: Super Why!: Jack and the Beanstalk
items.description: The heroes climb the beanstalk the way you would, one letter at a time. Then they carry the story's lesson home to a friend, which is the part a good librarian hopes you remember.

items.title: Super Why!: The Ugly Duckling
items.description: The odd duckling gets help with his spelling before he gets help with his feelings. Floating, kicking, gliding: some words are easier to learn when you can feel them.

items.id: the-big-comfy-couch_202108/The Big Comfy Couch - Season 1/The Big Comfy Couch S01E13 - Snug As A Bug.mp4
items.title: The Big Comfy Couch: Snug As A Bug
items.description: Loonette wakes up, says good morning to Molly, and settles in for a story about bees. Nothing here needs fixing by lunchtime. The couch is large enough for all of it.

items.id: the-big-comfy-couch_202108/The Big Comfy Couch - Season 3/The Big Comfy Couch S03E12 - Hiccups.mp4
items.title: The Big Comfy Couch: Hiccups
items.description: Hiccups turn out to be worth a whole half hour of Loonette's attention. Granny Garbanzo drops by, the frogs get their puppet story, and bedtime comes along right on schedule.

items.id: the_electric_company_best_Lando18/The Electric Company - E23 (It’S A Walrus, It’S A Bathtub, It’S Sprayman!).mp4
items.title: The Electric Company
items.description: A decoder machine, a game-show round, and Morgan Freeman as Easy Reader. These sketches trusted kids who already knew their letters to enjoy being clever with them.

items.id: the_electric_company_best_Lando18/The Electric Company - E289 (Can You Say That Name).mp4
items.title: The Electric Company: Can You Say That Name?
items.description: Candy, candles, a candidate: one little word does a lot of work. The sketches chase the letters around the room until you can say any of them. Rita Moreno would approve.

items.title: Square One TV
items.description: A lemonade stand, a fast-food counter, a general's office. The show's quiet argument is that math has been standing next to you the whole time. The detectives are working on it.

items.title: Square One TV
items.description: A math show dressed as a variety show, with a superhero shop, a dance number, and Kate Monday and George Frankly solving a case by arithmetic. The sweater does a lot of the work.

items.title: WordGirl: Princess Triana / Heat Wave, Crime Wave
items.description: Captain Huggy Face does the heavy lifting while a vocabulary word sneaks past you in the dialogue. Two stories, one villain with a book, one town with a heat wave.

items.title: WordGirl: Opposite Day / Granny's Book Club
items.description: Opposite Day turns the town upside down, then Granny May starts taking books and the words in them. A superhero whose power is a dictionary is a very librarian idea.

items.title: Super Why!: Little Red Riding Hood
items.description: Grandma's house, a wolf in a nightcap, and four readers who can spot a trick by the letters alone. It is nice to see a fairy tale get solved instead of just survived.

items.id: the-big-comfy-couch_202108/The Big Comfy Couch - Season 5/The Big Comfy Couch S05E11 - Don't Tell.mp4
items.title: The Big Comfy Couch: Don't Tell
items.description: Waiting is the hardest part of a surprise party, and Loonette knows it. She and Molly do it together on the couch while the other clowns gather at the wagon. Shh.

items.id: the-big-comfy-couch_202108/The Big Comfy Couch - Season 7/The Big Comfy Couch S07E10 - Lost and Found Clowns.mp4
items.title: The Big Comfy Couch: Lost and Found Clowns
items.description: A special delivery letter goes astray and Loonette ends up with the lost-and-found clowns. A problem exactly this size has always been enough on this couch.

items.title: The Electric Company: Just Think
items.description: Thumb, thick, think, trouble: a whole episode on one stubborn sound, with a cartoon car to carry it. Spider-Man swings in at the end, and his balloons are the reading homework.

items.title: ZOOM ('99)
items.description: A pizza made from scratch and a newspaper tower built for a viewer's challenge. The show's best rule survives the reboot: the good ideas come from kids at home, in their own kitchens.

items.title: ZOOM ('99)
items.description: Cereal and milk become the experiment. No star here, just kids with a kitchen and an idea. The tape keeps running through the station's closing cards, and the cards are part of the visit.

items.title: WordGirl: The Good, The Bad, and the Chucky
items.description: A covered wagon parked on a city street, a cowboy hat, and a grandmother's neckerchief that starts a mix-up. Captain Huggy Face has a better day than anyone.

items.title: WordGirl: Royally Framed
items.description: The chase stops in the middle so the cartoon can explain what hesitate and bewilder mean. A horned helmet loose in the park is the best vocabulary lesson that day.

items.title: Cyberchase
items.description: The Cybersquad has a map, a number puzzle, and a very large blue fish to ride. All of it is aimed at saving a slug that may be the last of its kind. Math as a way out of trouble.

items.title: Cyberchase
items.description: Christopher Lloyd voices Hacker, so the theatrics come pre-installed. The kids chase him to a planet where a music contest has gone wrong, and a drum pattern has to be worked out.

items.title: Cyberchase: Raising the Bar
items.description: Digit's squawk could only be Gilbert Gottfried's. The Cybersquad races Hacker and Delete through cyberspace, stops in a library to meet a pink-haired robot, and someone ends up in green coils.

items.title: Teletubbies: Going for a Walk
items.description: The walk over the hills is only half of it. The film in the tummy shows real children climbing fences, opening a gate, and crawling through a hedge. Small adventures, taken seriously.

items.title: Teletubbies: Flamenco Dancing
items.description: A film plays on a Teletubby's tummy: two little girls learning flamenco from their teacher. Then everyone dances in the dome until the sun goes down. The best part is the stomping.

items.title: Teletubbies: Body to Body
items.description: The sun baby watches over a playground where children pair up to make shapes on the ground. Body to body is the whole lesson, and nobody needs it explained.

items.title: The Charlie Horse Music Pizza: Star-Spangled Charlie
items.description: Charlie Horse is asked to sing the anthem in front of a whole stadium, and the pizza parlour has a few things to teach him first. Harmony, mostly, and what the words are actually saying.

items.title: The Charlie Horse Music Pizza: Hush Puppy the Hero
items.description: A sea monster, or so it seems, and Hush Puppy to the rescue. Meanwhile Junior trades piano lessons for driving lessons, which is a fair deal in any parlour.

items.title: ZOOM ('99)
items.description: Red cabbage juice changes colour with acids, which turns a kitchen into a chemistry lab. The kids test whatever liquids are in the cupboards. Wear something you do not mind staining.

items.title: ZOOM ('99)
items.description: A rebus is a puzzle where the words' placement does the talking. Here it comes with folded paper, a chopsticks game, and proof that relaxing your muscles slows your heart.

items.title: Corduroy: Good Night, Corduroy / Soap Flakes
items.description: A girl and her bear stay up late and find the night is well attended. Then a box of soap flakes, and the kind of mess that is mostly bubbles.

items.title: Corduroy: Ship Ahoy / Help Wanted
items.description: A toy boat on the park pond, then Lisa in a cafe kitchen with a bear who keeps peeking at the cookbook. Everybody has to learn somewhere.

items.title: Corduroy: Art Smart / A Hot Day in the City
items.description: A painting mouse in an art museum is exactly who you hope to meet there. Then a hot city day and a daydream of the beach, which is the correct response to one.

items.title: Kratts' Creatures: In Search of the Tasmanian Tiger
items.description: The Kratts go looking, coast and forest, for an animal that has vanished. They find wombats and parrots and a Tasmanian devil along the way, which is not nothing.

items.title: Kratts' Creatures: Weird Creatures
items.description: A sloth, a cassowary and an armadillo prove that weird is mostly a matter of where you are standing. The brothers ask why, and Ttark has opinions.

items.title: Teletubbies: Goats
items.description: The film this time is a small boy among a flock of goats, all of them eating grass. Nothing hurries. That is the design, and it works on grown-ups too.

items.id: 19-can-i-sing-you-my-song/19 Can I Sing You My Song.mp4
items.title: The Charlie Horse Music Pizza: Can I Sing You My Song
items.description: Charlie Horse learns that somebody has to write the songs, and that they can earn a living at it. A birthday party is the right place to try out one of his own.

items.id: lamb-chops-play-along/Lamb Chop's Play Along S01E07 Lamb Chop Works Out.mp4
items.title: Lamb Chop's Play-Along: Lamb Chop Works Out
items.description: Lamb Chop works on her muscles, and the whole garden joins in. It is hard to stay on the couch when a lamb is doing the stretches.

items.id: lamb-chops-play-along/Lamb Chop's Play Along S01E11 The Baseball Show.mp4
items.title: Lamb Chop's Play-Along: The Baseball Show
items.description: A baseball show with a bat, some crafts and a lot of singing. Nobody seems to be keeping score, which is how it should be.

items.title: Corduroy: Super Duper Market / Party Plans
items.description: A trip through the supermarket with a bear along, and a lesson in staying safe. Then the apartment fills with balloons for a party, and the rocking horse is surely invited.

items.title: Kratts' Creatures: The Redcoats Are Coming
items.description: Foxes and coyotes raise their kits, and the old fox hunt rides by in red coats with hounds. Allison and Ttark keep the science straight.

items.title: Kratts' Creatures: Mungus Revenge
items.description: Mungu, head of all living things, has a story to tell, and it runs through rhinos and ostriches. Horns and habits get explained the way a good field trip explains them.

items.title: Long Ago and Far Away
items.description: The tailors sell the Emperor a suit that is not there, and the whole town plays along until the laughing starts. An old tale that holds up well in a cartoon.

items.title: Popular Mechanics for Kids: Buildings
items.description: Two kids and a host find out how a building gets made and kept running, from the concrete to the elevators. It ends with one coming down, which is also a kind of engineering.

items.title: Popular Mechanics for Kids: Police Force
items.description: Kids ride in a helicopter and a patrol car, learn what radar does, and get a close look at the gear. The cells come last, and the tour is quieter for it.

items.title: Popular Mechanics for Kids: Ticket to Ride
items.description: Two young hosts work out how coasters and rides really work, then peek inside an animatronic triceratops. The ride control room is the real treat.

items.id: lamb-chops-play-along/Lamb Chop's Play Along S01E15 Runaway.mp4
items.title: Lamb Chop's Play-Along: Runaway
items.description: Somebody threatens to run away, and the grown-ups in the room take it seriously and gently. Then a letter game and a book, because afterward there is always a book.

items.id: lamb-chops-play-along/Lamb Chop's Play Along S01E19 Charlie Horse's Birthday.mp4
items.title: Lamb Chop's Play-Along: Charlie Horse's Birthday
items.description: A picnic, a table game and a book on the lawn, and that is the whole party. Charlie Horse thinks it is plenty, and he is right.

items.title: Ramona: Mystery Meal
items.description: Supper goes sideways over a meal nobody likes, and the plan is to give it to Pinky Pig. It ends the way family dinners do when they are lucky: candlelight, and two sisters laughing.

items.title: Kratts' Creatures: The Best of the Best
items.description: The brothers line up against a cheetah and a cougar with great confidence and ordinary legs. The real question is who is best, and at what.

items.title: Kratts' Creatures: Gatorglades
items.description: An airboat through the Everglades, where alligators have been getting along for a very long time. The snakes and wading birds are guests in a house much older than they are.

items.id: sagwa-the-chinese-siamese-cat/06 - Harvest Festival Race - Foolish Magistrate's New Clothes.mp4
items.title: Sagwa: Harvest Festival Race / Foolish Magistrate's New Clothes
items.description: A harvest festival race, then weavers sell a magistrate cloth that is not there. The old new-clothes tale, told for a cat who would have noticed.

items.id: sagwa-the-chinese-siamese-cat/26 - Lucky to be a Bat - Tea for Two Monkeys.mp4
items.title: Sagwa: Lucky to Be a Bat / Tea for Two Monkeys
items.description: A bat in round glasses and a flock of small dogs, then monkeys in a tree at sunset. Sagwa handles all of it with the calm of a cat who has seen worse.

items.title: Popular Mechanics for Kids: Space
items.description: Astronauts train in a pool, float on a zero-gravity flight and live aboard a station. The kids ask how, and the answer is a great deal of practice.

items.id: lamb-chops-play-along/Lamb Chop's Play Along S01E24 The Chicken Show.mp4
items.title: Lamb Chop's Play-Along: The Chicken Show
items.description: Eggs in the hay, chicks coming out of them, and everyone leaning in to look. A book on the lawn and a singalong settle the barnyard afterward.

items.id: lamb-chops-play-along/Lamb Chop's Play Along S01E28 Bigger is Better.mp4
items.title: Lamb Chop's Play-Along: Bigger is Better
items.description: Is bigger better? The puppets have thoughts, the children sing and dance about it, and a book on the matter is read aloud near the end.

items.title: Adventures from the Book of Virtues: Compassion
items.description: Two kids on a bike ride and a bison who talks tell stories about mercy: a traveller on the road to Jericho, and a man alone with a lion. A serious afternoon, kindly told.

items.title: Adventures from the Book of Virtues: Faith
items.description: A king and his advisers, a frontier family and a flood. The bison and the kids sort out what faith asks of a person, one story at a time.

items.title: Adventures from the Book of Virtues: Citizenship
items.description: A Roman story, a girl's lesson at home, and the bison and the bikes in between. Citizenship, it turns out, starts at the kitchen table.

items.id: the-cat-in-the-hat-knows-a-lot-about-that-full-series_202605/The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That! S01E11 Flight of the Penguin; Let's Go Fly a Kite!.mp4
items.title: The Cat in the Hat: Flight of the Penguin / Let's Go Fly a Kite!
items.description: A penguin gets a lesson in flight from the Cat, Nick and Sally. Back home, a kite shows how it is really done.

items.id: the-cat-in-the-hat-knows-a-lot-about-that-full-series_202605/The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That! S01E17 Reindeer Games; Along Came a Spider.mp4
items.title: The Cat in the Hat: Reindeer Games / Along Came a Spider
items.description: Nick and Sally find out what reindeer do with antlers, then get shrunk down to watch a spider spin her web. Both are better seen up close.

items.title: The Berenstain Bears: Trouble With Money / Double Dare
items.description: Money trouble for Brother and Sister first, then a dare from the big cubs near the watermelon patch. Bear Country is a good place to learn it the easy way.

items.title: The Berenstain Bears: The Bad Habit / The Prize Pumpkin
items.description: Sister is trying to quit biting her nails, and Papa is trying to grow a prize pumpkin. Both take patience, and a family dinner waits at the end.

items.title: Theodore Tugboat
items.description: A host in a life vest opens the harbour, and the model-boat tugs take it from there, Rebecca among them. Two stories in one half hour, the way PBS aired it.

items.id: the-cat-in-the-hat-knows-a-lot-about-that-full-series_202605/The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That! S01E24 Secret Super Digger; Pucker Up and Blow.mp4
items.title: The Cat in the Hat: Secret Super Digger / Pucker Up and Blow
items.description: Plants, soil and compost, and what a flower needs to grow. The kind of lesson best learned with dirt under your fingernails.

items.id: the-cat-in-the-hat-knows-a-lot-about-that-full-series_202605/The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That! S01E31 Hooray for Hair; Ice is Nice.mp4
items.title: The Cat in the Hat: Hooray for Hair / Ice is Nice
items.description: Porcupine quills and haircuts, then a ride in the Thinga-ma-jigger north to a yak, a polar bear and penguins. Hair turns out to be a bigger subject than you would think.

items.title: The Berenstain Bears: Family Get-Together / The Stinky Milk Mystery
items.description: Relatives arrive in Bear Country, and two cubs bike off after a puzzle about milk. The credits roll over the family fishing by the stream.

items.title: Berenstain Bears: White Water Adventure / Showdown at Birder's Wood
items.description: A canoe trip with a ranger-led group, then a turn toward birds that ends at a treehouse and a nest of chicks. Camping first, and then the quiet of watching.

items.id: the-cat-in-the-hat-knows-a-lot-about-that-full-series_202605/The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That! S01E37 Amazing Eyes; Water Walkers.mp4
items.title: The Cat in the Hat: Amazing Eyes / Water Walkers
items.description: How does a llama see? How does a snake find warmth? The Cat has answers, then shrinks the children down to meet a bug that walks on water.

items.title: National Geographic Video: Shark Encounters
items.description: Michael deGruy lost part of an arm to a shark, so this tour of the family, from the dwarf dog shark to the whale shark, comes from a host with a stake. He goes back in the water to show how it happened.

items.title: Life on Earth: The Rise of the Mammals
items.description: Platypus and echidna first, then Australia's marsupials, the thylacine among them. Life on Earth does mammal family history, and Attenborough tells it like he knew everybody.

items.title: The Life of Birds: Fishing for a Living
items.description: A black heron shades the water with its wings to see the fish. Skimmers, a kingfisher and Galapagos boobies work the same trade. Attenborough covers the whole fleet, and no one is in a hurry.

items.id: LandoftheEagle/Land of the Eagle - Ep 1 The Great Encounter.mp4
items.title: Land of the Eagle
items.description: The BBC's eight-part natural history of North America, told with the continent's first peoples at its center. The continent was somebody else's long before it was anyone else's.

items.title: Discover Bats!
items.description: An earnest case for bats: how they live, how they behave, why the ecosystem needs them. The colony close-ups are good. The pup nursery is the real argument, and it wins.

items.id: david-attenboroughs-world-of-wildlife-meerkats-1996-uk-vhs/David Attenborough's World of Wildlife - Meerkats (1996 UK VHS).ia.mp4
items.title: David Attenborough's World of Wildlife: Meerkats
items.description: A small mob posts a sentry while the rest forage, which is more civic duty than most of us manage. Attenborough watches them watch, on a British VHS that was taped whole.

items.title: Frozen Seas
items.description: David Attenborough beneath the polar ice, where seals navigate frozen cathedrals and penguins commute through water that would kill you in minutes. The BBC's original Blue Planet, proving the ocean doesn't need us to be interesting.

items.title: Birds From the Gods
items.description: Tadashi Shimada follows the birds of paradise through Papua New Guinea, where the males dress like a dare and dance for an audience of one. The courtship is the show. The reviews come from the females, and they are tough.

items.title: Panda Adventure
items.description: Nigel Marven hauls himself into the mountains of central China to fulfill a childhood dream: seeing a giant panda in the wild. Five episodes of bamboo forests, mist, and a man who clearly never outgrew the poster on his bedroom wall.

items.id: BBCNaturalWorld180EpisodeCollection/BBC Natural World 1985 - City Of Coral [VHS (XviD)].mp4
items.title: Natural World: City of Coral
items.description: Neil Goodwin produced and photographed this Caribbean reef film, and the camera has all the patience it needs. One colony stands taller than a man and about a hundred years old, which sets the pace.

items.title: Marty Stouffer's Wild America: Water Babies
items.description: Seal and sea lion pups along the coast, with tides and mothers in charge. Nobody on screen is graceful yet, and nobody minds. Patient cameras, small flippers, and a very low bar for cuteness.

items.id: interspeciesio-jM6WTXSmG78/Ocean Stories 3 - Dolphins and Whales _ Free Documentary-jM6WTXSmG78.mp4
items.title: Ocean Stories: Dolphins and Whales
items.description: Two lives by the water: one person befriends a solitary dolphin off the Irish coast, the other watches orcas hunt in Puget Sound. A quiet film about people who picked the ocean over everything else.

items.id: BBCNaturalWorld180EpisodeCollection/BBC Natural World 1994 - Webs of Intrigue.mp4
items.title: Natural World: Webs of Intrigue
items.description: Spiders, with the patience to watch them work: orb webs, a tarantula, a jumping spider, a mother carrying her egg sac. It opens in a cobwebbed shed, which is fair warning. Check your corners after.

items.id: wild-philippines-with-nigel-marven-episode-1-luzon-the-volcanic-north-the-northern-islands/Wild Philippines with Nigel Marven - Episode 1 - Luzon - The Volcanic North (The Northern Islands).mp4
items.title: Wild Philippines
items.description: Nigel Marven loose in the Philippines, island-hopping from tarsiers to cobras to whale sharks. Volcanic terrain, coral reefs, and a presenter who handles venomous snakes like they're his cousin's kids.

items.id: BBCNaturalWorld180EpisodeCollection/BBC Natural World 2010 - The Monkey-Eating Eagle of the Orinoco (HDTV x264).mp4
items.title: Natural World: The Monkey-Eating Eagle of the Orinoco
items.description: A harpy eagle's nest in the Venezuelan rainforest, a chick, and the capuchins and howlers who have good reason to look up. Climbers with ropes go up into the canopy to meet it.

items.id: DaylightRobbery-II/Daylight Robbery II (VHS transfer with audio sourced from youtube).mp4
items.title: Daylight Robbery II
items.description: The BBC put grey squirrels on obstacle courses and filmed what happened. Presented by Jessica Holm, and more entertaining than it has any right to be.

items.title: Air Jaws: Sharks of South Africa
items.description: Two-thousand-pound great whites leave False Bay straight up, and Dr. Rocky Strong has the front-row boat. The cameras stay patient, which is the right way to watch something that violent.

items.title: Nature: Penguins of the Antarctic
items.description: Emperor penguins huddle through an Antarctic night at fifty below with the wind at ninety, then dive into water that feels like a bath by comparison. PBS Nature on the best-dressed survivors on the planet.

items.title: Growing Up Wild
items.description: A children's series where each episode follows baby animals working out what legs are for, what counts as food, and why that bigger animal is looking at them like that. Narrated with patience.

items.title: Ocean World
items.description: From the BBC's Blue Planet, the series that set out to film the whole ocean: open water, coasts, the deep, and everything making a living in them. Blue in every direction, and rarely empty.

items.id: BBCNaturalWorld180EpisodeCollection/BBC Natural World 2003 - Lost Crocodiles of the Pharaohs.mp4
items.title: Natural World: Lost Crocodiles of the Pharaohs
items.description: Crocodiles in Egypt: mummified ones from the temples of the pharaohs, and living ones in Saharan caves and pools. A BBC Learning bug rides in the corner the whole way, like a very small chaperone.

items.title: Natural World: Jungle Nights
items.description: The rainforest on its night shift: bats, a tarantula, small primates, and scientists logging it all on 1990s laptops. Patient, dark and a little damp, as a jungle should be.

items.id: WildSouthAmerica/Wild South America - Ep 1 Lost Worlds.mp4
items.title: Wild South America
items.description: Broadcast as Andes to Amazon, this BBC series runs from high peaks to the forest floor, with infrared night cameras in the jungle catching animals that are rarely seen.

items.id: the-trials-of-life-1990/The Trials of Life (1990) - S01E04 - Hunting and Escaping (1080p BluRay x265 afm72).mp4
items.title: The Trials of Life: Hunting and Escaping
items.description: Attenborough on how to eat and how not to be eaten, from orcas to a moth wearing eyespots to army ants that build bridges out of themselves. The ants have the best engineering here.

items.title: Springwatch 2022
items.description: Packham, Strachan and Williams spend weeks in the British countryside while live cameras watch nests, dens and setts. Live means nobody, the presenters included, knows what the burrow will do next.

items.title: The Life of Mammals: Life in the Trees
items.description: Mammals that went up a tree and never came back down: flying foxes at sunset, small primates after dark, gibbons and an orangutan. Attenborough goes up to meet them, which is the polite way.

items.id: austin-stevens-snakemaster-in-search-of-monster-rattlers/Austin Stevens - Snakemaster - In Search of Monster Rattlers.mp4
items.title: Austin Stevens Snakemaster: In Search of Monster Rattlers
items.description: Austin Stevens, the Snakemaster, goes looking for monster rattlers, and the rattle is the soundtrack all the way through. It is the polite warning. Keep your feet on the couch.

items.id: BBCNaturalWorld180EpisodeCollection/BBC Natural World 1987 - Spirits of the Forest.mp4
items.title: Natural World: Spirits of the Forest
items.description: Madagascar's lemurs and the forests they live in, with Alison Jolly among the scientific advisers. The island grew its own primates, and the film gives them time to prove it. The ring-tails take it.

items.title: The Great Journeys
items.description: Snow geese, wildebeest, monarchs and humpback whales, each crossing thousands of miles on instinct alone. No maps, no layovers. The film follows at their pace, which is the only pace on offer.

items.title: White Sands, White Wilderness
items.description: The world's largest gypsum dunes, explained by New Mexico State with dramatic footage and computer animation, down to the plants and animals found nowhere else. Calm voice, bright sand, no hurry.

items.id: rocky-mountain-national-park-rooftop-of-the-continent-1990/Rocky Mountain National Park - Rooftop of the Continent (1990).ia.mp4
items.title: Rooftop of the Continent
items.description: Colorado's high country on VHS: elk meadows, alpine tundra, and the long slow pans the format was secretly good at. It plays like a postcard somebody left running.

items.title: Discovering Alaska
items.description: Alaska at two hours: glaciers, bears working the rivers, tundra running past the edge of the frame. It is in no hurry, and the wilderness has never once asked about your schedule.

items.id: interspeciesio-IOI-QOiQ01g/Mountain Gorilla - A Shattered Kingdom! _ Real Wild-IOI-QOiQ01g.mp4
items.title: Mountain Gorilla: A Shattered Kingdom
items.description: A gorilla family's ordinary life: eating, sleeping, growing up. Then the region's politics arrive, and the camera angle never has to change.

items.title: Ice Age Survivors
items.description: The argument here: the moose, bison and elephants alive today are what's left of a Pleistocene lineup that ran much bigger. Watch them as survivors rather than as the normal size of things.

items.title: The Grizzlies
items.description: The grizzly film that follows them from salmon streams in Alaska to the tourist overlooks in Yellowstone. Powerful, intelligent, and aggressive enough that even the cameraman keeps a respectful distance. You can feel it through the screen.

items.title: Life in Cold Blood: The Cold Blooded Truth
items.description: Attenborough's last big survey turns to reptiles and amphibians, the animals most of us have been rude about. He makes the introductions, calmly, as is his way.

items.title: British Trees & Woodlands
items.description: A slow, loving walk through Britain's woods, birch to yew, oak to beech, with enough detail that you could step into any English wood afterward and name what you see. Trees as the whole drama.

items.id: BBCNaturalWorld180EpisodeCollection/BBC Natural World 1998 - Vanishing Pools of the Zambezi.mp4
items.title: Natural World: Vanishing Pools of the Zambezi
items.description: The Zambezi shrinks in the dry season and everything with a pulse comes to what's left: lions, hippos, elephants with a calf, and hyenas, whom the narrator calls the ultimate butchers.

items.title: The Natural World: Amazon, The Flooded Forest
items.description: The Amazon floods, and the forest becomes an ocean with treetops. BBC's Natural World follows the fish into the canopy, where the fruit falls from above and the whole place runs on high water. Off a UK VHS.

items.title: Equator from the Air
items.description: Gordon Buchanan, a wildlife cameraman by trade, follows the equator around the planet for BBC Two. Seen from above, the tropics read as one continuous belt rather than a list of countries.

items.title: Sky Island
items.description: Mountains, canyons and desert from Idaho Public Television. A caption bills Meryl Streep, and then the landscape does nearly all the talking. A sky island is a peak stranded above the lowlands.

items.title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet — Land
items.description: The ground is the lead here: geological forces, soil, plants, and the creatures that learned to live on top of them. One episode of a series that tells the planet's story through its elements.

items.id: MooseTitansOfTheNorth/2007 Nat Geo Wild - Moose (Titans of the North).ia.mp4
items.title: Moose: Titans of the North
items.description: A northern winter that would kill most things that tried it, and a moose that looks assembled from spare parts getting through it anyway. Starvation and cold are the plot.

items.id: the-undersea-world-of-jacques-cousteau-1976/files/S01E02 - Savage World of the Coral Jungle.mp4
items.title: Cousteau's Undersea World: Savage World of the Coral Jungle
items.description: Cousteau opens with 'This is the Coral Jungle' and treats the reef like a place with a reputation: morays, a diving saucer, the Calypso crew in the water. Savage is the show's word, not the reef's.

items.title: The Glacier Fox
items.description: Koreyoshi Kurahara's Hokkaido fox film follows two foxes from courtship to kits, and lets the winter do the plot. No hurry at all. A love story, technically.

items.title: Griffy Lake
items.description: A homemade nature documentary about a lake in Bloomington, Indiana. David and Eric White just showed up with a camera and paid attention. No narrator, no agenda, just a small body of water and whatever decided to live near it.

items.title: Cousteau's Undersea World: The Night of the Squid
items.description: The Calypso crew dives at night into swarms of squid under the lights, and the narration reaches for 'a golden grenade, distracting predators.' The 1970s could make anything sound like a thriller.

items.title: Wandering Through Winter
items.description: A 1970s nature film that drifts through the quiet side of winter — frost patterns, dormant forests, animals conserving every calorie. The season most documentaries skip, given its full hour of patience.

items.id: lost-worlds-vanished-lives-part-one-1996-uk-vhs_202204/Lost Worlds Vanished Lives Part One (1996 UK VHS).ia.mp4
items.title: Lost Worlds, Vanished Lives
items.description: Attenborough goes fossil hunting, off a UK VHS. Whole casts of creatures lived and died before anyone was around to name them, and he makes the introductions.

items.id: americas-natural-wonders-volume-two-celebrated-national-parks-1994/Americas Natural Wonders Volume Two - Celebrated National Parks (1994).ia.mp4
items.title: Celebrated National Parks
items.description: Big trees, foggy ridgelines and a narrator in no rush at all. Put it on when the day has been too loud, and the parks will take the whole afternoon.

items.title: Congo
items.description: A river of 4,700 km, and almost none of its basin could be filmed. The BBC makes the most of what its crews could reach, which is still a great deal of jungle.

items.title: Echo of the Elephants
items.description: Cynthia Moss has followed one elephant family in Amboseli, Kenya for decades. This BBC film follows its matriarch, Echo, and the family she leads: elephants remember, and so does she.

items.title: Realms of the Russian Bear
items.description: BBC cameras into the corners of the former Soviet Union that outsiders rarely saw: Siberian tigers, Kamchatka's volcanic bears, the frozen taiga. An empire of wilderness, long kept behind the Iron Curtain.

items.title: Nature: Violent Hawaii
items.description: Hawaii as Nature sees it: volcanoes, monster waves, rockslides and the odd blizzard. The brochure leaves out the violence, which is the reason the islands exist at all.

items.id: BBCNaturalWorld180EpisodeCollection/BBC Natural World 1994 - Pandas of the Sleeping Dragon.mp4
items.title: Natural World: Pandas of the Sleeping Dragon
items.description: A mountain bamboo reserve in China, a mother panda hauling bamboo into her nest, a four-month-old cub, and a red panda who gets more than a cameo. Liz and Keith Laidler made it. Nobody hurries.

items.id: BBCNaturalWorld180EpisodeCollection/BBC Natural World 1999 - Hokkaido, Garden of the Gods [PDTV (XviD)].mp4
items.title: Natural World: Hokkaido, Garden of the Gods
items.description: Hokkaido through its seasons: red-crowned cranes, Steller's sea eagles, a brown bear at a salmon waterfall, whooper swans. Japan's wild north, where the cranes stay put all year.

items.title: Down the Amazon
items.description: The closing chapter of the BBC's Flight of the Condor, which starts in the Andes and ends by following the water down the Amazon. Made by Michael Andrews.

items.id: predators-of-the-wild-giant-tarantula-1995-uk-vhs/Predators of the Wild Giant Tarantula (1995 UK VHS).ia.mp4
items.title: Predators of the Wild: Giant Tarantula
items.description: Eight legs, one plan, and a great deal of waiting. The spider is the patient one here; you, on the couch, are not. A British VHS, with the unhurried pacing nature shows used to be sold on.

items.title: Diary of a Desert Garden
items.description: Southwest Africa is mostly rocks, sand and mountains, and yet it holds thousands of species of flowers. George Page hosts a PBS film about a desert that blooms with an intensity that looks impossible.

items.title: The Fifth World of the Aztecs
items.description: In Aztec belief the world had been made and destroyed four times, and they lived in the fifth. From the BBC's Spirits of the Jaguar: the animals behind the myths of a people who treated nature as scripture.

items.title: Wild Discovery: Wonderful Kangaroo
items.description: Peter Ustinov narrates the kangaroo, from a newborn joey held in a hand to reds and greys sharing the country with sheep and tractors. An Anglia production, off a Wild Discovery VHS.

items.id: FirstLifeWithDavidAttenborough/2010 First Life with David Attenborough Ep 1 Arrival.ia.mp4
items.title: First Life
items.description: Attenborough starts the hunt for the first animals in a forest near the Leicester of his childhood, then follows the fossils toward the first eyes, teeth and predator. He looks for the beginning close to home.

items.title: Kopje: A Rock for All Seasons
items.description: A single granite outcrop on the African savannah, filmed across the seasons. Lizards, birds, insects, and plants all sharing one ancient rock — a miniature ecosystem in plain sight, proving you don't need a continent to contain a universe.

items.title: Wild Discovery: Crocodile Territory
items.description: The saltwater crocodile can go three months without a meal, which makes the Northern Territory's wet season a buffet and its dry season a long wait. A patient predator, filmed by an equally patient camera.

items.title: Killer Whales: Wolves of the Sea
items.description: David Attenborough narrates an hour with the killer whales, who hunt in packs like wolves and stun herring with their tails. The title is the thesis; the patience is the show.

items.title: Rain Forest
items.description: Costa Rica's rain forest, with leaf-cutting ants hauling loads many times their own weight and a basilisk lizard running across the water without sinking. The jungle as a machine of tiny workers.

items.id: the-trials-of-life-1990/The Trials of Life (1990) - S01E11 - Courting (1080p BluRay x265 afm72).mp4
items.title: The Trials of Life: Courting
items.description: Attenborough does courtship: a bowerbird with a decorated bower, birds of paradise in full show, and elephant seals who skip the subtlety. A planet that has tried every approach.

items.title: National Geographic Explorer: Ultimate Cat
items.description: National Geographic Explorer treats lions, tigers and leopards as engineering: one design brief, three different solutions, grassland and swamp as the test tracks. The cat at home is taking notes.

items.title: Baby Tales
items.description: Baby animals learning to be animals: walking, eating, not getting eaten. The sharper part is the parents, who keep running the math on how much danger to allow and how much to prevent.

items.title: Hidden Hawaii
items.description: National Geographic goes to the Hawaiian Islands National Wildlife Refuge — the parts of Hawaii that don't make the postcards. Coral reefs in crisis, marine life holding on, and conservation efforts doing their best against the math.

items.title: The Life of Birds: Signals and Songs
items.description: Attenborough on how birds talk, from the lyrebird to the palm cockatoo to a ptarmigan on snow. The dawn chorus turns out to be a conversation, and most of us have been talking over it.

items.title: NOVA: Return to Mt. St. Helens
items.description: Life comes back to the Mount St. Helens blast zone faster than anyone expected, and NOVA revises a few textbook ideas on camera. The BBC Radiophonic Workshop scored the comeback, so even the moss sounds a little sci-fi.

items.title: The Natural World: Attenborough in Paradise
items.description: Thirty-eight of the forty-two birds of paradise live in Papua New Guinea's forests, and Attenborough goes to meet them. Patience is the whole method. The birds put in the effort.

items.id: the-discovery-video-channel-the-ends-of-the-earth/(Redone) The Discovery Video Channel - The Ends of the Earth - Enter the Dreamtime of West Australia.ia.mp4
items.title: The Ends of the Earth: Enter the Dreamtime of West Australia
items.description: Western Australia with the Dreamtime myths set beside the wildlife: a thorny devil that looks like a cactus with opinions, a frilled lizard, Ningaloo Reef. A Discovery Video Channel tape, with the sleeve still on it.

items.title: Natural World: Leopard Hunters
items.description: Leopards in Yala, Sri Lanka, caught by camera trap and infrared after dark. A card up front says hundreds of people in the park died in the massive waves while few dead animals were found.

items.title: Africa's Animal Oasis
items.description: Ngorongoro is a collapsed volcano in Tanzania whose floor became a world of its own: fresh water, grazers by the thousand, flamingoes, and every predator that noticed. The audience is also the cast.

items.title: Wild Discovery: Lions of Etosha
items.description: A pride at Etosha in Namibia: cubs, a dark-maned male, a waterhole after dark. A Survival Anglia production, caught off Wild Discovery on VHS, so it comes with the soft glow of a tape.

items.title: Reptiles and Amphibians
items.description: 350 million years of evolutionary success. Komodo dragons, giant tortoises, sea snakes, and crocodiles that haven't changed since the dinosaurs because — why would they? They got it right the first time.

items.title: Horses
items.description: Mongolian children race horses across the steppe, and elsewhere riders in wheelchairs find freedom in the saddle. Same animal, same old bargain: it started as a beast of burden and kept finding better work.

items.title: Cousteau's Undersea World: The Dragons of Galapagos
items.description: The Calypso goes to the Galapagos for the marine iguana, billed here as 'a dragon of the sea, a living fossil.' It swims, it basks, it sneezes salt, and the scientists measure it patiently.

items.title: The Private Life of Plants: Travelling
items.description: Plants can't walk, so this one is about how they travel anyway. Attenborough and the BBC's patient cameras show that the garden has been on the move the whole time. Rude of it not to tell us.

items.title: Wolf: Return of a Legend
items.description: Jim Dutcher's cameras go close on the gray wolf and set out to retire a few centuries of bad press. Graham Greene narrates, calmly. It is the rare wolf story in which nobody is cast as the villain.

items.title: Galapagos
items.description: The islands are a geological conveyor belt: new land rising in the west, old land sinking back into the sea in the east, and a living laboratory of species found nowhere else in between. Darwin took notes.

items.id: in-the-company-of-whales-1991-4-audio-tracks-animal-planet-documentary-dvdrip-by-h-y-p-o-2/In the Company of Whales 1991 (4 audio tracks)Animal Planet documentary DVDRip by H y P o 2.mp4
items.title: In the Company of Whales
items.description: Whales, filmed with the patience whales require. Nothing here hurries, and a few minutes in you stop wanting it to. Settle in; the ocean keeps its own schedule and has never once checked ours.

items.title: Animal Oddities: Dragons
items.description: A lizard tour: the Komodo, Gila monsters, marine iguanas and flying lizards, pitched as a living myth. Nobody had to invent anything for this one. The lizards were already doing the work.

items.id: WildDiscoveryCollection/Wild Discovery 1998-05-26 Monkeys of the Temple Forest.mp4
items.title: Natural World: Monkeys of the Temple Forest
items.description: Toque macaques live among ancient temple ruins and forest, where the monkeys are the residents and the stones are the furniture. BBC Natural World, series editor Neil Nightingale.

items.id: baja-mexicos-cactus-forest/National Geographic (1989) Baja - Mexico's Cactus Forest.mp4
items.title: Baja: Mexico's Cactus Forest
items.description: Mexico's Baja Peninsula and the Sea of Cortez — home to the cardon, a ten-ton cactus, plus scorpions, manta rays, and sea turtles. The desert meets the ocean and both of them brought their weirdest residents.

items.title: Cousteau's Undersea World: Hippo!
items.description: Cousteau trades the sea for an African river and lake, and meets hippos from the water, the shore and underneath. They yawn, which is a warning, and then they charge.

items.title: The Impossible Bird
items.description: The ostrich can't fly and, by aerodynamic reasoning, has no business thriving, yet it does. The film follows the nest to the point where chicks from several families pool into one enormous, chaotic playgroup.

items.title: In the Kingdom of Dolphins
items.description: Hardy Jones and Julia Whitty spend several summers in the Caribbean learning dolphins by sight, Didi most of all. It's Jane Goodall's method, but wetter. Quiet, and the dolphins have the upper hand.

items.title: Wild Discovery: The Frozen Kingdom
items.description: Both poles in one sitting: polar bears, walrus, orcas, and emperor and Adelie penguins, Arctic to Antarctic. A Discovery Channel production, off the tape it aired on.

items.title: Miracle of the Scarlet Salmon
items.description: Sockeye born in British Columbia's Adams River head for the open Pacific, then find their way back to the same gravel. The big runs there come every four years, which makes the homecoming a scheduled event.

items.title: Natural World: Whale Shark
items.description: A giant roams the world's oceans, and scientists in boats try to tag it and find out where. Spotted skin, a mouth like a doorway, sunlit water. The biggest fish in the sea, with the calmest manner.

items.title: Downwind, Downstream
items.description: Peter Coyote lends the steady voice to Christopher McLeod's look at where pollution ends up after the smokestack and the pipe. The air and the water are the witnesses, and they have a long memory.

items.title: Westwood Promotions: Remembering the 80s with Nina Blackwood
items.description: Nina Blackwood was one of MTV's original five VJs in 1981, so here she is selling the decade she helped broadcast back to you on CD. The record-sleeve set knows exactly what it is doing.

items.title: Les Brown: The Motivator, Power Pak (1988)
items.description: Les Brown went from radio DJ to the Ohio legislature to the lecture circuit, so the pitch is really just his resume with a guarantee at the end.

items.title: The McDougall Program: 12 Days to Dynamic Health
items.description: A doctor recommends potatoes on USA at 6 a.m., sandwiched between Susan Powter and First Business, which is the whole early-nineties self-improvement dial in one sitting.

items.title: Let's Talk with Lyle Waggoner: Y-Bron (1988)
items.description: Lyle Waggoner, a regular on The Carol Burnett Show, also built a business renting Star Waggons trailers to film sets. Here he works a studio audience for a homeopathic remedy, still in the comfort business.

items.title: CSA AutoBike Classic
items.description: A bike that shifts its own gears, so the rider's only job is to look happy about the boardwalk. Taped in Sacramento in 1998 by a viewer who suspects they've stopped making them.

items.title: Susan Powter: Stop the Insanity!
items.description: Susan Powter's platinum buzz cut and her shout of 'Stop the insanity!' turned a diet pitch into a catchphrase. This is the whole half hour, shot in Dallas at the Plaza of the Americas, at full volume.

items.id: the-fantom-furytm-story-vacuum-cleaner-infomercial-1996/The FANTOM FURYTM Story - Vacuum Cleaner Infomercial (1996).mp4
items.title: The Fantom Fury Story: Fantom Fury Vacuum (1996)
items.description: The testimonials roam from Ridgecrest, California to a log cabin, which is roughly the full range of American dust. Bagless is the selling point, and the dog has seen all of it.

items.title: Urban Rebounding System (2005)
items.description: Tucked in after CSI and Entertainment Tonight Weekend on a Baltimore station, a mini trampoline tries to bounce its way into your weekend. The tape runs out before the countdown does.

items.title: Qwik Cook Newspaper Burning Grill (1991)
items.description: Tony Pessy hosts a grill that runs on rolled-up newspaper, so the sports section finally earns its keep with the tailgaters. Part cookout, part recycling program, and the headlines literally go up in smoke.

items.id: TheVistaGroup-Early90sInfomercialDonLapresMakingMoneySecrets/Early 90s Infomercial: Don Lapre's Making Money Secrets • 60 FPS 1992.ia.mp4
items.title: Don Lapre's Making Money Secrets (1992)
items.description: Don Lapre's pitch here is the tiny classified ad. The Greatest Vitamin in the World came later, and so did a 2011 fraud indictment, which gives this tape the feel of a first chapter.

items.title: The Video Professor with Jeff Conaway (1992)
items.description: Jeff Conaway went from Kenickie in Grease to Bobby on Taxi to explaining computers to America at 6 a.m. on WCBS, the morning after Christmas, when the new computer was either under the tree or it wasn't.

items.id: angels-as-seen-on-tv-vhs-tape-1994/Angels - As Seen on TV VHS Tape 1994.mp4
items.title: The Gift of Angels: The Angel Guideline (1994)
items.description: Touched by an Angel premiered on CBS the same year, and this is the direct-response version, with a phone line instead of a plot. A woman in a red blazer keeps the sunset set in order.

items.title: Discover: The Helsinki Formula (1986)
items.description: The FCC lifted its limits on commercial time in 1984, and a few years later you could get a hair-regrowth shampoo sold with a survey, a factory tour and a stylist's chair for half an hour.

items.id: uanvideo/Apple - The Martinettis Bring Home A Computer • 1995.mp4
items.title: Apple Performa: The Martinettis Bring Home a Computer (1995)
items.description: Apple's Performa was the consumer Mac sold in big retail stores, so naturally the pitch is a family soap opera in which the big drama is shopping for one. The free info kit is the cliffhanger.

items.title: Psychic Readers Network: Ten Free Minutes
items.description: The network behind Miss Cleo's 'Call me now!' ads offers ten free minutes, and the format has its arc: a skeptic walks in at the mall, a believer walks out.

items.title: Gloria Sutton Realtors: Showcase of Homes (1996)
items.description: The most honest half hour on the channel: houses in Chattanooga, one after another, no miracle, no gadget, no countdown clock. Gloria Sutton moves it along in pearls like a garden party host.

items.id: 2007-infomercial-for-the-ultimate-rock-ballads-collection/2007 infomercial for The Ultimate Rock Ballads Collection.ia.mp4
items.title: Time Life: The Ultimate Rock Ballads Collection with Kevin Cronin (2007)
items.description: Kevin Cronin, who sang REO Speedwagon's 'Keep On Loving You', hosts a box set of rock ballads, so the man behind one of the biggest is selling you everybody else's. This is the Australian copy.

items.title: Sentricon Colony Elimination System (2003)
items.description: Dow AgroSciences made Sentricon, and this pitch treats termites like a nature documentary where the host cheerfully roots against the subject. The polo man smiles; the colony does not.

items.title: Ralph Paul's Secrets to Playing Great Guitar Now (1999)
items.description: Lessons take years, says the calendar graphic; this video, naturally, does not. It spent the 2002 holidays on Hallmark Channel, where nobody was in a hurry either.

items.title: Sharper Image Ionic Breeze (2004)
items.description: Consumer Reports panned the Ionic Breeze, Sharper Image sued, and by 2008 the company was bankrupt. Here it's 2004, a founder on the set, wiping the plate clean to prove there's nothing to clean.

items.id: js-a-advertisements-the-making-of-a-commercial-infomercial-1991/JS&A Advertisements The Making of A Commercial Infomercial 1991.ia.mp4
items.title: JS&A: The Making of a Commercial, BluBlocker Sunglasses (1991)
items.description: A commercial about the making of a commercial, from the company Joe Sugarman built on ad copy. The microphones are as orange as the lenses.

items.title: Alex Langer's Flying Lure (1994)
items.description: The lure's case is underwater footage, where the fish never look unconvinced, and on the Branson stage the price keeps dropping like it's being reeled in.

items.title: Freedom From Fat Diet Plan (1987)
items.description: The doctor's lab coat does most of the credentialing, and the bunting makes the weigh-in feel like a county fair. Every few minutes somebody has lost twenty pounds, right on schedule.

items.title: Time Life 80s Music Explosion (2008)
items.description: Belinda Carlisle, who sang lead for the Go-Go's, co-hosts a pitch for the decade she helped soundtrack. The music is the whole argument, and a clip of nearly every song makes it.

items.title: Kmart Spring 1990 Music In-Store Video
items.description: Nobody sat down for this one. It played to shoppers walking past the music racks, so Kiss and the B-52's got equal billing: the store sold both.

items.title: TurboGrafx-16 Promo Tape
items.description: The TurboGrafx-16 was Japan's PC Engine in American clothes, and this tape makes its best case, with a CD magazine promised on top. Nintendo and Sega finished the argument, and not in its favor.

items.title: Meaningful Beauty with Cindy Crawford (2007)
items.description: Cindy Crawford is the proof, Dr Sebagh is the credential and a melon is the brand: a tidy division of labor from Guthy-Renker, the company that also sold Proactiv.

items.title: Talk Psychic USA with Bo Griffin (1998)
items.description: Every caption admits it's for entertainment only, which makes it the most honest text on Discovery in June 1998. Bo Griffin sells the future from a comfortable sofa, with a fine-print escape hatch.

items.id: shop-at-home-network-the-knife-collectors-show-90s-woc/Shop At Home Network The Knife Collectors Show 90s WOC.mp4
items.title: The Knife Collectors Show on Shop at Home Network
items.description: Fifty blades in an ammo box is the kind of lot only a collectors' show can sell with a straight face, while the hosts keep reminding everyone the edges are very sharp. Nobody argues.

items.title: Integra Viktory Golf Clubs (2001)
items.description: A long-drive champion is the salesman, so the proof is a swing you will not be matching, and the closest thing to a plot is clubs being boxed for shipping.

items.title: Roadshow Home Video: June 1984 Dealer Presentation
items.description: Aimed at shop owners, not you, so it's a rare view of how the rental shelf got stocked: The Rutles, a Beatles parody, sit beside Under Fire, and a Nikon is the incentive.

items.id: 1996-apple-computer-infomercial-the-kids-in-room-116-aired-november-28-1996/1996 Apple Computer Infomercial： The Kids in Room 116 - Aired November 28, 1996.mp4
items.title: Apple Computer: The Kids in Room 116 (1996)
items.description: The slate swears every character is fictional, and the real plot twist was off camera: Steve Jobs returned to Apple in 1997, a year after Room 116 and its free information kit.

items.title: Sawdust Therapy: Shopsmith Mark V
items.description: The Mark V dates to the 1960s, so this is a sales tape for something older than the VCR it's on. The pitch ends on a bicycle: it takes up that much room.

items.title: X3D 3D Glasses and Games (2002)
items.description: The uploader calls it 'the future that never came,' and the case for the glasses rests on a solar-system tour and a chess champion's letter. Chess never needed a third dimension; that was the host's problem.

items.title: Bodi-Tek Facial Toner (2000)
items.description: Captions swear the before and after photos are unretouched, the way a magician shows you the empty hat. FX ran it overnight around the end of January 2000, the hour when an electronic facial toner seems reasonable.

items.title: Miss Cleo: Mind & Spirit (2001)
items.description: This is Miss Cleo at full volume in 2001, a year before the FTC went after the company behind her hotline. 'Call me now!' was the catchphrase, and the corner of the screen made it easy.

items.title: Time Life Classic Soft Rock (2006)
items.description: Two singers on a sofa vouch for 168 songs you already know by heart. That's the whole pitch: nothing here is new, and that's the product. The sofa looks very comfortable.

items.title: H2O Mop
items.description: Every floor in the house is a crime scene, and the steam mop is the detective who never takes a day off. The uploader taped this in Australia in 2009, unsure when it was made, which fits: infomercials have no vintage.

items.title: Flavorwave Turbo Oven with Mr. T (2007)
items.description: From Rocky III's Clubber Lang to The A-Team's B.A. Baracus to a glass countertop oven: Mr. T's range is wide. The glass means everyone gets to watch the ribs.

items.id: theme-ware-internet-business-toolbox-infomercial-with-richard-karn-june-2000/ThemeWare Internet Business Toolbox Infomercial with Richard Karn_ June 2000 [fayBpsyIwd8].ia.mp4
items.title: Theme Ware Internet Tool Box with Richard Karn (2000)
items.description: Richard Karn spent the 90s as Home Improvement's Al Borland, the sensible one, so he's the right man to vouch for a toolbox for the web. It aired in June 2000, three months after the dot-com peak.

items.id: psychic-talk-special-tarot-edition-infomercial-week-of-1-31-2000/Psychic Talk - Special Tarot Edition infomercial(Week of 1 31 2000).mp4
items.title: Psychic Talk Special Tarot Edition from Total Telecom (2000)
items.description: Three women and a round table take the long way through the tarot, and the phone number rides along in the corner for every card, like a guest who won't leave. FX ran it at the end of January 2000.

items.title: Ab Lounge from Fitness Quest
items.description: Whoever taped ESPN Classic's 3 Days of Dale marathon kept the ad break, and Fitness Quest is in it, promising a reclining chair will end crunches forever. Racing and sit-ups, together at last.
