items.id: supersloppydoubledare-1987/Super Sloppy Double Dare (1987) - The Koehler Bears vs. The Hawks.mp4
items.title: Super Sloppy Double Dare (1987): The Koehler Bears vs. The Hawks
items.description: The trivia is a time capsule, Kate & Allie and U2's Joshua Tree, before a goggles-and-cream stunt and an obstacle course with a cage, a ramp and a bicycle leg. The Koehler Bears and the Hawks play for Reebok and a scooter.

items.id: supersloppydoubledare-1987/Super Sloppy Double Dare (1987) - The Pepperoni Pizzas vs. The Miracle Workers.mp4
items.title: Super Sloppy Double Dare: The Pepperoni Pizzas vs. The Miracle Workers
items.description: A basket balanced on a head is just the warm-up. The real contest runs through Granny's Attic, the Recipe Tire Run and the Tank, where Pepperoni Pizzas and Miracle Workers get messy. Complete, with no commercials.

items.title: Video Power: Batman Week (Monday)
items.description: Season two is where Video Power swapped its cartoon for a game-show format, and the first episode is Batman Week: two kids in life vests duel at consoles under a clock, then a goop-soaked dash through a game store.

items.title: Video Power: Battletoads Week (Thursday)
items.description: Battletoads has a name for brutal difficulty, and here kids in life vests race its rounds at the consoles while the host calls the score. The winner gets the prize round: a game store and a goop bin.

items.id: secrets-of-the-cryptkeepers-haunted-house-crabs-vs-squids/Secrets of the Cryptkeeper's Haunted House - Crabs Vs Squids.mp4
items.title: Secrets of the Cryptkeeper's Haunted House: Crabs vs. Squids
items.description: The Cryptkeeper doesn't host, he heckles from his chair while the Crabs and the Squids, in crash helmets, climb a numbered rope ladder and hit the Dungeon. Taped at Universal Studios Florida.

items.id: secrets-of-the-cryptkeepers-haunted-house-crabs-vs-squids/Secrets of the Cryptkeeper's Haunted House - Sloths Vs Hogs.mp4
items.title: Secrets of the Cryptkeeper's Haunted House: Sloths vs. Hogs
items.description: Even the Cryptkeeper got a game show. John Kassir, his voice since Tales from the Crypt, announces as the Sloths and Hogs hit Fireball Alley and a rope swing over the moat, in a run that earned a Daytime Emmy nomination.

items.id: secrets-of-the-cryptkeepers-haunted-house-crabs-vs-squids/Secrets of the Cryptkeeper's Haunted House - Snakes Vs Skunks.mp4
items.title: Secrets of the Cryptkeeper's Haunted House: Snakes vs. Skunks
items.description: One season on CBS was enough to build an Endless Hallway. The Snakes and the Skunks go down a sliding tunnel, through a word-matching board, then up a rope ladder to the Hall of Horrors.

items.title: Double Dare (1986): The Goobers vs. The Rasinettes
items.description: The Goobers and the Rasinettes, both in red, live by the name: dare the other team to answer, they can double dare it back, and a double dare can be swapped for the physical challenge. Hat-and-rings, a goo pit, a timed helmet run.

items.title: Get the Picture: Playing for an NES
items.description: The picture arrives one lit square at a time, with a Konami game and an NES Control Deck among the prizes. Mike O'Malley hosts two kid teams, and the day ends at the Mega Memory floor grid.

items.id: ytv-uhoh/Uh-Oh! S02E14 Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island [KeepItWeird].mp4
items.title: Uh-Oh!: Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island
items.description: Charlottetown, P.E.I., where the field game takes place in a pool of pudding. In the studio the host reads the question cards and the teams spin the wheel for points.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: Fredericton, New Brunswick
items.description: Fredericton, New Brunswick, sends a bagpiper to the outdoor skit. In the studio the host reads the question cards, the kids' teams spin the wheel, and the floor gets slimy.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: Banff, Alberta
items.description: Banff, and the outdoor challenge involves someone in a bird costume. Back in the studio the colour teams take the quiz and the wheel game with the host before things get messy.

items.id: supersloppydoubledare-1987/Super Sloppy Double Dare (1987) - The Super Solvers vs. The Champions.mp4
items.title: Super Sloppy Double Dare (1987): The Super Solvers vs. The Champions
items.description: Reebok and Worlds of Wonder, the Teddy Ruxpin company, supply the prizes after a wall climb, a tire swing and a tub of clam dip. First the Super Solvers and the Champions field Cosby kids and Billy Rosewood questions.

items.id: supersloppydoubledare-1987/Super Sloppy Double Dare (1987) - The Difference vs. The Punky Preppies.mp4
items.title: Super Sloppy Double Dare: The Difference vs. The Punky Preppies
items.description: The Difference and the Punky Preppies answer pop-culture questions, then run helmeted through messy obstacles, and somewhere in there the host ends up wearing lunch.

items.title: Video Power: Mega Man Week (Monday)
items.description: Life-vested kids race the clock at the consoles while the host slips in a Mega Man tip, and then somebody sprints a game store and a goop bin. The Mega Man games let you pick which boss to fight first.

items.title: Video Power: TMNT 2 Week (Wednesday)
items.description: Turtles Week, Wednesday: two kids in vests duel on TMNT II while Johnny Arcade calls tips to the crowd, then it's a sprint through a toy store of game boxes. Cowabunga, with a controller.

items.title: Think Fast (1990): Angela and Brian vs. Belinda and Doug
items.description: Angela and Brian in blue against Belinda and Doug in gold, trading quick questions and physical stunts in a game that lives up to its name. The finish is a timed run in helmets, grabbing from lockers.

items.id: secrets-of-the-cryptkeepers-haunted-house-crabs-vs-squids/Secrets of the Cryptkeeper's Haunted House - Spiders Vs Worms.mp4
items.title: Secrets of the Cryptkeeper's Haunted House: Spiders vs. Worms
items.description: Eddie and Kelly, the Worms, go up against the Spiders across a bridge past skull walls, a timed tube ride and the Creepatorium in the dark. A card at the end admits it was edited for time.

items.id: masters-of-the-maze-1994-jesse-tyrell-vs.-zana-jaclyn-vs.-jonah-aaron/Masters of the Maze 1994 (Jesse _ Tyrell vs. Zana _ Jaclyn vs. Jonah _ Aaron).mp4
items.title: Masters of the Maze: Jesse, Tyrell, Zana, Jaclyn, Jonah and Aaron
items.description: A found episode of the maze: Jesse and Tyrell, Zana and Jaclyn, and Jonah and Aaron buzz in on picture questions, beat a video game, then send armored teammates into the maze against the clock.

items.id: masters-of-the-maze-1994-stuart-ricky-vs.-shannon-kelly-vs.-ronald-stephen/Masters of the Maze 1994 (Stuart _ Ricky vs. Shannon _ Kelly vs. Ronald _ Stephen).mp4
items.title: Masters of the Maze: Stuart, Ricky, Shannon, Kelly, Ronald and Stephen
items.description: The uploader says this is the last one they have, a found tape they forgot to post. Stuart and Ricky, Shannon and Kelly, and Ronald and Stephen take on the maze with the host and a robot-suited guide.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: Saskatoon, Saskatchewan
items.description: Saskatoon, where one of the games is milking a pretend cow. The kids' teams play the quiz rounds with the host, and a park challenge runs on tape between them.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: Halifax, Nova Scotia
items.description: The harbour in Halifax for the taped segment, quiz questions and the wheel in the studio, and a slime finish nobody on stage gets to sit out.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: Victoria, British Columbia
items.description: Victoria, B.C., where the park challenge involves painted logs. The kids' teams answer flag questions and trivia and spin the wheel with the host.

items.id: supersloppydoubledare-1987/Super Sloppy Double Dare (1987) - The Schwarzeneggers vs. The Live Wires.mp4
items.title: Super Sloppy Double Dare: The Schwarzeneggers vs. The Live Wires
items.description: The Schwarzeneggers and the Live Wires answer trivia for Marc Summers, then get to the real work: a goop-soaked physical challenge and an obstacle course of helmets, ropes and slime, for scooters and shoes. No commercials.

items.id: wild-and-crazy-kids-water-park/Wild and Crazy Kids - Water Park.ia.mp4
items.title: Wild & Crazy Kids: Water Park
items.description: Relay racing down water slides, up a rope net and across floating pads, scored in points, with instant replays of the best splashes. Wild & Crazy Kids ran its stunts like a sports broadcast.

items.title: Video Power: WrestleMania Week (Monday)
items.description: The ring becomes a console: two kids go head to head on a WrestleMania game while the host and the crowd roar them on, then the winners get a toy store to tear through.

items.title: Video Power: The First Semi-Final
items.description: Semi-finals call for Paperboy, the bike-and-newspaper arcade game, as one round against a countdown clock, then a physical challenge in padded vests and helmets. An ad break rides along on the tape.

items.title: Gladiators 2000: Billy and Stephanie vs. Mason and Leandra
items.description: Gladiators for kids: teen teams take on the obstacle course and the big padded opponents, and two pairs go in with one trophy to chase. Cheap, loud, and the lights never come down.

items.title: Gladiators 2000: Anthony and Chante vs. James and Tanya
items.description: Know your food groups as well as your wall: Anthony and Chante, James and Tanya, red against blue, run slide and obstacle games against the Gladiators, with a nutrition quiz between rounds.

items.title: Gladiators 2000: Kyle and Liana vs. Charlie and Joeann
items.description: Two teams of kids walk into an arena built for grown-up gladiators and try the events anyway. Padded sticks, big lights, and a studio crowd that has already decided whom to love.

items.title: BrainSurge
items.description: Six kids, one set, and a lesson in how much you can't remember: Kenny, Hyla, David, Tyler and Ally take on the memory and trivia rounds, then two finalists race the lit floor-tile game against the clock.

items.title: BrainSurge
items.description: Try holding the numbered board in your head before Ally, Jennifer, Chase, Pat and Ruby do. Memory turns into a spectator sport here, ending on the lit floor-tile game for two finalists.

items.id: gtp-jess-and-jack-vs-hagan-and-jeff/GTP Jess and Jack VS Hagan and Jeff.mp4
items.title: Get the Picture: Jess and Jack vs. Hagan and Jeff
items.description: A set built like a circuit board, an orange team (Jess and Jack) against a yellow one (Hagan and Jeff), questions that uncover hidden pictures, and a giant keypad where the leaders match cartoon characters.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: Drumheller, Alberta
items.description: A trip out to the hoodoos near Drumheller, the badlands' stone pillars, for the taped segment. In the studio the teams play quiz rounds and the wheel, and it ends slimy.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: St. Denis, Saskatchewan
items.description: The Speed Round, more trivia with the host, and a farm challenge in St. Denis, Saskatchewan. The slime turns up at the end, as it always does.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: Saskatoon, Saskatchewan
items.description: Saskatoon brings a cow-costume skit and a park game played on space hoppers. The kids' teams answer questions and spin the wheel for points with the host.

items.title: Splatalot!: The Finger Dance
items.description: Six teen attackers cross the moat, escape the stockade and go for the crown while Knightriss and the other defenders do their worst. Two hosts commentate every splat, and only one gets crowned.

items.title: Splatalot!: Revenge of the Nerds
items.description: The hosts of this medieval splat-fest end the show dressed for Revenge of the Nerds, which tells you the castle is in on its own joke. Teens work the moat, stockade and crown rounds with defenders in the way.

items.id: video-arcade-top-10/Video & Arcade Top 10/Season 04/Video & Arcade Top 10 S04E01.ia.mp4
items.title: Video & Arcade Top 10
items.description: This Toronto-made YTV game show is a time capsule: a Medieval Times tournament as the prize for home players, an NSYNC postcard quiz, and Excitebike 64 turbo tips, plus a studio challenge with kids.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: Victoria, British Columbia
items.description: A street segment around Victoria, B.C., between the studio rounds. The kids' teams take the quiz and spin the wheel with the host, and the finale does not go quietly.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: Halifax, Nova Scotia
items.description: The Slime Tour hits the beach in Halifax, Nova Scotia. In the studio the kids' teams play trivia and the wheel with the host before a messy finale.

items.title: Uh-Oh!: St. Denis, Saskatchewan
items.description: Out on the prairie at St. Denis, a clown runs a hay-bale game. In the studio, the teams answer questions and spin the Speed Round wheel with the host.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Evolution
items.description: Wesley's science project gets loose, and the Enterprise learns what happens when you let a teenager run the lab. Third season, and the ship already has bugs.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Ensigns of Command
items.description: Data has to talk stubborn humans out of a planet, and he does it by the book. Meanwhile the Enterprise argues with a species that has never once been flexible.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Survivors
items.description: A whole colony is gone, and one house stands untouched with two calm people inside. The mystery gets stranger the more politely they answer.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Way of the Warrior
items.description: A Klingon fleet shows up at the station, Worf walks in and the show quietly changes shape. It's the franchise machine at its most deliberate, and it works.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Visitor
items.description: An old Jake tells a young writer what he gave up for his father. Many fans call it the best hour Trek ever made, and nobody on the channel wants to argue.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Hippocratic Oath
items.description: Bashir and O'Brien are held by soldiers who need a doctor and won't take no. Bashir's oath gets tested, and O'Brien does his job and a bit of friendship.

items.id: star-trek-deep-space-nine-best-buy-exclusive-bonus-extras/DS9.s1 - The Deep Space Nine Scrapbook 13.58 480i-dvd AC3-2ch subs.mp4
items.title: Deep Space Nine: Best Buy Bonus Extras
items.description: Fourteen minutes of retail-exclusive featurettes that existed to make you buy your DS9 discs at one specific store. The promotion ended; the extras escaped. The archive keeps its receipts.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Scorpion Part 2
items.description: Janeway shakes hands with the Borg to beat something worse. The ship gets a new look, a new crew member and a ratings bump, which the franchise machine did not hide.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Gift
items.description: Seven of Nine is cut loose from the Collective, and Kes has her own parting to attend to. A farewell and an arrival in the same hour.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Day of Honor
items.description: B'Elanna picks a Klingon holiday to be miserable on, and gets stuck in space with Tom Paris. It's a love story that's half engineering manual.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Who Watches the Watchers
items.description: A hidden Federation observation post gets exposed, and a village decides Picard must be a god. He spends the hour insisting he is not. Fans quote it anyway.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Bonding
items.description: A boy loses his mother on an away mission, and Worf, of all people, is the one who has to sit with him. The franchise rarely gets quieter than this.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Booby Trap
items.description: Geordi builds the perfect engineer on the holodeck to help him out of a trap, and then has feelings about it. The ship is in peril, but the hologram gets the spotlight.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager — "Time and Again"
items.description: Janeway and Paris get knocked one day into a doomed planet's past and have to decide whether warning anyone would make it worse. Season one Voyager, already playing fast and loose with causality.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Indiscretion
items.description: Kira and Dukat set off to find a lost ship and spend most of the trip not liking each other. A road movie where the company is the hazard.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Starship Down
items.description: The Defiant is sinking into a gas giant with the enemy circling above. It's a submarine movie, and the crew plays it perfectly straight.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Little Green Men
items.description: Quark, Rom and Nog crash in Roswell, New Mexico, a little too early in history, and the Air Force assumes the worst. Quark sees a whole planet of new customers.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Nemesis
items.description: Chakotay crashes on a planet in the middle of someone else's war and picks a side. The jungle is a soundstage, and the show knows it.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Revulsion
items.description: A lone hologram calls for help, and the Doctor and B'Elanna answer it. Holograms meeting holograms, with an edge.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Raven
items.description: Seven starts to remember a life before the Borg, and it isn't a happy one. Her memories go back further than anyone on board knew.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Enemy
items.description: A storm-lashed rock, a wounded Romulan and a man who will not give him blood. Worf's stand here is the part people still argue about.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Price
items.description: A wormhole goes up for auction and a very charming man works the room. Troi finds out that charm and honesty are separate departments.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Vengeance Factor
items.description: Two clans, a feud nobody can end, and a servant who seems to know too much about it. Riker is the diplomat, and the evening is hard on him.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager — "Caretaker" (Feature-Length)
items.description: The full two-part pilot in one sitting: a Starfleet crew, a Maquis crew, one ship, and a 75-year commute home. The whole seven-season premise, set up in ninety minutes.

items.title: William Shatner: Star Trek Memories ('95)
items.description: Shatner walks through the making of the original series, home-video style, with help from his old crewmates. He wrote the book; naturally he also had to host the tape.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Sword of Kahless
items.description: Worf and Kor go hunting for a sacred sword, and Dax keeps them honest. The relic is easy to find. The two old Klingons are harder to manage.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Our Man Bashir
items.description: Bashir plays a 60s super-spy in the holosuite, and the whole station gets dragged into the plot. Garak is a villain with the best tailoring on the channel.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Homefront
items.description: Sisko goes home to Earth to hunt for shapeshifters, and finds his father's kitchen is the safest place in the Federation. Security gets tighter. Trust gets thinner.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Scientific Method
items.description: Something unseen is studying the crew, and the crew only learns by getting sick. Sickbay has never looked so crowded.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Year of Hell Part 1
items.description: A Krenim commander rewrites history with a ship, and Voyager takes the hit. The hardest the show ever gets on its own hull.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Year of Hell Part 2
items.description: The year grinds on, and Janeway keeps her ship together with what is left of it. Fans still want a whole season of this version.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Defector
items.description: Data and Picard are rehearsing Shakespeare when a Romulan walks in with a story. It's a spy tale where everyone is honest and no one is believed.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Hunted
items.description: The Enterprise carries a prisoner off a planet that very much wants him back. It turns out the prison was never the biggest problem.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The High Ground
items.description: Dr. Crusher is taken by terrorists who have a case to make. Picard has to weigh whether to listen, and the show lets the question stay uncomfortable.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Paradise Lost
items.description: A Starfleet admiral has a plan to protect Earth and the cost is Earth itself. The Defiant ends up across from other Starfleet ships, and nobody enjoys it.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Crossfire
items.description: Odo guards Bajor's First Minister Shakaar against assassins, while watching Kira fall for the man he has to protect.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Return to Grace
items.description: Kira gets her own ship and her old enemy as co-pilot. The tension on that bridge is better than any space battle.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Sons of Mogh
items.description: Worf's brother turns up in disgrace and asks for something Worf can't give. Family, honor and a Klingon crisis, with plenty of both left on the table.

items.id: star-trek-tng-the-measure-of-a-man-extended/Star Trek TNG - 2x09 The Measure of a Man (Extended)/Star Trek TNG - 2x09 - The Measure of a Man (Extended).mp4
items.title: TNG: "The Measure of a Man" (Extended Cut)
items.description: Starfleet convenes a hearing to decide whether Data is a person or a toaster, and television quietly produces one of its great courtroom hours. This is the longer cut, rebuilt years later from a writer's VHS workprint.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Random Thoughts
items.description: On a world with no violence, a stray thought is a crime. Torres is at the center of it, and the local police are polite about it.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Concerning Flight
items.description: Thieves take Voyager's computer core and the Leonardo da Vinci hologram with it, and Janeway goes after both. The holodeck gets a gentle, nerdy break.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Mortal Coil
items.description: Neelix loses something no cook should have to lose, and Naomi Wildman is the one who stays by him. Ethan Phillips gets the heavy hour.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Deja Q
items.description: Q shows up with no powers and no plan, begging the people he spent years pestering. It's funny until it's suddenly not.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: A Matter of Perspective
items.description: One death, three accounts, and a holodeck that replays each one as the witness remembers it. Everybody is telling the truth, which is the trouble.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Yesterday’s Enterprise
items.description: A rip in space drops in an old Enterprise, and the timeline turns to a ship at war. Tasha Yar is back, and the episode earns it.

items.title: Star Trek Night on BBC2 ('96)
items.description: A whole British evening given over to the franchise: a quiz, a science documentary, cast interviews. A kid taped it, and the tape still tears at the top.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Bar Association
items.description: Rom organizes a union at Quark's bar, which is the most dangerous thing a Ferengi can do. Everyone gets a lesson in labor, and Quark gets a headache.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Accession
items.description: A man claims to be the real Emissary and Sisko has to wonder whether he's the wrong one. The station's faith gets a stress test.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Rules of Engagement
items.description: Worf is on trial at the station, facing a Klingon lawyer who knows how to make a hearing hurt. Courtroom drama with a very short fuse.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Waking Moments
items.description: The crew starts sharing a dream, and the dream has teeth. Chakotay gets to be the one who understands it.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Message in a Bottle
items.description: Voyager finally reaches a Starfleet ship, and the Doctor goes aboard. He gets to be the newest model in a room of smarter machines.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Hunters
items.description: The Hirogen are coming, and they treat the ship as a game. The crew also gets a letter from home, which does its own damage.

items.title: TNG: "Encounter at Farpoint"
items.description: The Next Generation premiere: a new Enterprise, a bald captain everyone doubted, and an omnipotent pest named Q putting humanity on trial in the very first hour. The verdict took seven seasons.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Offspring
items.description: Data builds himself a daughter and teaches her to be a person. Then Starfleet shows up to ask whether she is allowed to be one.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Sins of the Father
items.description: Worf goes home to answer for his father, and the Klingon council turns out to be a courtroom with knives. This is where the franchise started building a Klingon empire.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Allegiance
items.description: Picard wakes in a cell with strangers while a copy of him runs the ship. A bottle episode that makes the captain's chair look good.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Hard Time
items.description: O'Brien gets home from twenty years of prison that lasted a few hours, and nobody knows how to help. The show spends the hour on the aftermath, not the crime.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Shattered Mirror
items.description: The Mirror Universe comes back and Jake is stuck in it. Everything is darker and sharper, and the Intendant is thrilled to see the old crew again.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: For the Cause
items.description: Sisko's personal life and the Maquis border war collide on the station. Someone you like turns out to be hiding something.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Prey
items.description: A wounded hunter limps aboard, and Janeway has to decide what the rules are for an enemy. Seven has an opinion. So does the Prime Directive.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Retrospect
items.description: Seven says a weapons trader attacked her, and the Doctor helps her remember it. Janeway has to ask whether sure is the same as right.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Killing Game Part 1
items.description: The crew wakes up in an occupied European town, in costume, not entirely themselves. The cliffhanger is a holodeck nobody can turn off.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Tin Man
items.description: A telepath who can't stand human minds comes aboard to meet a living ship out in the dark. Data is the only one who's quiet enough to talk to either.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Hollow Pursuits
items.description: The shy engineer everyone avoids has built a better crew in the holodeck. Fans gave Barclay a lot of grace, and so does the episode.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Most Toys
items.description: Data is kidnapped by a collector who thinks he's the finest thing in the case. Data takes it very politely, up to a point.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: To the Death
items.description: Starfleet teams up with the Jem'Hadar, the one group it would never invite to dinner. The mission is a peace of sorts, and the soldiers keep a ritual of their own.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Quickening
items.description: Bashir lands on a planet where every child is born into a plague. He can't cure it, and he can't stop trying. One of the show's bleakest hours.

items.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Broken Link
items.description: Odo falls sick and the Founders call him home to answer for what he did. The finale turns the whole season toward what's coming.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Killing Game Part 2
items.description: Janeway and the crew take the war back to the Hirogen, in uniforms from the wrong century. Fans still quote the costumes.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Vis a Vis
items.description: A friendly stranger borrows Tom Paris, and what he leaves behind is a puzzle. Voyager does a body-swap and plays it as a thriller.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Omega Directive
items.description: Janeway has an order she can't tell anyone about, and Seven is the one who sees it. A rare moment where the captain looks scared.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Sarek
items.description: A legendary Vulcan ambassador arrives, and the calm of the ship starts to fray around him. Mark Lenard does the quiet work that makes the whole thing land.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Menage a Troi
items.description: Lwaxana Troi barges aboard, a Ferengi kidnaps her, and the rescue falls to Picard reciting love poetry. The franchise machine has its off nights, and this one has charm.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: Transfigurations
items.description: Dr. Crusher nurses a patient who changes in ways that no scan explains, with pursuers close behind. A small mystery with a big heart.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Unforgettable
items.description: A woman remembers Chakotay, and he doesn't remember her. A romance with a catch the show lets you feel before it tells you.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Living Witness
items.description: The Doctor wakes up in a museum centuries on, where the locals have the story of Voyager wrong. He has to correct the record, which is also the best trick this channel knows.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Demon
items.description: Fuel is low, and the planet below is the kind that eats ships. The crew has a bad idea and a worse one.

items.title: The Definitive 90s Trek Broadcast Collection
items.description: The same 90s-Trek broadcast collection in a friendlier container. When you believe in a playlist hard enough, you upload it in every format.

items.title: Star Trek: Dagger of the Mind + The Galileo Seven ('89)
items.description: Two classic Kirk-era hours with the local commercials left in, which is half the fun. Spock invents the mind meld in one and gets handed a shuttlecraft full of people who won't listen in the other.

items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation: The Best of Both Worlds Part 1
items.description: The Borg are coming, and Picard is the one they want. Fans waited a whole summer for the next half, and the tape makes sure you wait as long.

items.id: essental-guide-to-star-trek-first-contact-converted/essental guide to star trek first contact converted.mp4
items.title: The Essential Guide to Star Trek: First Contact
items.description: A making-of documentary for First Contact, copied off VHS — the Borg, the new Enterprise, the promotional machinery of 1996 in full hum. Every Trek film shipped with one of these, and the tapes outlived the hype.

items.title: Star Trek: "The Cage"
items.description: The original pilot: Captain Pike, a cerebral crew, and a network that decided audiences weren't ready. NBC ordered a second pilot instead of a series — the rarest decision in television, and the one that saved the whole franchise.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: One
items.description: Seven spends a long stretch with the ship nearly empty, and the ship doesn't like it. A showcase for Jeri Ryan, and for the dark.

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Hope and Fear
items.description: A new friend offers Voyager a way home, and Seven isn't sure he can be trusted. The season ends on a promise and a very big trap.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 01 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: Day of Flames
items.description: The opener has an Uncle Sam poster pointing at you, three young recruits and a hangar of red-and-white mecha. Dragonar spends its first half hour getting people into the seats, with some swagger.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 02 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: Death Match in the Ruins
items.description: A pilot with a Band-Aid on his forehead gets a fist in the face, ties on a headband, and goes out to fight among the ruins. In anime, the headband is where the speeches stop.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 03 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: The Blue Hawk of Giganos
items.description: Before anyone fights the enemy, the crew shoves each other in a corridor. Then a blue-helmeted rival from the other side shows up in space, which is probably why the shoving stops.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 04 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: The Men's Battlefield
items.description: The pilots get red flight suits and a first real sortie, and one of them carries a toy clown into the cockpit. Give it a minute and the clown is the thing you remember.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 05 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: The Sworn Sortie
items.description: Civilians bed down on the cafeteria benches, pilots haul supply boxes past them, and a grey-haired officer reads over his papers. The sortie is sworn on a ship with no spare room.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: Zeon Zakus raid the colony Side 7 while the Federation moves its new mobile suit. Amuro Ray, a civilian boy, finds the Gundam's manual, climbs in and fights back. Char's red Zaku turns up at the end.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: White Base's crew tend a wounded older man in spacesuits while Char keeps watch from the Zeon side. Amuro takes the Gundam out into open space, where there is nothing to hide behind.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: White Base makes for Luna II, the Federation's asteroid base, with children underfoot and Bright and Sayla on the bridge. Amuro meets a red Zaku in the Gundam, and the beam sabers come out.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: White Base is stuck in port with a Zeon ship parked across the way, and the crew agree it has to be destroyed to save the fleet. Amuro takes the Gundam out to try.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: White Base has to drop into Earth's atmosphere with Char's forces pressing the attack. Amuro fights in the Gundam while a countdown runs, and nobody gets to ask for more time.

items.title: Macross: Booby Trap
items.description: Launch day on Macross Island. Stunt pilot Hikaru Ichijo is visiting his old friend Roy Focker when the Zentradi arrive, and he ends up in a Valkyrie while the ship's guns fire on their own.

items.title: Macross: Countdown
items.description: The Zentradi press the attack while Misa and Claudia run the bridge and Hikaru fights from a Valkyrie over ruined streets. A fortress that is also a city has to defend both jobs at once.

items.title: Macross: Space Fold
items.description: Bridge officers and pilots work a crisis in space, while a Valkyrie fights through a wrecked city street and a fleet hangs over a planet. A whole episode of the ship working a problem.

items.title: Macross: Lynn Minmay
items.description: Hikaru and Minmay spend an episode alone in the dark corridors, camping and sharing a meal until they find a crowd again. It is the quietest stretch of a war show, and the pop star gets to be a person.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: Koji's grandfather dies and leaves him a giant robot of a new metal, just as Dr. Hell raises an army of mechanical beasts. Koji takes the controls and the robot stands up for the first time. Start here.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: Dr. Hell's skull-chested beast goes after the lab while a dark robot turns up carrying the orange one, and Koji's crew has to hold the line. Hell ends on a monitor, promising to take the Photon lab.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: It opens on a motorcycle chase through the mountains, a big rider against a young racer, before the lab starts worrying about a missing pilot. Dr. Hell's agents plot in the background.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: Dr. Hell sends a big grey horned beast, the lab decides the orange robot needs weapons, and Koji races off on his bike. The fight goes up into the sky, and the friends end the day together at sunset.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: Dr. Hell and Baron Ashura plot from their island, and a torpedo sends the heroes racing to meet it. A red robot is destroyed in a flash. The cast ends at sunset, with Hell not done with them.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 06 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: A Warrior's Trial
items.description: Three recruits in red flight suits spend this one on foot, running corridors with rifles, until a scrap in zero gravity sends cans drifting everywhere. The robots stay parked.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 07 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: Farewell, Chekhov
items.description: A pilot asleep, a long breakfast with the whole crew, and then blue-armored mecha on the attack. The calm comes first, which is the usual warning.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 08 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: Operation Prisoner Rescue, Part One
items.description: Part one of two. Pilots strap into a transport, soldiers stand in rows, and a blonde woman and a man look out at a mountain view. Nobody has been rescued yet; that's part two's job.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 09 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: Operation Prisoner Rescue, Part Two
items.description: Part two of the rescue splits in two: prisoners wearing number tags, one of them taking up a revolver, and a beam-saber fight in space. The cutting between them keeps the pace.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 10 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: A Body-Slam Defense
items.description: The title promises a body slam; first come the feelings. Someone cries on a crewmate's shoulder, a big man in a pink tank top holds forth, and a purple-armored pilot watches from his cockpit.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: First stretch on Earth. The crew plan to follow a mountain range for cover from Zeon aircraft, but tanks and a Zaku close in anyway, and Amuro takes the Gundam out into the desert.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: White Base skims low over Earth carrying refugees, and an argument on the bridge gets tense. Then Garma's aircraft attack, with Char watching from his red Zaku. Some people prefer to watch a fight.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: White Base carries civilians now, so every Zeon pursuit across rough country counts for more. The night ends on dark hilltops, Amuro in the Gundam and a red Zaku taking each other's measure.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: Earth looks like wreckage in this one. White Base picks its way through a ruined district while Zeon closes in, and Amuro and the others go out against them in the Gundam.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: A Zeon officer works a formal dinner and a young woman's attention while his forces hunt the Trojan Horse. The war gets fought over the canapes first. Then the Gundam fights and a city is hit.

items.title: Macross: Transformation
items.description: The ship-city is counting its rations while the main cannon counts down toward a fight. Minmay turns up somewhere between the two, which is about how this show balances its books.

items.title: Macross: Daedalus Attack
items.description: A day of shopping, then a warship and a fighter get ready, and the fight moves into an asteroid field. A normal day for a city of civilians riding inside a battleship.

items.id: sdf-macross-episode-8-longest-birthday-adv-dub_202108/SDF Macross Episode 7  Bye Bye Mars   (ADV Dub).ia.mp4
items.title: Macross: Bye Bye Mars
items.description: The Macross stops at the abandoned Sara Base on Mars for supplies, and Misa goes in alone. Outside, the Zentradi have set a trap around the ship, and Destroids and Valkyries fight on the red ground.

items.title: Macross: Longest Birthday
items.description: Minmay's birthday, on the street of her family's Chinese restaurant in the ship-city, while enemy robot units close in. It ends on a photo album, a gentler close than the fighting suggests.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: Dr. Hell's side readies a fresh attack, the lab scrambles jets, and the robot and the orange one head out to fight a big armoured beast. It ends with the robot cradling something very small in one hand.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: Ozones B3, a mechanical beast, tears through a city while a white-haired woman working for Dr. Hell lays a trap. Boss and the kids get caught in it, and then the robot takes on the beast.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: Boss and a friend take a night ride straight into Baron Ashura's path, and the demon-god robot Abdra has a secret that makes the scare worth it.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: Dr. Hell sends Deimos F3 after a group of scientists, and Sayaka and the others race to get them back. Rescue first, robot fight second, which is the right order.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: A giant iron arm flies loose over the city, and Boss and the heroes chase it down. The robot faces it, and the day ends with Koji's robot carrying the fallen orange one home to the lab.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 11 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: The Longed-For Land
items.description: Dragonar pilots chase a fight down from orbit into a blue planet's clouds, while crews in white suits work along a hull. Real robots, real altitude, and a sharp Blu-ray transfer.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 12 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: Homecomings
items.description: A reunion on a green hillside, a carrier deck with mecha lined up, and a quick fight with a green enemy mecha before the crowd gathers on the rubble. Nobody gets home all at once.

items.id: qts-kikou-senki-dragonar-blu-ray-box-tv-ep-36-bd-h-264-960x-720-aac/[QTS] Kikou Senki Dragonar Blu-ray Box TV ep 13 (BD H264 960x720 AAC).mp4
items.title: Metal Armor Dragonar: The Mass Driver Launch Order
items.description: The launch order is mostly brass and paperwork: a saluted arrival, a council round a big table, an old general in gold epaulettes. Then the crew drives out and has dinner in some ruins at sunset.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: Char and Zeon circle White Base, and a young woman produces a pistol at a very tense moment. Amuro keeps fighting in the Gundam as the battle climbs into the clouds.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: Zeon holds a rally under a portrait the size of a building while its ships hunt the Trojan Horse with jamming and attacks. Amuro and a red Zaku settle it with a night duel on the hilltops.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam
items.description: White Base passes near Amuro's home town, and he finds his mother in a refugee camp. Zeon soldiers turn up, and he has to fight with her watching. The war is usually about his robot; this one is about her.

items.title: Macross II: Lovers Again
items.description: Decades after the first war, a reporter and an enemy singer end up in the same story. The franchise keeps this sequel at arm's length, so a Manga Entertainment VHS is a fine way in.

items.title: Patlabor: The Movie
items.description: Mamoru Oshii turns a giant-robot cop show into a slow, rainy procedural about a bug in the operating system. Section 2 does the legwork, and the legwork is the suspense.

items.title: Macross: Do You Remember Love?
items.description: Macross retold as a feature: a love triangle, an alien war, and a pop singer whose songs matter to the plot. Real robots, big hair, and a title that asks you a question.

items.title: Macross: Miss Macross
items.description: A beauty pageant goes ahead in the ship-city while an enemy force closes in. The episode cuts between the stage, a press panel and the fighters, and the contest has to share the sky with the war.

items.title: Macross: Blind Game
items.description: The Zentradi officers decide to try a rougher approach, and the bridge crew and the pilots spend the rest of the half hour finding out what that means.

items.title: Macross: First Contact
items.description: The original Macross, and not Robotech, as the uploader insists. Valkyries launch, alien officers argue at a round table, and a singer takes the stage. We side with the uploader.

items.title: Macross: Big Escape
items.description: Hikaru and Misa, in matching white flight suits, try to walk across an enemy ship through its corridors and past its soldiers. The two who bicker most on the Macross get the longest walk together.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: Baron Ashura schemes from a cliff while the heroes gather at the Photon Power Lab. Koji's robot and Sayaka's Aphrodite A head out to fight, because that is what the lab is for.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: The full Japanese opening song plays first, then Dr. Hell and the Baron send a robot to burn a city. It ends quietly: a bandaged boy, the girl and a pilot at a grave cross at sunset.

items.title: Mazinger Z
items.description: The town's snowman contest is Dr. Hell's cover: a mechanical beast is buried in the snow. Koji, Boss and the robot meet a spiked red ball in the mountains, and the day ends under Fuji. Check under the snowman.

items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: The Black Gundam
items.description: The premiere: Kamille is arrested at a colony spaceport after a scuffle, which is one way to start your own series. The Titans show off their black Gundam Mk-II, and it ends on a chase.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 02 - Departure (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: Departure
items.description: A newly assigned pilot is sent into battle without a single simulator run, mobile suits and warships tangled up in and around a colony. Orientation, Zeta style: sink or float.

items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: Inside the Capsule
items.description: A handwritten letter passes between officers arguing whether a ship can survive mobile suits at all, while one pilot sweats and weeps alone in a cockpit. The waiting episode, and it knows how to wait.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 04 - Emma's Decision (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: Emma's Decision
items.description: Warships and mobile suits clash in space, and a pilot is asked if he's ready for a machine its designer built to work an unusual way. Nobody asks whether the machine is ready for him.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 05 - Father and Son (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: Father and Son
items.description: A commander gets one more chance to redeem his honor and presses the chase through space, suits launching off his ships. A hurt young man struggles in a bed at the close. Honor is expensive.

items.id: 02.-patlabor-2-the-movie-1993/Mobile Police Patlabor - 02 (BDRip 1440x1080p x265 HEVC FLACx2, AAC 2.0x3)(Dual Audio)[sxales](v2).mp4
items.title: Mobile Police Patlabor: Longshot
items.description: Section 2 gets a briefing, a news report and a lot of waiting around in vans. A giant-robot show that spends a good stretch acting like a police procedural, and trusts you to stay.

items.title: Mobile Police Patlabor: The 450-Million-Year-Old Trap
items.description: A man in an eyepatch turns up at the Section 2 mountain camp and ends up with a mug in his hand. Patlabor in a tent, where the trap takes its time.

items.id: 02.-patlabor-2-the-movie-1993/Mobile Police Patlabor - 04 (BDRip 1440x1080p x265 HEVC FLACx2 2.0x2)(Dual Audio)[sxales](v2).mp4
items.title: Mobile Police Patlabor: The Tragedy of L
items.description: Section 2 is out of the city and out of its depth. A stubborn old man, a crate of bottles, and by night a story about recruits from long ago. A quiet one, for a show with giant robots.

items.title: Macross: Blue Wind
items.description: The Macross comes down in the ocean with the Zentradi fleet watching from orbit. Global and his officers work out what comes next, the city inside goes on living, and Hikaru gets open air on the deck.

items.title: Macross: Global's Report
items.description: The uploader's note says NOT ROBOTECH, and the title agrees: Global is the Macross captain, the man Robotech renamed Gloval. The original names, on a tape that cares about the difference.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E01 Brothers of the Universe.1080.mp4

items.description: Koji and Daisuke, and a promise to get to the bottom of someone's true identity. A Let's Be Friends With Aliens Society turns up, which is rich with Duke Fleed on the ranch. Vega is closing in on the same answer.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E02 Prince of the Other World.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: Ah! My Land That Was So Green
items.description: A flying instruction goes sideways when 'throttle' is heard as 'sit down', and the subtitles stop to explain the pun. Then the truth about Daisuke's war machine comes out. Vega, as ever, will never give up.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E03 The Tragic Fiesta.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: Crisis Approaches Makiba Ranch
items.description: Makiba Ranch throws a party, with bunting and a toast, and Koji can't shake a nightmare he had on the happy day. Out in space, something crosses point X23. The omen showed up early.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E04 The Island of Fear.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: Young Blood Burning Crimson
items.description: Saucers swarm a quiet green pasture, and a loud man wants one to land at his place. The Vega machine that does arrive has a spiked wheel for a body and gives Grendizer real trouble.

items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: Flames of Love Dyed in the Sunset
items.description: Koji takes a plane up into a sky full of flying saucers, with Vega calling its own plans flawless. Then word comes that Grendizer is closing on the airfield. Flawless is a big word.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 06 - To Earth (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: To Earth
items.description: The crew compare notes on getting used to life in space while a pilot holds off pursuers before a launch. Then a quiet night at a house with a pool, and the mobile suits come looking anyway.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 07 - Escape from Side One (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: Escape from Side One
items.description: In a ruined colony, a pilot in a pink suit holds a pilot in white at gunpoint, while red Rick Dias suits fight their way out into space. Two escapes at once, and one is at gunpoint.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 08 - The Dark Side of the Moon (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: The Dark Side of the Moon
items.description: The moon city has a mobile suit deck and a Rolls-Royce showroom, and Quattro, sunglasses on, visits both like it's normal. Later the group passes a metal mountain said to be a colony's ruins.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 09 - A New Bond (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: A New Bond
items.description: Kamille, cheek bandaged, and a woman in a safari hat get chased through a jungle while a gold mobile suit and a space battle go on elsewhere. It ends at a glowing hidden doorway.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 10 - Reunion (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: Reunion
items.description: Mobile suits fight in space and over the lunar surface, a pilot talks about losing memories only weeks old, and a plan forms to lure an enemy gun away from its support. It closes quietly.

items.id: 02.-patlabor-2-the-movie-1993/Mobile Police Patlabor - 05 (BDRip 1440x1080p x265 HEVC FLACx2 2.0x2)(Dual Audio)[sxales](v2).mp4
items.title: Mobile Police Patlabor: The SV2's Longest Day, Part 1
items.description: A young man on a payphone, men in dark glasses with binoculars, a car running without its lights. Part one of Section 2's longest day is a stakeout, and the robots wait their turn.

items.id: 02.-patlabor-2-the-movie-1993/Mobile Police Patlabor - 06 (BDRip 1440x1080p x265 HEVC FLACx2 2.0x2)(Dual Audio)[sxales](v2).mp4
items.title: Mobile Police Patlabor: The SV2's Longest Day, Part 2

items.title: Mobile Police Patlabor: Go North, SV2!

items.title: Getter Robo: Invincible! Getter Robo Launches
items.description: Professor Saotome needs three people to fly one robot, and one recruit protests that he can't even ride a bicycle. Mechasaur Saki is out there anyway, so the team's first sortie comes fast.

items.title: Getter Robo: Showdown! The Three Great Mechasaurs
items.description: Getter-2 changes in, and the fight ends up underwater, where somebody warns Ryo the pressure will kill them. Three Mechasaurs on the bill, and the deep end is the hard part.

items.title: Getter Robo: The Dinosaur Empire's Rainbow Operation
items.description: A segmented Mechasaur is sent at Tokyo, and one pilot is told Getter-3 means no more dizzy flying. A pipe-shaped worm and a drill in one episode is a decent day for a mecha fan.

items.title: Getter Robo: The Southern Cross of Burning Blood
items.description: An island holds a bonfire ritual, and a sea dragon wrecks a boat in the surf. The Getter team goes to find out what the Dinosaur Empire wants there, and Getter Drill gets its moment.

items.title: Getter Robo: Pierce the Darkness, Getter Team
items.description: The Dinosaur Empire says Giga is the perfect counter to Getter-2. The Getter team's own teamwork is a mess, orders ignored, and Professor Saotome says so in the debriefing.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E06 Attack on Perlepolis.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: Fighting Spirit Kills the Sky
items.description: Vega's Bracki is ordered to hurt the hostages so Grendizer will come, and a red-legged walking saucer does the pushing. Everyone keeps asking where Daisuke went, which is a fair question.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E07 The Feast of the Wolves.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: Even If It Costs My Life!
items.description: A Vega commander is out of excuses: destroy Duke Fleed this time or lose his position. Elsewhere someone told to withdraw says the time for that has passed, and goes on at any cost. Two oaths, one sky.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E08 The Radars are Off.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: The Warm, Green Earth
items.description: Someone ends up in a sickbed just as Vega seeds the sky with space mines, and a pilot is told again and again to return now. Autumn trees, a red barn, terrible timing.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E09 The Black Moon Camp.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: Beyond Unforgiven Anger
items.description: Minao is sent from Planet Ruby with a terrible order, then ends up at a ranch dinner where she is asked to join the dancing. Quieter and sadder than the title promises.

items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: Longing Beyond the Stars
items.description: A boy in red overalls plays a harmonica on a hay wagon, and the cows have opinions. Cliffs, a river, a hospital bed, a robot who arrives late. A quiet one, a long way from the Vega Star Empire.

items.title: Force Five: Starvengers
items.description: Three jets, three pilots, and a merge that decides what shape the robot takes for the fight. Getter Robo G boiled down to one feature for American TV. The rip is rough, but the merge still lands.

items.title: Force Five: Grandizer
items.description: Go Nagai's Grendizer squeezed into one American feature. The hero is a prince with a ruined homeworld, so the giant robot is the one part of his life that's in good shape.

items.title: Force Five: Gaiking
items.description: A seventies Toei super robot squeezed into one feature for American syndication. The planet is in danger and the movie has no time to explain why. Neither do we. Strap in.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 11 - Entering the Atmosphere (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: Entering the Atmosphere
items.description: Crews ready their ships for the descent to Earth, a captain orders a lieutenant to return, and a spacecraft burns through re-entry. Gravity, the one enemy no mobile suit can shoot.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 12 - The Winds of Jaburo (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: The Winds of Jaburo
items.description: Capsules float down through clear blue sky and soldiers slip into a jungle base as mobile suits close in. A pilot is told someone was seen, a huge blast follows, and the night ends in a park.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 13 - Shuttle Launch (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: Shuttle Launch
items.description: A shuttle sits on an Earth runway while the Mk-II fights in the sky above it, and Quattro and the crew end up aboard. Getting off a planet is harder than getting onto one.

items.id: ms-zeta-gundam-ep.-49-casualties-of-war-720p-dual-audio/MS ZETA Gundam - Ep. 14 - Amuro Files Again (720p DUAL Audio).mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: Amuro Flies Again
items.description: The title promises Amuro Ray flying again, and Quattro Bajeena turns up in the same episode. Anyone who knows Quattro's other name knows why that matters.

items.title: Gundam Wing: The Shooting Star She Saw
items.description: On a show that opened with Operation Meteor, a shooting star is a launch, not a wish. The title leaves it to you to work out who the she is, and whether she should have looked away.

items.title: Gundam Wing: The Gundam Deathscythe
items.description: Operation Meteor begins: five scientists, five trained boys, five Gundams falling toward Earth, one grudge against OZ. The Deathscythe is on the marquee, and the show is already in no mood to explain itself.

items.title: Gundam Wing: Five Gundams Confirmed
items.description: OZ counts to five. What was a rumor of one Gundam becomes a roster, and the episode is the military finding out how big its problem is. The colonies' plan stops being a secret and starts being a file.

items.title: Gundam Wing: The Victoria Nightmare
items.description: Lucrezia Noin takes a cockpit seat for the worst night of a base's life. The episode's last note is Quatre with a violin, which is a very Gundam Wing way to answer a nightmare.

items.title: Gundam Wing: Relena's Secret
items.description: A secret with Relena's name on it, and the episode is in no hurry: a shuttle, a hospital room, a long limousine ride. For once the talking scenes are the ones carrying the plot.

items.title: Getter Robo: Dinosaurs! Operation Tokyo Hijack
items.description: A Mechasaur on tank treads rolls straight for Tokyo and Command Machine launches. One pilot says he only wants a team effort, which is the show's whole premise said out loud on a hillside.

items.title: Getter Robo: Forgive No Evil, Sound the Charge
items.description: The Getter energy has a thirty-minute clock, and the Professor tells Musashi to hurry and land safely. Musashi calls himself the hero for a bind like this. A schoolmate wanted a man-to-man talk first.

items.title: Getter Robo: Close Call, Getter-2
items.description: A school soccer match with one minute left, then a note summoning someone to a temple, or else. Mechasaur Giro turns up, and Getter-2 has a close call. The ball stays on the pitch.

items.title: Getter Robo: The Glory of Captain Ladra
items.description: Getter-1 ends up in volcanic lava, the Professor hopes the machine won't overheat, and the Dinosaur Empire is told it gets one more chance to finish the Getter. Hot work, even for a robot.

items.title: Getter Robo: Nosedive! Getter-3 Goes In
items.description: Everyone wants to know what Musashi thinks he's doing, and two kids ask if it's really okay. A Mechasaur is waiting, and he says he's going anyway. That is the job.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E11 The Day when the Sun will Stop.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: The Demon in the Black Sun!!
items.description: Vega's plan needs the sun dimmed and Grendizer lured into the moon's true shadow. Earth's side says keep your distance until the sun returns in ten minutes. Under the stars, somebody strums a guitar first.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E12 Blood on Snow.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: The Girl Across the Rainbow Bridge
items.description: The Christmas one: snow, a tree, Santa's sleigh. A girl who can raise pictures with her hands is at the center, and a Vega commander thinks Lady Gandal's idea will finally top Duke Fleed.

items.id: ufo-robot-grendizer-s-01-e-68-the-great-pain.-1080_20260125/UFO Robot Grendizer S01E13 By Iron and by Fire.1080.mp4
items.title: UFO Robot Grendizer: Grendizer Under Fire
items.description: A snowy morning of mochi pounding, a colt promised to be the best horse around, then Vega arrives with annihilation on the agenda. One pilot is not giving up a single step.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Gante, The Giant Dragon
items.description: A pyramid turns in a whirlpool at sea, a research team is captured, and a voice tells the hero the time to awaken has come. Gante the dragon is the monster, but the ocean is the mystery.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Bastodon, The Giant Fossil Beast
items.description: Akira takes a boat, then a motorcycle, then diving gear to reach the golden Raideen statue on the cliffs, while a monster stirs in the rock. Getting to work is its own adventure.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Garda, The Iron Beast
items.description: A boy crosses a rope bridge swearing he'll show everyone how cool he is. Soon Raideen faces a monster that rolls in as a spiked ball, and the children are huddled in a cave.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Giant Maddon Annihilates Tokyo
items.description: Mari has gone to Tokyo, Maddon is on the way, and Akira is told his friend is in danger. The city takes the damage, and the episode lets you watch it happen.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Assault! Biira, The Ultrasonic Beast
items.description: Biira, the insect beast with the ultrasonic scream, gets a storm-purple sky all to itself. Raideen flies in over the sea, and someone on the other side swears they won't retreat.

items.title: Gundam Wing: Party Night
items.description: Gowns and dress uniforms fill a ballroom, a pair of knives gets thrown, and by the end a Gundam is standing in the trees. The war comes to the party, and nobody checked its invitation.

items.title: Gundam Wing: Scenario for Bloodshed
items.description: A council hall full of OZ officers hears the scenario, then the mobile suits start firing in earnest. The episode closes on five Gundams standing in a row, which is the point of the title.

items.title: Gundam Wing: The Treize Assassination
items.description: Treize Khushrenada has a plot against his life and a book to read, and he reads. Elsewhere a Gundam fires across a barren plain and mobile suits skirmish. His sword is never far away.

items.title: Gundam Wing: Portrait of a Ruined Country
items.description: A framed family photograph sits on a table while OZ officers go about their business. Zechs in his mask, a helicopter in fog, mobile suits in the dark: a quieter episode than the title suggests.

items.title: Gundam Wing: Heero, Distracted by Defeat
items.description: Heero takes a beating in battle and shows it, wounded and bleeding. OZ troops and officers plan around the damage, and a Gundam stands in a storm-dark field. Nobody in this war gets a rest.

items.title: Getter Robo: Clash! Drill Versus Drill
items.description: A horned, long-necked Mechasaur stalks the forest, and the Dinosaur Empire is sure it will beat the Getter in the end. Getter-2 brings the drill. So does the other side. A fair fight, drill-wise.

items.title: Getter Robo: Roar! Ulu the Undying
items.description: Getter-2's legs are damaged, and Ryo is asked how anyone controls it now. A Mechasaur with serious teeth keeps coming, so the answer is a backup generator and a Getter Kick.

items.title: Getter Robo: One-Point Battle! Daisetsuzan Oroshi
items.description: Musashi has a judo match on the day the Dinosaur Empire shows up with an underwater base. Ryo and the Professor wonder whether to wait for the match to end. They'd rather have Getter-3.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E01 'Roger The Negotiator'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Roger the Negotiator
items.description: Roger Smith, Paradigm City's negotiator, takes a briefcase job, and Dorothy turns up in a green dress. Big O gets its first call before the day is out.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E02 'Dorothy Dorothy'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Dorothy, Dorothy
items.description: Dorothy goes to an evening affair in a red dress, Roger Smith in black beside her. Police lights outside and a megadeus out back are the rest of the guest list.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E03 'Electric City'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Electric City
items.description: Roger Smith ends up in a wooden farmhouse, drops through a trapdoor, and finds a girl in pink and something huge with a long neck in the dark. Take the trapdoor seriously.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E04 'Underground Terror'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Underground Terror
items.description: Train tunnels, an expo hall with nobody in it, and a megadeus at the end of the line. Roger Smith drives the red car straight at it, as the job tends to require.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E05 'Bring Back My Ghost'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Bring Back My Ghost
items.description: Picket signs, a mansion with a fountain out front, and the military police watching all of it. Roger Smith's case starts at the gate and keeps getting quieter.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Recapture! The Hostages of the Giant Tortasu
items.description: Tortasu, a giant tortoise, is holding the hostages, and Akira is told to stay away. Raideen episodes rarely let a warning count for much, but the rescue is the whole plot.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Crush Skarl, the Replicating Beast!
items.description: Skarl multiplies and Raideen ends up fighting a pile of rocks. A broadcast says the team can only count on Akira's fighting spirit, and a quiet scene about a lost mother outweighs the fight.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Counterstrike! Shiva, the Double-Headed Devil Beast
items.description: A professor from Caledonia University is on a plane in trouble, someone begs for Jacqueline to be saved, and Barao is waking Shiva's fossil. Akira gets the whole list of emergencies at once.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Terror! Manmo's Freezing Operation
items.description: Akira meets a new teacher at school, then faces Sharkin's ice beast Manmo in a blizzard. Sharkin has made up his mind, and the weather has made up its own.

items.title: Brave Raideen: Showdown! The Lover of Jagar, The Fossil Man
items.description: Rei is told to come back to the Jagger Group, someone swears to kill Akira, and a fossil man announces himself plainly. Raideen's villains rarely hide the plan.

items.title: Gundam Wing: The Whereabouts of Happiness
items.description: Market men in fezzes, a Gundam at night, a pistol drawn in a ballroom, and a woman in white alone in a spotlight. Happiness is what's being looked for, which is an odd request in this war.

items.title: Gundam Wing: Bewildered Warriors
items.description: A jungle outpost, a pot of soup on the stove and a forest on fire later. The title is generous to the soldiers, who have clearly not been told what is going on either.

items.title: Gundam Wing: Catherine's Tears
items.description: Zechs, masked, takes the field as OZ's next-generation fighter makes its run, and mobile suits slug it out in the rain. The last minutes go quiet: two people looking out through glass.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Angel Attack
items.description: Shinji gets off the train in a Tokyo-3 on a war footing, to meet a father who sent for him after years of nothing. The welcome is an Angel.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The Beast
items.description: Shinji wakes in a hospital bed after his first fight, then moves in with Misato and her penguin, Pen Pen. Everybody has a plan for the pilot except the pilot.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: A Transfer
items.description: Shinji's first day at a new school, where the class works out who he is over instant messages before the bell. Toji has something to say with his fist, and then the alert sounds.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Hedgehog's Dilemma
items.description: Shinji takes his SDAT player and a train and leaves Misato's with no plan. Out past the city he finds Kensuke camping, who is glad of company and has no questions.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Rei I
items.description: Shinji is sent to deliver Rei's new ID card, and her bare apartment says more than she ever does. Eva-00 is back on the test schedule, with Rei in it.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E06 'A Legacy of Amadeus'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: A Legacy of Amadeus
items.description: Roger Smith is hired over a piano and a man in white, and the case ends in the winter woods with a megadeus. The music matters more than the robot.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E07 'The Call from The Past'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: The Call from the Past
items.description: A call from the past gets Roger Smith out of the black suit and into a brown jacket. A blonde woman rides along, and the fog hangs over everything.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E08 'Missing Cat'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Missing Cat
items.description: Roger Smith takes a small job, a lost pet, and Dorothy comes along for the search. The trail ends somewhere with far more teeth than any pet should have. Paradigm City does this to small jobs.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E09 'Beck Comes Back'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Beck Comes Back
items.description: A mansion, a portrait over the fireplace, candles burning, and Beck back in his yellow suit. Roger Smith is the one who has to answer the door.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E10 'Winter Night Phantom'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Winter Night Phantom
items.description: A snowy pier at night, a woman in white who may or may not be there, and a trench-coated man who can't leave it alone. The amusement park lights are the only warm thing in it.

items.title: Brave Raideen: The Insurrection of Gildeen, The Assassin
items.description: The order is to raise Gildeen and stir up humanity's hatred, so the episode opens on floods and stranded men. Akira has to be a rescuer before he gets to be a robot pilot.

items.title: Brave Raideen: The Strike of Algandos, The Fireball Beast
items.description: Jinguuji and Mr. Sarumaru are captured, so a boy is left alone at the controls, crying into a microphone. Algandos the fireball beast brings the lava, and the boy carries the episode.

items.title: Brave Raideen: The Love of Shuraga, The Beautiful Changeling
items.description: A witch burned at the stake, a woman in a photograph and a monster with a mane of gold hair: the Shuraga episode is Raideen's turn to the gothic. Akira has a lot to look at.

items.id: mobile-suit-zz-gundam/ZZ Gundam ep01 - Prelude of ZZ.ia.mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: Prelude of ZZ
items.description: Before Judau, a history lesson: space colonies, Zeon's declaration of independence, Amuro Ray, then Haman Khan's fleet finishing its preparations. Start here and you won't be lost.

items.id: mobile-suit-zz-gundam/ZZ Gundam ep02 - The Boy from Shangri La.ia.mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: The Kid from Shangri-La
items.description: Judau, a junker kid from Shangri-La, heads for the Argama with a bike and a salvage truck, and finds a Zeta Gundam in the hangar. Nobody in a Gundam show has ever just looked at one.

items.id: mobile-suit-zz-gundam/ZZ Gundam ep03 - The Knight of The Endra.ia.mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: The Knight of the Endra
items.description: A boss gets a letter, a ship is in port, and a few junk kids decide the Zeta Gundam would sell for a fortune. By the end someone is yelling 'Big brother! You did it!' So the plan went somewhere.

items.id: mobile-suit-zz-gundam/ZZ Gundam ep04 - Hot Blooded Mashymre.ia.mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: Passionate Mashymre
items.description: Mashymre Cello is told to go to Shangri-La and gather information, so he puts on a white suit with a rose in the lapel. The Argama hides in the rubble. A visitor this polite is the dangerous kind.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: Judau's Determination
items.description: Judau the junker gets recruited from more than one side, and one pitch is a pilot's fixed schedule. Mobile suit work, now with regular hours. Then a green hillside, and Beecha is told to drop the gas tanks.

items.id: mobile-suit-zz-gundam/ZZ Gundam ep06 - The Zssa Menace.ia.mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: The Zssa Menace
items.description: 'I prefer to fight fairly,' says Mashymre, rose close at hand, while a room of old men argues about civilians. Then a yellow Zssa drops over the colony's fields and lakes.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Rei II
items.description: Operation Yashima borrows the whole country's electricity for one giant rifle. Shinji does the aiming, Rei stands in front with the shield, and Misato has bet everything on the two of them.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: A Human Work
items.description: Japan unveils JA, a giant robot that needs no teenager and no Evangelion, with a banner, a podium and a christening party. NERV's staff attend, unconvinced.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Asuka Arrives in Japan
items.description: Asuka Langley Soryu arrives by UN fleet with Eva-02 and no doubt about who the best pilot is. Shinji and Misato get the view from a deck while an Angel rises under the ships.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Both of You, Dance Like You Want to Win!
items.description: An Angel that splits in two needs two pilots who move as one, and Shinji and Asuka can barely share a hallway. Misato's fix is choreography in the living room. Evangelion's oddest training montage.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Magmadiver
items.description: Asuka dives Unit-02 into an active volcano to catch an Angel before it hatches, and the heat is the real opponent. Afterward Shinji and Pen Pen get a hot spring, which is the correct reward.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E11 'Daemonseed'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Daemonseed
items.description: Something with roots is coming up through Paradigm City, and a map fills with red Xs to show where. Roger Smith is the only one who walks toward it.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E12 'Enemy is Another Big!'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: Enemy Is Another Big!
items.description: A second Big takes the field against Big O, and the city loses another few blocks to the argument. Roger Smith wears the same black suit to it, naturally.

items.id: the-big-o-en/The Big O Complete Series [EN]/The Big O [EN] E13 'R-D'.mp4
items.title: The Big O: R.D.
items.description: Roger Smith drives into the rain and down a sewer tunnel after a lead, with the military police never far behind. A golden field and a weathervane are the only sunshine in it.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Resurrection of Ideon
items.description: In a desert stopover, someone points out that the colonists didn't build their giant machine, they restored it. The Buff Clan keeps worrying about Karala, and the red robot is saved for the last minute.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Destruction of New Lopia
items.description: New Lopia's residents head for the jungle, and a check of the defenses finds the missiles were installed in the wrong places. Paperwork is undefeated, even this far from home.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Bursting Earth
items.description: Smoke over a colony, a woman running with a child, and a ship that can't get away. 'They're keeping us from escaping,' someone says, then asks Cosmo what he thinks he's doing.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Escape from Planet Solo
items.description: The colonists get off Solo: rockets on the pad, squadrons covering the lift-off, and room, somehow, for a goat. Giant-robot shows rarely stop for livestock.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Infinite Power: Legendary Ide
items.description: Someone recalls light that melted the ground and boiled away seas and lakes, and the legend of the Ide gets a painted, dreamlike vision to match. Then comes a plan to put fear in the enemy's hearts.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: Gaza Storm
items.description: The Endra's red mobile suits come down on Shangri-La while its people watch. Beannene and Wyme fly wing, and over the radio someone keeps asking the Zeta where it is hiding.
