items.id: mobile-suit-zz-gundam/ZZ Gundam ep08 - The Funeral Bell Tolls Twice.ia.mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: The Funeral Bell Tolls Twice
items.description: Mashymre's side holds a prayer for the fallen on a hillside, then asks over a lavish table 'what is the best way to honor them?' A Zeta is already out over a colony that could be destroyed.

items.id: mobile-suit-zz-gundam/ZZ Gundam ep09 - Judau in Space.ia.mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: Judau in Space
items.description: The Argama gets out of Shangri-La in one piece, Mashymre's Endra goes looking for the La Vie en Rose, and Judau learns that space has no side streets to duck into.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: Sayonara, Fa
items.description: Fa starts out carrying the Argama's meals and ends up in a pilot suit among the asteroids, which is not a normal career path. The title has a goodbye in it.

items.id: mobile-suit-zz-gundam/ZZ Gundam ep11 - Activate! Double Zeta.ia.mp4
items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: Activate! Double Zeta
items.description: A kit of red, yellow and blue pieces drifts through the asteroids and snaps together into the suit this show is named for. Mashymre's green mobile suit happens to be in the way.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: Leina Goes Missing
items.description: Leina is gone, the Endra is slipping away through the asteroids, and a shout of 'Judau! The Endra's getting away!' is the cue to chase. Captain Bright gets his tea first.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The Day Tokyo-3 Stood Still
items.description: With the power cut, the pilots climb and crawl through dead ducts to reach their Evas while an Angel drips acid onto headquarters. Upstairs, NERV's staff run the place by hand.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The Value of a Miracle
items.description: An Angel is dropping out of orbit, and the only plan is to catch it with three Evas and no second try. Misato's promotion and the party that goes with it are the day's other news.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Lilliputian Hitcher
items.description: Mid-test, an Angel goes after NERV's Magi supercomputer from the inside, and Ritsuko is the one at the terminals. A fight in code, and it is as tense as any giant-robot battle.

items.title: After War Gundam X: Has the Moon Come Up?
items.description: Narration covers the Seventh Space War, a market town gets a visit from Mobile Suits, and Garrod and Tiffa drive a night road asking whether there's a house ahead. Does the moon come up? Watch for it.

items.title: After War Gundam X: I'll Give You Power...
items.description: Garrod and Tiffa share a campfire while a buyer prices the electronics in a wrecked Mobile Suit. Then a clearing fills with more suits than anyone expected. Enjoy the fire while it lasts.

items.title: After War Gundam X: My Favorite Mount Is Ferocious
items.description: Men in an office talk about Tiffa Adill over a chess set while Garrod lies out cold and a ship chases a lone vehicle across the desert. The chess is the better metaphor.

items.title: After War Gundam X: This Operation Is Time Critical!
items.description: Jamil puts out a call to fellow Vultures because the crew is short on firepower. Garrod says he fights to help Tiffa, then corrects it to people like Tiffa. The correction is the show in one line.

items.title: After War Gundam X: You Will Pull the Trigger
items.description: A red Gundam attacks, a lab full of white coats asks whether Tiffa Adill is awake, and mid-fight Garrod is asked what he is actually fighting for. Bad timing, good question.

items.title: Force Five: Danguard Ace
items.description: Leiji Matsumoto, the Captain Harlock and Yamato guy, also drew a giant robot. It brings his space-opera gloom with it, cut down to a single feature so the long voyage goes by fast.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: White Flag of Betrayal
items.description: Gije says it will be his responsibility if anything happens to her, and aboard the Solo Ship they ask whether a strange energy and the Ideon are connected. Trust is the dangerous part.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Escape from Null-Space
items.description: Gil Baio's squadron has the colonists in a tough spot, a briefing lays out the Gido Nebula, and then the swirl starts. "Pull up! Pull up!" is the closest anyone gets to a plan.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Battle in the Sandstorm
items.description: A hostage standoff over Gije, with children in the balance, spills into a desert battle where Cosmo reaches for a knife. Nobody has a good view.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Burning Null-Space
items.description: A volcano, a dinosaur or two, and a Buff Clan quarrel over whether letting the enemy escape counts as being defeated by him. 'Humiliation's the best medicine,' someone says, not kindly.

items.id: space-runaway-ideo-eng-sub/10. Suprise attack of the Bajin.mp4
items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Surprise Attack of the Bajin
items.description: A girl in a glowing bubble asks to be brought a souvenir, and later a voice says it has come to take a woman back. Somebody shouts for Moera. The crystal wasteland is a good-looking bad place.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ: Little Sister!
items.description: 'Of course I'm gonna get Leina back!' says Judau, and the rescue runs through a dinner table, a debris field and Chara's 'I wouldn't lie in a voice that cute!' Little sisters are expensive.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: Hang In There, Young President!
items.description: Opens on two space pilots, then drops into a sixth-grade classroom, which is where the president actually lives. The title cheers him on, and the plot supplies the reasons.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: It's Tough Being President
items.description: The president is a schoolboy, and the job covers a sandlot ball game and a hospital bedside before the robot is needed. Trider G7 turns up for the last third, like a good executive.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: It's Not the Money, It's the Spirit
items.description: A boy president oversleeps, drags himself to school and spends much of the half hour close to tears. The title says spirit counts. This is the bad day before the robot gets involved.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: Watta's Lullaby
items.description: A baby ends up in a schoolboy's arms, and the same boy flies a giant robot. Of the two jobs, the baby looks harder, and the episode gives it most of the half hour.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: Ah, My Fated Rival
items.description: A man in glasses and a green vest takes the boy for a drive, then sits down with an old gentleman in a suit. A moustached man with a cigarette holder drops in. The robot waits for the last stretch.

items.title: After War Gundam X: I Don't Believe This...
items.description: Narration disposes of the Seventh Space War in about a minute. Then the Freeden's crew sells off the day's salvaged Mobile Suits, and Garrod decides a glimpse of Tiffa made the trip worth it.

items.title: After War Gundam X: I'm Selling This Gundam!
items.description: Garrod takes the microphone beside the Gundam and works a crowd like an auctioneer. Within the first minute someone is already shouting to stop talking and just run. Good advice for any pitch.

items.title: After War Gundam X: I Won't Forgive That Child!
items.description: A red-haired woman says she'll shoot and means it, Witz needs a new hiding spot for something he can't carry around, and an alley gets uncomfortably close to Garrod. The last scene asks for a photograph.

items.title: After War Gundam X: Like the Rain Falling on the City
items.description: A crew's ship is trapped on a lake of fire, and the enemy is betting Garrod Ran will come for it. The rain from the title holds off until the end, which is how you do weather.

items.title: After War Gundam X: I Am a Newtype
items.description: A snowbound northern city, a blond boy who says he was born with the same abilities as the Newtypes, and Jamil's crew prepping for a hard fight against one. Tiffa is asked if she can sense him.

items.id: space-runaway-ideo-eng-sub/11. Pursuit to the Ruined Planet.mp4
items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Pursuit to the Ruined Planet
items.description: Abadede of the Buff Clan launches something that swarms the Ideon like blue-green weeds, and aboard the Solo Ship someone tries to decode the 6th Civilization's language. Remote spy planes circle.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Break Through the Enemy's Front
items.description: On a ruined planet of grey rocks, someone asks 'Aren't you going to laugh?' Someone else sees the Ideon with her own eyes for the first time. It's a quiet episode for a robot show.

items.title: Space Runaway Ideon: Attack on the Alien
items.description: A grinning officer promises results, a colonist is told 'we're all depending on you,' and the ship's quarrels give way to the woods, where the last minutes belong to a woman, not a robot.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 01 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: That's the Rumored Might Gaine
items.description: The Might Gaine of the rumor shows up in person: the blue-and-white robot, plus a boy in a yellow shirt and a night bike ride. A proper introduction, and the rumor holds up.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 02 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: Roar and Take Off! Bombers
items.description: Bombers are the threat, and the bullet train that unfolds into a robot is the reply. Along the way: a lightning-wrapped car pileup and a plot hatched over office computers in a very nineties suit-and-tie.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 03 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: This Guy Is Strong! Swordsman Robo
items.description: The title is the review: this guy is strong. A swordsman robot arrives with a long-haired, headbanded pilot who looks pulled from a period drama, and the Might Gaine crew has to find an answer.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 04 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: Emergency Dispatch! Divers
items.description: The Divers get an emergency dispatch: a grand hall full of guests and police, a boy in a headband, then smoke over the skyline. A thriller first, a robot episode second, and the cavalry is in the title.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 05 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: Protect the President!
items.description: Gunmen hold a family at home while a robot waits under camouflage netting, and a bullet train is the only thing that can get there in time. Mecha, with a commuter schedule.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: I Love Space Cram School
items.description: Even a boy president has homework. This one trades the boardroom for a cram school, with a teacher in glasses and a lot of classroom. Homework first, giant robot second, as many children were told.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: Danger! The Dashing Section Chief
items.description: This one leaves town for a red desert world: a pair in yellow suits crosses it in a little green rover, and Trider G7 is on hand. The title saves the dash for the section chief.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: Man to Man, the Petals Fall
items.description: Under the cherry blossoms, the boy president and the big kid in the yellow shirt have it out, and nobody is in a robot. The robots come later, and one gets tangled in cables.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: I'm a Little Big President
items.description: The boy president puts on a bow tie and a blue suit and faces a room of grown executives. It is the episode where the job looks most like a job, and the sofa takes some punishment.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: Mr. Daimon, Pure of Heart
items.description: A bundle of cash, a bulldog and a worried big kid anchor the human half of this one, and the title vouches for somebody's heart. The robot half takes place in an ice cave.

items.title: After War Gundam X: Don't Think, Just Run!
items.description: The crew still can't believe the Newtype they came looking for attacked them first. Snow, a nod to Carris on a completed mission, and Garrod on his knees in it by the end.

items.title: After War Gundam X: This Is My Finest Masterpiece
items.description: The crew puts in three days of combat simulations while a man with a monocle reads reports elsewhere. Then Garrod ends up aiming a pistol, and the talk turns to Newtype powers. Simulators are the calm part.

items.title: After War Gundam X: Shoot My Foolish Self
items.description: Carris has a gun on Tiffa, Garrod has his own aimed back, and the opening minute is a standoff where every word counts. The rest of the episode has a lot to live up to.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x01 - Prisoner.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Prisoner
items.description: Somebody gets held, and the lead's face does the arguing. A mountain base, a row of officers watching a screen, a red enemy suit close enough to touch.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x02 - Makeup.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Make-Up
items.description: Hallway talk and a base on edge, then the red-armored enemy shows up and a white fighter limps away trailing fire. Southern Cross gets from a quiet scene to a battle in one cut.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x03 - Star Angel.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Star Angel
items.description: This one leaves the ground: a launch tower, Earth turning below, then fighters firing in the dark. The sheet is nearly all blue and black, and the bridge is where the tension sits.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x04 - Half Moon.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Half Moon
items.description: Two moons hang over a cold ridge where a red enemy suit and a blue mecha trade shots in the snow. Some of the prettiest ground this series gets to blow up.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x05 - Trouble City.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Trouble City
items.description: A day in the shopping district: floats at the counter, the crew browsing, a fight waiting on the far side of the afternoon. The fighters scramble when a warship turns up overhead.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 06 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: Enter! The Fated Rival
items.description: The fated rival makes his entrance: green-streaked hair and a scarred cheek. There is also a quiet theme-park stop, ferris wheel included, which gives the entrance something to land on.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 07 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: The Devil's Daimonji Bonfire
items.description: A robot with a kabuki-painted face turns up, a car arrives heaped with gifts, and the cherry blossoms are out. It is spring, with giant robots attached.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 08 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: Don't Touch Natto!
items.description: Natto gets a whole episode of a giant-robot show, and the title is the house rule. Two breakfast bowls, a villainess in a red dress, a bird-headed robot, and an old man in the last frames who is enjoying himself.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 09 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: Roulette of Terror
items.description: A giant roulette wheel, a toast of red wine, a sniper's crosshair, and a train full of ordinary passengers who did not place a bet. The title is not exaggerating.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 10 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: Mifune Buddha's Hellish Blessing
items.description: Banknotes rain on a crowd gathered at a giant Buddha, and the blessing is as hellish as the title warns. A column of followers with bags on their heads is the detail you will keep.

items.title: Force Five: Spaceketeers
items.description: Musketeers with rockets, which is about as subtle as syndication got. Japanese robot television recut as a movie and handed to American kids under a new name.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: Ah, the Top-Secret Test Plan
items.description: A school exam and a top-secret test plan share one episode: the boy bends over his paper, the grown-ups sit around a conference table. Either way, somebody is being graded.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: Run, Shinkichi! Go for the Goal
items.description: A title that shouts at Shinkichi to run, and an episode that spends its time on schoolyard scuffles and a butler who finds something very funny. The robot gets the closing minutes.

items.title: Invincible Robo Trider G7: I'm the Earth's Superstar?!
items.description: A man in a white T-shirt runs the neighborhood in training, a bulldog guards a gate, and a sword-and-shield robot shows up at the seafront. The title puts a question mark on stardom.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Prelude to the Offensive
items.description: The war starts in an orange sky and a ship's corridor, with armoured pilots fighting in space. Then it slows for a heart-shaped locket and a red-haired young man by a wrecked ship in the desert.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: The Broken-Hearted Girl's March
items.description: The riders pick up a small girl in a red cap, then the tape follows her through ruined streets and out onto cracked desert, pink backpack on. The march in the title is hers, and it's a long one.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Showdown Concert at High Noon
items.description: High noon, a bar, a sunglassed tough guy, and riders rolling in on armor cycles. Mospeada does a Western and plays it straight. The title promises a concert too, so stay for that part.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Survival Song Feeling
items.description: Everyone is on foot in a forest this time: tall grass to hide in, a river to cross, a stranger in red along for the walk. Then a big red machine with a round eye finds the party.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Live Inn Plunder Operation
items.description: Mospeada stops for a concert: a drum kit, a stadium crowd, a pink-haired singer in the lights, and a plunder stitched in around them. The armor holds off until the last few minutes.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x06 - Prelude.ia.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Prelude
items.description: A decorated tree and sundaes in the mess, the brass looking on, the lead trying to relax. The calm is the setup, and by the last minutes the blue armor is out among burning ruins.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x07 - Labyrinth.ia.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Labyrinth
items.description: Green-lit corridors, hatches and a squad that keeps going deeper into a maze that clearly has opinions about them. The set design is the star.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x08 - Metal Fire.ia.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Metal Fire
items.description: The fight comes downtown. Officers argue in a council room, then white armor steps through city streets and the glass starts coming down. Somebody is going to be billed for the windows.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x09 - Star Dust.ia.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Star Dust
items.description: The enemy's hooded elders sit in council, an arm is bandaged, and the episode turns strange and quiet before the last fight. Watch it with the lights low.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x10 - Outsider.ia.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Outsider
items.description: A piano in a dark blue room, a commander over a star map, a library where someone sits apart. A talky episode with a lonely streak, and a good place to learn who these people are.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 11 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit FLACx2).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: Crimson Wings! Hiryu Appears
items.description: Hiryu, the crimson aircraft of the title, gets its entrance, and the cockpit has a MODE CHANGE panel with a jet silhouette on it. A button like that is a promise, and Might Gaine keeps it.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 12 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: The Ring of Saros
items.description: A bullet train paces a gazelle across the savanna, the best thing a train has done all week. A woman draws a pistol, and a blonde woman's portrait seems to matter to everyone.

items.id: 20240609_20240609_1627/[Moozzi2] Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine - 13 (BD 1440x1080 x265-10Bit Flac).mp4
items.title: The Brave Express Might Gaine: Duel in the Wilderness
items.description: Might Gaine goes Western: dust-masked drifters, a saloon with a bartender at the shaker, a steam locomotive, and two robots squaring off against a setting sun. The title is the plan, and the sunset agrees.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 1 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Gundam Fight Begins!
items.description: The Shining Gundam drops from the colonies to Earth with Domon Kasshu in it, and the first episode has more punching than briefing. A girl is tied up, and Domon notices.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 2 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Roar of the Winning Punch
items.description: Neo America means Chibodee Crocker, who settles things in a ring before he settles them in a Gundam. Domon gets the New York welcome, Statue of Liberty included. The title is not subtle.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 3 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Beat the Dragon Gundam
items.description: Neo China's Dragon Gundam belongs to Sai Saici, who is a kid, and the machine is bigger than he is. Domon has to beat it anyway. The title is the whole assignment.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 4 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Challenge! The Red Rose Knight!
items.description: Paris at night, and Georges de Sand's Gundam Rose, a knight in flower form. Chivalry meets a hero who punches first and asks later, and the duel is the point.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 5 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Great Escape! A Captive Gundam Fighter
items.description: Neo Russia has a snowfield, a prison and a Bolt Gundam, and Domon sees all three. The tournament is supposed to be a fight; this week it starts as a breakout.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Support Girl Blues
items.description: Light on armor, heavy on mood. A girl on a red cycle, a name carved into a wall, and a gang of bruisers working a ruined city. The blues in the title are earned.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Fallen Hero's Ragtime
items.description: The riders roll into a village: a bakery, a worried couple, a crowd in the square and a red notebook that matters. Then a fire. The big man in the headband gets the last shot, driving out at sunset.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Jonathan's Elegy
items.description: A man in sunglasses sizes up a rider in a bar, and soon armoured troops are creeping through the forest after a purple machine. The talk comes first, and it sets up the hunt.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Lost World Fugue
items.description: Night in the jungle: a campfire, a kid in a red cap crying, a rider in a blue visor keeping watch. The lost world of the title sits out in the dark, and it isn't empty.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Requiem of the Battlefield
items.description: A requiem under open sky: mountains, barren ground, and red-armored troops watching the riders cross it. Mospeada is the Robotech chapter with motorcycles, and it is here to be mournful.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x11 - Déjà Vu.ia.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Déjà Vu
items.description: Mostly faces: a hospital bed, a clipboard, the lead with a gun in her hand. The robots mostly wait outside, which is unusual here and worth the detour.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x12 - Lost Memory.ia.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Lost Memory
items.description: Flowers, a park, and a purple-haired officer at the center of an afternoon away from the front line. It is the soft stretch of the series, and it has earned one.

items.id: the-super-dimension-cavalry-southern-cross-1x-01-prisoner_202104/The Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross - 1x13 - Triple Mirror.ia.mp4
items.title: Super Dimension Cavalry Southern Cross: Triple Mirror
items.description: A purple-haired officer, a bald elder in a hood and a pink creature in a green field. Southern Cross does not usually go this strange, and it commits.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 6 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Fight, Domon! Earth Is the Ring
items.description: Earth is the ring. That is the whole Gundam Fight in four words, and Domon, Rain and the Shining Gundam act it out for a tournament with no stadium to speak of.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 7 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Prepare to Fight! Desperate Fugitive
items.description: A fugitive in a straw hat, a village by the sea, and a fight the title tells you to prepare for. Domon prepares by getting involved.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 8 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Old Grudge: Revenge of the Space Police
items.description: Niagara Falls is the backdrop, the Space Police have a grudge, and the title promises revenge. Domon is here for the tournament, which in this show is always also somebody's feelings.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 9 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Powerful Enemy! Chapman's Heroic Challenge
items.description: A casino, a stack of chips and Chapman's heroic challenge. Rain dresses for the occasion, Domon grins across the table, and the Gundams wait for the fight the title promises.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 10 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Terror! The Phantom Fighter Appears
items.description: Pyramids, lightning and a phantom fighter, which is a lot of atmosphere for one episode. Domon and Rain cross the sand with a boy in tow, and the pyramid is no sightseeing stop.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Lullaby of Distant Hope
items.description: A red-haired woman at a piano, a stack of gold on a pink table, a man in a black suit and red tie. A drawing-room mystery that wandered onto a ruined highway, ending in falling snow.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Fortress Breakthrough Boogie
items.description: The riders climb a snowy mountain, slip into a fortress whose walls look like they're breathing, and have to get back out. Everyone ends on the grass with a drink, so the boogie works.

items.title: Genesis Climber Mospeada: Sandstorm Playback
items.description: A playback in a cave: a glowing pink brain, two dinosaurs fighting, a green-bearded elder, soldiers in silver armor. The riders watch it like a tape, and the hero's face closes it out.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 11 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Reunion in Falling Rain
items.description: Her name is Rain, the weather is rain, and the title says so. Rain Mikamura gets a reunion and the umbrella, and for once the Shining Gundam can wait.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 12 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: He's the Undefeated of the East!
items.description: The Undefeated of the East, Master Asia, walks into the ruins of Tokyo. He taught Domon everything he knows, and he arrives like a man who knows it.

items.id: DonovanLewis/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episodes 01-49 & Extras [1080p]/[xPearse] Mobile Fighter G Gundam Episode 13 [1080p].mp4
items.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam: Big Trouble! Domon vs. Big 5
items.description: Domon vs. Big 5 is the whole title and the whole arithmetic. Tokyo's ruins are the arena, and for once the Gundam Fight prints the odds on the cover.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E001.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: God or Devil?!
items.description: A stranger with seven scars collapses in the wasteland and wakes in a village under Zeed's raiders. Bat and Lin are there too. The rules of this world get explained with fists.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E002.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: The Zankai Ken Deathblow!
items.description: Kenshiro, Bat and Lin reach a settlement waiting for help. A raider with a crossbow stands in the way. A crossbow is not a plan against this man.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E003.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: In a City Without Light, a Lone Fist Burns!
items.description: Spade hunts the man with seven scars on his warlord's orders. Kenshiro ends up in a caged arena against a masked champion. The warlord has the best seat.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E004.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: The Bloody Cross Attacks!
items.description: Ken rolls into a ruined town with a girl and her puppy. A fat, tattooed boss keeps everyone afraid. The showdown is out in the open desert, with nowhere to hide.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E005.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Can the Flames of Love Burn in Hell?
items.description: Ken walks alone to the fortress of the blond warlord who holds Yuria. He does not knock. A fortress is a lot of walls for one man to get through.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E01.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Weird
items.description: Lain Iwakura is fourteen, shy and not interested in computers. Then a classmate who has died sends her an email. Episode one opens the door to the Wired and says very little about what is behind it.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E02.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Girls
items.description: Lain's classmates help her dress for a club, and she goes in her bear hat. Something goes wrong in the crowd. The bear hat is the most trusting thing in the episode.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E03.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Psyche
items.description: Officials question Lain after the club. At school, everyone gossips about a suicide on the news. At home, she builds a computer from parts. The show moves slowly, and means to.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E04.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Religion
items.description: Lain's room fills with computer equipment while her classmates keep asking about the suicide. Men in black suits watch her at night. The 'to be continued' feels like a threat.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E05.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Distortion
items.description: Narration asks what man has evolved into and whether history is prophecy. Lain moves through crowds, a diner and her school. Nothing here is plot. All of it is mood.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: Here Comes Ayeka!
items.description: Princess Ayeka arrives from Jurai to arrest Ryoko. The two face off on the Masaki lawn, and little Sasami tags along. This is the Toonami audio. Dinner is the show's answer to everything.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: Hello, Ryo-Ohki!
items.description: Ayeka is stranded on Earth and grieves for her lost brother Yosho. Ryoko and Tenchi wait out the weather in a hut. Ryoko's egg hatches into the cabbit Ryo-Ohki, which is the title character's entrance.

items.id: tenchi-muyo-ryo-ohki-toonami-semi-remaster/04 - Mihoshi Falls to the Land of Stars (Toonami Audio).mp4
items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: Mihoshi Falls to the Land of Stars
items.description: Galaxy Police detective Mihoshi is sent after the pirate Ryoko and lands in the middle of a hot-spring outing at the Masaki house. Kagato makes his entrance too. Mihoshi's timing is the joke.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: Kagato Attacks!
items.description: Snow falls on Tenchi's valley, and Ryoko's old master comes calling. Tenchi and Ryoko run through the trees. The weather is cold. The visitor is colder. Even the snowmen look worried.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP01.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: Prologue to the Legend
items.description: A narrator lays out the war-torn island of Lodoss. Parn and his companions meet the elf Deedlit in a dungeon, while a sorceress watches through a crystal ball. It began as a tabletop game, and plays like one.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP02.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: Blazing Departure
items.description: Parn and Deedlit travel on with the dwarf Ghim and the priest Etoh. They fight through a forest and a village, and someone pleads for a life. The party finally feels like a party.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP03.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: The Black Knight
items.description: The party reaches the kingdom of Valis and meets its king. A black-armoured knight and a dark elf move against them. The knight says little, and it works.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP04.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: The Grey Witch
items.description: A king hears of a rival's move. The party crosses a glowing forest, where Parn faces a dark elf. The sorceress behind the war shows her hand in red light. The forest steals the episode.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP05.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: The Desert King
items.description: The party reaches a banquet hall and a court that smiles too much. Parn has a sword, a table full of strangers and a dance partner. Something red is poured, and nobody here is only a guest.

items.title: Crying Freeman: Portrait of a Killer
items.description: An artist in a garden sees something she was not meant to see, and the man who did it has a dragon tattoo and a habit of crying. First of five, in the English dub. Turn the lights down.

items.title: Crying Freeman: A Taste of Revenge
items.description: A hitman who weeps over his targets, at once tender and lethal. An adult OVA, plain about both the violence and the romance.

items.title: Armitage III: Electro Blood
items.description: A detective from Earth lands on Mars and is handed a new partner. A talk show called Red to Blue treats the planet as a news beat. Pioneer's dub. Go slowly; the plot rewards it.

items.title: Armitage III: Flesh & Stone
items.description: On Mars, Ross Sylibus works a case where the victims are Thirds, robots built to pass as human. His partner Naomi Armitage does not read the file the way he does. Pioneer's dub, second of four.

items.title: Armitage III: Heart Core
items.description: Part three of four, and the grown-up one: a prisoner in a collar, a Martian newscast, a love scene played straight. Mars noir never cared about the PG crowd.

items.title: Armitage III: Bit of Love
items.description: The last of four, where the series asks out loud whether a robot who can conceive counts as a person. Cyberpunk with a question mark at the end.

items.id: anikoto-project-a-ko-uncivil-wars-episode-2-watch-anime-online/Project A-ko Uncivil Wars Dub - Scifi Channel Saturday Feb 1st, 1997.mp4
items.title: Project A-ko: Uncivil Wars on Sci-Fi (Feb. '97)
items.description: C-ko is kidnapped across the galaxy and drops in on A-ko and B-ko, who are scavenging on a desert planet. The Saturday dub, kept whole and a little feral.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E006.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Search Order from Satan
items.description: A market town, a guarded vault, and soldiers under a goggled colonel. Ken takes on the uniforms and their leader after dark. The dark outside town is where this one gets good.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E007.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Shall We Have a Countdown to Death?
items.description: Kenshiro, Bat and Lin run into soldiers under a one-eyed colonel. Lin is held. Ken questions a sergeant, and the sergeant is not enjoying it.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E008.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Strike the Hidden Power Point!
items.description: Bat leads Kenshiro to the walled fortress where Lin is chained. Guards and a giant mechanical figure are in the way. Both turn out to be speed bumps.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E009.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Say Your Prayers Before You Die!
items.description: Madam Patra rules a village from her palace. Kenshiro, Bat and Lin arrive, and Ken lands in a cage. Cages in this series are a short-term problem.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E010.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: The Raging Flame Reverse Flow Punch!
items.description: A starving village has been taken as slaves. A fat king feasts while the people go hungry, and a blue-skinned giant guards his table. The feast is the cruelest part.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E06.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Kids
items.description: Lain is taken to a room with a black cube in it. Nobody explains it properly, which is how this show works. It leaves you with a feeling and calls that an answer. Keep the lights low.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E07.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Society
items.description: Voices keep asking who Lain is. They speak of her will and the light in her heart. Men in dark suits watch from a car and are in no hurry.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E08.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Rumors
items.description: A serious bug turns up in Protocol 6, and classmates crowd around Lain. Someone tells her everything she has said is a lie. School and the Wired stop being separate places.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E09.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Protocol
items.description: This is the lecture episode. The Wired's secret history plays over a glowing globe, from a grey alien to the Earth Coincidence Control Office. The footnotes are half the fun.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E10.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Love
items.description: Lain meets a sullen double of herself with marks on its cheeks. A man in a dark suit comes to her door, and the Wired floods her room with light. Two Lains is one too many.

items.id: armitage-iii-poly-matrix-aug-4-1997-usa-june-25-1996-jp/Armitage III Poly-Matrix Aug 4 1997 USA June 25 1996 JP.ia.mp4
items.title: Armitage III: Poly-Matrix
items.description: Detective Ross Sylibus lands on Mars, where someone is murdering Thirds, robots built to pass as human. His new partner is Naomi Armitage. Cyberpunk noir, rain included.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: We Need Tenchi
items.description: Tenchi and the girls storm Kagato's ship to free Ryoko. Ayeka and Mihoshi land in Washu's prison. Tenchi faces Kagato alone. The Light Hawk Wings are the payoff.

items.id: tenchi-muyo-ryo-ohki-toonami-semi-remaster/07 - The Night Before the Carnival (Toonami Audio).mp4
items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: The Night Before the Carnival
items.description: With Kagato gone, the household settles into a long, strange peace. Washu tinkers, Sasami cooks, and the girls compete for Tenchi. It is the show doing what it does best, which is nothing urgent.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: Hello Baby!
items.description: A baby named Taro is left with the Masaki household. Tenchi, Ryoko, Ayeka and Mihoshi try to look after him until his mother comes. Nobody in this house is trained for it.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: Sasami and Tsunami
items.description: On a family cherry-blossom outing, Sasami drifts off and dreams of the Jurai past. The dream shows her bond with the goddess Tsunami. This is the show at its softest.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP06.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: The Sword of the Dark Emperor
items.description: A castle is attacked by night and its people flee. A white-bearded king and a black-haired sorcerer face a fiery demon, then talk about being pawns in a bigger game. The demon is loud. The pawn talk is better.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP07.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: The War of Heroes
items.description: Armies meet on a rocky plain, and Parn fights a dark swordsman. An old king, a red-haired warrior and a caped sorcerer join in. For once, the war looks like a war.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP08mp4.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: Requiem for Warriors
items.description: Parn and his party cross a dead battlefield and a fog-choked ruin, past a sword left standing in the dirt. The Madhouse OVA grew out of a tabletop D&D replay. It plays grim and looks lovely.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP09.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: The Scepter of Domination
items.description: Ashram and his dark elves move against Lodoss. The heroes cross a forest, an army rides out, and a red dragon turns up late. The dragon is worth waiting for.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP10.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: The Demon Dragon of Fire Dragon Mountain
items.description: Parn and the company press on through caves and lava. A dark-armoured knight waits with his sword, and a volcano erupts. The dungeon is back, and hotter.

items.title: Akira
items.description: A biker gang, a psychic experiment and a Neo-Tokyo coming apart. Katsuhiro Otomo adapted his own manga. For a lot of American kids, this was the tape that started the trading table.

items.title: Crying Freeman: Eternal Love
items.description: Part three. Emu and Freeman are now bound together, and the dragon on his back is the least of what he carries. Elders meet, tea is poured, and a sword turns up. The English dub keeps a straight face.

items.title: Crying Freeman: Oshu Tohgoku
items.description: Fourth of five. Yo Hinomura, the Dragons' assassin who weeps over his work, is up against muscle this time, with a wrestling ring in the mix. Sad man, big fists. English dub.

items.id: arr-money-wars-nerawareta-waterfront-keikaku-ova/[ARR] Money Wars - Nerawareta Waterfront Keikaku (マネーウォーズ 狙われたウォーターフロント計画) OVA.mp4
items.title: Money Wars
items.description: A young businessman walks into a scheme over a waterfront development, and gangsters are on the other side of the deal. It airs in Japanese with our subtitles. Most of the fighting happens on the stock market.

items.title: Venus Wars
items.description: The Manga Video dub, as British rental shelves had it. Same Venus, same motorbike war, different voices. Put it beside the Sci-Fi copy and listen for what changed.

items.title: Lensman
items.description: E. E. Smith's pulp space opera as a film: a young hero picked by a lens, with early computer animation in the battles. The Streamline Pictures release is how many fans first met it.

items.title: Lily C.A.T.
items.description: A starship crew fights an alien force that has taken over their own ship. This is the Streamline Pictures VHS, the copy that sat on rental shelves. Dark and short. Leave a light on.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E011.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Listen to the Blues of Hell!
items.description: An old woman keeps a band of children safe in a ruined town. A red-haired brute with dynamite wants them gone. Ken, Bat and Lin are the only thing in his way.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E012.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: I Am Death!
items.description: A mocking killer in a red coat murders to survive and thinks that makes him tough. Then he meets the man with seven scars in a ruined city. They square off in the street.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E013.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: The Arhat Deva Fist!
items.description: A huge purple-skinned brute is made to fight in an arena. Kenshiro steps in while the town's children watch. They see all of it, and so do you.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E014.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: A Miserable Age!
items.description: Kenshiro lies feverish in a village bed. Helmeted thugs under a mustached boss are leaning on the town and its children. A fever does not get him out of a fight in this show.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E015.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Count to Three!
items.description: Kenshiro, Bat and Lin cross the wasteland, and a ruined tower holds a knife-wielding surprise for Bat. Lin's puppy is along for all of it. The apple is the calm part. Nothing else is.

items.title: Casshan: Robot Hunter
items.description: A young man is rebuilt as a fighter against the robots that turned on humanity. A Tatsunoko hero on a tape that comes with no notes, so go in cold. Anime from the back shelf, as promised.

items.title: 8 Man After: City in Fear
items.description: Cyborg noir that opens on a burning photograph. The silver-faced hero turns up late, and it works better that way.

items.title: 8 Man After: End Run
items.description: A football stadium, a crowd that looks painted on, and a mustached doctor with a bottle of pills. The cyborg detective is already late. Short sentences, long night.

items.title: 8 Man After: Mr. Halloween
items.description: A bandaged detective, a body-scan readout and a mangled green cyborg face. The middle of the story, and it hurts a little.

items.title: 8 Man After: Sachiko's Decision
items.description: A kid in a purple cap follows the cyborg detective through the dark city, and the lab behind the case finally gets a look. Sachiko has a choice to make. The title says so.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E11.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Infornography
items.description: The men in black come closer in every scene. Lain moves between her bedroom and the Wired, and neither is safe. Watch it late, and watch it alone.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E12.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Landscape
items.description: Lain in a red hoodie on empty streets, the men in black in their car, and a room full of cables. Someone asks who she is talking to. The close-ups do not answer.

items.id: serial-experiments-lain-english/BluRay (MKV - Highest Quality)/Serial Experiments Lain - S01E13.mp4
items.title: Serial Experiments Lain: Ego
items.description: The last one. The streets empty, and blue static crosses Lain's face. Her friends are asked who that girl is. The show will not tie a bow, so do not wait for one.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: I Love Tenchi
items.description: Ryo-Ohki is a cat now, and the whole household adores her. Washu runs her through the lab. The girls compete for Tenchi and spend a day in the field. The cat gets the best attention.

items.id: tenchi-muyo-ryo-ohki-toonami-semi-remaster/11 - The Advent of the Goddess (Toonami Audio).mp4
items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: The Advent of the Goddess
items.description: Dr. Clay comes looking for Washu and sets a plan in motion against the Masaki household. A goddess begins to show herself. The sitcom gets nervous.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: Zero Ryoko
items.description: Dr. Clay replaces Ryoko with a copy called Zero, who creeps into the Masaki house. Washu and the household have to work out which Ryoko is real. Two Ryokos is a lot of Ryoko.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki: Here Comes Jurai
items.description: Royalty from Jurai arrive at the Masaki house looking for Tenchi's grandfather. The household has to put up with the visitors. Company is coming, and it is royal company.

items.title: Tenchi Muyo! in Love
items.description: The Tenchi household gets a feature film, in English. The harem comedy turns serious and reaches into Tenchi's past. Rent this one if the series ever made you wonder where he comes from.

items.title: Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture
items.description: Terry Bogard and friends fight through a plot built straight from the SNK arcade game. Arcade story logic, arcade punches, and no continues. The quarters are on you.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP11.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: The Wizard's Ambition
items.description: A castle burns at night and a dark armoured figure walks its halls. By day Parn and the company ride toward Marmo, with a girl travelling alongside. A quiet ride after a loud night.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP12.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: Final Battle! Marmo - The Dark Island
items.description: The sorcerer Wagnard begins a resurrection ceremony in a black castle. The company fights through a cave and a monster, and a red-haired sorceress works her own magic. The villain keeps a schedule.

items.id: s-01-ep-13_202602/Record of the Lodoss War (1990)/S01 EP13.mp4
items.title: Record of Lodoss War: Lodoss - The Burning Continent
items.description: The last battle: magic circles, a dragon, and the dark lord and his sorcerer. The credits run long. Let them.

items.title: Crying Freeman: Abduction in Chinatown
items.description: The last of five. Yo Hinomura, the assassin who weeps, takes the Dragons' war to a walled fortress. Bring tissues. He already has some. English dub.

items.title: Gunsmith Cats
items.description: Rally Vincent runs a Chicago gun shop and hunts bounties on the side. Minnie May builds the explosives. A short OVA, composite-video rough, and the cars get more screen time than the cops.

items.title: Riding Bean
items.description: Bean Bandit moves any cargo for a price, and this job comes with a kidnapped girl and a frame. A car-chase OVA with real gunfire and a courier who talks like he's on a deadline.

items.title: Yankee Reppuu-tai
items.description: Street gangs fight over turf, with swords in dark doorways and one question hanging over the lot: who becomes the next leader. The subtitles are on screen. The threats are the same in any language.

items.title: Yankee Reppuu-tai II: The Blood-Stained Gang Jacket
items.description: The hero inherits the gang jacket and the job of second leader. The subtitles are on the picture. Nobody in this gang finishes a fight with a clean face.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E016.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Try To Sing Villains!
items.description: Raiders on bikes ride down on a crowd of survivors in a ruined city. A joker card lands between Kenshiro and a hard-eyed stranger. The rest is Hokuto Shinken, delivered at close range.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E017.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Battle Makes a Man!
items.description: Kenshiro is thrown in with General Barcom's fighters, and Shin's side of the story stays in the frame. Yuria is part of why. The cage is the easy part of this one.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E018.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Life or Death!
items.description: A gang's brutes and a horned-helmet raider meet Kenshiro in the wasteland. A hidden pressure point does the work. Lin and Bat wait in cloaks at nightfall, and they have seen this before.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E019.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Ready Your One-Way Tickets to Death
items.description: Kenshiro and the children cross the wasteland to a village. A masked swordsman and his gang plan to raid it. They have picked the wrong village, and the show knows it.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E020.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: A Nightmarish Full-Scale War!
items.description: A bandaged Kenshiro, Bat and Lin meet a goggled, feathered gang boss. Up in his tower, Shin watches and keeps Yuria at his side. The feathers are a bold choice.

items.title: Iria: Pitch Black
items.description: Iria, a bounty hunter with a quick temper, takes a job that goes wrong in space. Zeiram the Animation, in English. A live-action film came first, and this tape moves faster than it did.

items.title: Iria: Rampage
items.description: Iria drops into a seaside town in armor and a red scarf. Smoke rises over the rooftops, and a crew of kids and a goggled strongman gets in her way. In English, from the Saturday Anime shelf.

items.title: Iria: Visage
items.description: Iria draws a sword on a green-crested fighter while a gold ornament changes hands. An older man with a red mark on his brow watches from the stands. Keep an eye on who ends up holding the ornament.

items.title: Iria: Broom Tree
items.description: A boy with a bandaged cheek meets Iria's crew, and a dockside brawl follows. Later, something rooted and green-haired comes out of the dark. The English dub plays it dead straight.

items.title: Iria: Wind Song
items.description: Iria shares a rocky hillside with a blond stranger in armor. A gold ornament, a gray-haired officer, a row of gunmen and a pink thing with far too many teeth turn up. English, and mostly after dark.

items.title: Green Legend Ran: Departure
items.description: A boy named Ran scrapes by in a wasteland where green is only a legend. This is the first of three, and the road starts here. The OVA takes its time with the sand. Pioneer's dub keeps the pace.

items.title: Green Legend Ran: Green 5
items.description: Part two. The scene moves into a cramped, rusting craft with a wounded passenger and a lot of people shouting through hatches. The Pioneer dub fits the claustrophobia. Nobody gets a window seat.

items.title: Green Legend Ran: Holy Green
items.description: A cavern city, a giant stone hand and a woman in a red robe. The last of three, where the desert wraps things up on its own terms.

items.id: Yankee-Reppuu-tai-3/ヤンキー烈風隊 3 壮絶仁義なき抗争 1990.mp4
items.title: Yankee Reppuu-tai III: A Feud Without Honor
items.description: A rival gang in matching jumpsuits, tattooed yakuza and car chases in the dust. The title borrows from the old yakuza films. It airs in Japanese with subtitles. The roadside diner is the quiet part.

items.id: Yankee-Reppuu-tai-4/ヤンキー烈風隊 4 恐怖の命取り合戦 1991_360p.mp4
items.title: Yankee Reppuu-tai IV: The Battle to Take Lives
items.description: The delinquent gang war stops being a brawl. The title uses gang slang for a life, and it means it. It airs in Japanese with subtitles. The fists were the polite part.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E021.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: The Palace of Evil in Flames!
items.description: Kenshiro fights through Shin's army and lieutenants in Southern Cross. Shin promises Yuria the world. The two rivals end up face to face, and the series has been walking toward it.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 1/Fist of the North Star S1E022.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Conclusion of Chapter One
items.description: Kenshiro reaches Shin's pyramid tower and faces him over Yuria. The first part of the story ends here. It is a good place to stop for the night.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 2/Fist of the North Star S2E01.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Chapter Two: Stormy Times, Titanic Battles
items.description: Chapter two begins. Mamiya and Rei face a pack of claw-handed raiders, and Kenshiro is not far behind. New faces, same wasteland, and the stakes get bigger without getting any quieter.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 2/Fist of the North Star S2E02.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Nanto Suichoken!
items.description: The Fang Clan keeps raiding. Kenshiro and the silver-haired fighter in white stand against them. Lin and Bat are caught in the middle, as usual.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 2/Fist of the North Star S2E03.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Sinners! - Thy Name Is Fang!
items.description: The Fang Clan's claws come for a village of women and children. Kenshiro and Rei stand between them and the clan. The clan's big man is not used to being told no.

items.title: Robot Carnival
items.description: Nine short films about machines, opening on a rusted carnival grinding over a desert village. Hardly anyone talks, so the dub never comes up. The best shuffle button on the rental shelf.

items.id: desert-rose-the-snow-apocalypse-1993-upscaled-anime-rare-films-upscaled-1080p-1/Desert Rose The Snow Apocalypse (1993) - Upscaled Anime - Rare Films Upscaled (1080p) (1).ia.mp4
items.title: Desert Rose: The Snow Apocalypse
items.description: Mariko leads an anti-terror squad after an airport bomb takes her family, and a summit in the snow needs her team. Grown-up and violent. This sat on the other end of the shelf from the cute stuff.

items.title: Perfect Blue
items.description: A pop idol quits her group to become an actress, and someone online starts writing as her. Satoshi Kon's first feature. Rough going, and the lights stay on in the room afterward.

items.id: Yankee-Reppuu-tai-5/ヤンキー烈風隊 5 血の掟 遠州血ﾞ獄一家 1994.mp4
items.title: Yankee Reppuu-tai V: The Blood Code
items.description: The Enshu gang family is the new enemy, and the feud runs two tapes. This copy stops mid-scene, before the credits. It airs in Japanese with subtitles. Nobody planned that cliffhanger.

items.id: Yankee-Reppuu-tai-6/ヤンキー烈風隊 6 最終話血の決着遠州血ﾞ獄一家 1996_360p.mp4
items.title: Yankee Reppuu-tai VI: The Blood Showdown
items.description: The feud with the Enshu family gets settled, and the series ends. It airs in Japanese with subtitles. Six tapes of turf wars, and this is the last one on the shelf.

items.id: fist-of-the-north-star-1984/Fist of the North Star (1984)/Season 2/Fist of the North Star S2E04.mp4
items.title: Fist of the North Star: Tremble & Die!
items.description: Kenshiro and Rei close in on the Fang Clan's chief, with Mamiya's people at their back. The title reads like a warning. It is a prediction.

items.title: Dallos, Part 1
items.description: Earth runs the Moon's mining colonies from far off, and a young worker named Shun starts asking why. Out on the surface sits something huge and ancient the settlers guard. The first OVA ever made.

items.title: Dallos, Part 2
items.description: The settlers' grumbling turns into a resistance, and Earth's security forces stop asking nicely. Shun is caught between his friends and the garrison. Mamoru Oshii directs, a dozen years before Ghost in the Shell.

items.title: Dallos, Part 3
items.description: Both sides are armed now, and the old giant on the lunar surface matters more to the settlers than either side lets on. Early-eighties mecha and moonscapes, drawn for home video when nobody knew if that would sell.

items.title: Dallos, Part 4
items.description: The last of the four: the Moon's settlers and Earth's garrison have one part left to decide who the Moon belongs to. How it ends is the tape's to tell. Japanese, with English subtitles.

items.title: Toonami's First Block (Mar. 17, '97)
items.description: Before TOM took the console, Moltar ran Toonami, and this tape catches the very first broadcast whole: ThunderCats and Voltron among them, Polly Pocket in the breaks and the block's own credits at the close.

items.title: DBZ: Enter Goku (Nov. '98)
items.description: November 10, 1998. Dragon Ball Z's first run on Toonami, Ocean dub, original airing with the commercials still in. Goku finally lands. Everyone at school saw this one.

items.title: Sailor Moon (Toonami, Dec. '98)
items.description: December 1998, the winter of Sailor Moon's lost episodes. Half an hour of the Sailor Scouts off the Cartoon Network VHS, Sailor Says and all, with the commercials left in and a Super Chunk promo on the way out.

items.title: Toonami Fall Block ('99)
items.description: Fall '99. School just started but Toonami doesn't care. TOM's running the lineup and the leaves are changing outside a window you're not looking through.

items.title: Cartoon Network Toonami Block (Sept. '99)
items.description: September '99 Toonami. First week of school and you're already counting the hours until 4 PM. The Absolution doesn't recognize summer vacation — the block runs year-round.

items.id: ToonamiSMReBootAndDBZJuly14th1999WOC/Toonami SM, ReBoot and DBZ July 14th 1999 WOC.mp4
items.title: Sailor Moon, ReBoot & DBZ (July '99)
items.description: The Toonami triple threat — Sailor Moon, ReBoot, and Dragon Ball Z stacked back to back. Three different worlds, one afternoon, zero reason to change the channel.

items.title: DBZ, Jonny Quest & Batman (July 29 '99)
items.description: July 29, 1999. First-generation tape, wall-to-wall commercials. The tail end of ReBoot, then Dragon Ball Z, The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest, Batman: The Animated Series, and Animaniacs. The whole afternoon, no skipping.

items.id: ocwoc-033-toonami-full-block-sailor-moon-re-boot-dbz-jonny-quest-cn-1999/OCWOC 033 - Toonami Full Block - Sailor Moon, ReBoot, DBZ, Jonny Quest (CN, 1999).ia.mp4
items.title: Toonami Full Block: Sailor Moon, ReBoot, DBZ & Jonny Quest (CN, 1999)
items.description: The edges are the best part: the tape opens on a TNT promo for L.A. Heat and rolls out as Cartoon Network sets up Batman at 6:00 and Animaniacs at 6:30. Sailor Moon, ReBoot and Dragon Ball Z in between, breaks intact.

items.title: Dragon Ball Z: Pathos of Frieza (Toonami, Oct. '99)
items.description: Namek's clock is running down and Goku and Frieza are still trading blows, caught off Toonami by a home VCR in Hartford, Connecticut. The break afterward sells a WCW Nitro Arena toy and M&M's.

items.title: Sailor Moon, ReBoot & DBZ (Apr. '99)
items.description: Moltar-era Toonami with the ads left in: a Mummy trailer promising May 7, Sports Illustrated for Kids, a Dexter's Lab promo. Sailor Moon, ReBoot and Dragon Ball Z fill the rest, and the block closes by asking viewers to write in.

items.title: Toonami Midnight Run (Winter '00)
items.description: The Midnight Run. Toonami goes nocturnal. Same shows, different frequency — everything hits harder when the house is dark and you're the only one still watching.

items.title: Toonami Fall Tape (Fall '00)
items.description: Fall 2000. TOM's broadcasting from the Absolution and the lineup is dialed in. Three hours of the block at full power. Grab a seat on the couch and don't touch that dial.

items.title: Toonami Winter Tape (Winter '00)
items.description: Dead of winter, 2000. Snow piling up outside, anime piling up inside. Three hours of Toonami recorded while the rest of the world was asleep or frozen.

items.title: Toonami Full Cycle (April '00)
items.description: A complete Toonami rotation from April 2000. Every show, every TOM bump, every commercial break preserved in order. This is what the block sounded like when it was locked in.

items.title: Toonami & More (2000)
items.description: Toonami mixed with Disney and Nick recordings on the same VHS. Somebody was channel surfing but kept coming back. Toonami always pulls you back.

items.title: Toonami: Tenchi Muyo (Sept. '00)
items.description: September 2000. An hour of Tenchi on Toonami. Ryoko, Ayeka, and a house full of problems from outer space. TOM ran it straight through. So should you.

items.title: Toonami Full Cycle Marathon (2000)
items.description: A tape from the deep and dark part of the uploader's collection: Toonami's Full Cycle marathon, ThunderCats to Ronin Warriors, Powerpuff Girls and a Dragon Ball Z movie between, a Freehold Mitsubishi ad left in.

items.title: Toonami: Dragon Ball Z & Tenchi (DirecTV, Oct. '00)
items.description: October 3, 2000, off DirecTV. Dragon Ball Z opens the tape, then a mecha hour and Tenchi, with Hot Wheels, Max Steel and My Real Baby between the breaks. The Toonami Version credits roll, one last break, and the block is done.

items.title: Toonami: Sailor Moon & DBZ (late '00)
items.description: A home recording of TOM's block from late 2000, and the breaks are the time capsule: McDonald's, LEGO, AOL and a Grinch ad. Sailor Moon and Dragon Ball Z fill the block, and a Comcast spot signs the tape off.

items.title: Toonami ('01)
items.description: Someone hit record on Toonami in 2001 and captured a perfect afternoon. TOM introduces, the shows deliver, the commercials fill the gaps. This is how it was.

items.title: Midnight Run Special Edition (Nov. '01)
items.description: The Midnight Run Special Edition. November 2001. TOM pulls the deep cuts for a late-night marathon. The schedule's different after midnight — heavier, stranger, better.

items.title: Toonami New Year's Evil ('01)
items.description: New Year's Day 2001. While everyone else is recovering, Toonami drops a marathon. Nearly four hours of the block ringing in the millennium the only way that matters.

items.title: Toonami Midnight Run (Feb. '01)
items.description: A flea market VHS of the Midnight Run: Dragon Ball Z, then Outlaw Star, ads intact, until the ACME Hour starts a Popeye and the tape gives out near the end. The block doesn't stop. The tape did.

items.title: Toonami: Sailor Moon S & DBZ ('01)
items.description: Toonami, 2001. Sailor Moon S and Dragon Ball Z, with the Absolution drifting between shows and TOM on watch. The Sailor Scouts are back on the schedule where they belong.

items.title: Gundam & Midnight Run: Gorillaz / Daft Punk (Toonami, Aug. '01)
items.description: Nine nights of Mobile Suit Gundam, then Midnight Run: Gorillaz and Daft Punk videos, the Daft Punk set from a film supervised by Captain Harlock's Leiji Matsumoto. Late August 2001, five and a half hours.

items.title: Dragon Ball Z on Toonami (Cartoon Network, 2001)
items.description: Five hours of Dragon Ball Z straight off Toonami: Goku, Gohan and Cell trading blows, with the bumpers, a Hot Wheels spot, a Burger King ad and a Tenchi in Tokyo promo kept in between rounds. Stay for the Goku's Noble Decision title card.

items.id: toonami-midnight-run-vhs-with-commercials-gorillaz-daft-punk-kenna/Toonami Midnight Run VHS with Commercials Gorillaz, Daft Punk, Kenna.mp4
items.title: Toonami Midnight Run Special: Gorillaz & Daft Punk (2001)
items.description: Toonami's Midnight Run: TOM strings together Daft Punk's One More Time and Gorillaz' Clint Eastwood, taped off the VCR with the tracking display still glowing, local ads and all. The block doesn't stop.

items.title: Toonami Lockdown: Dragon Ball & Dragon Ball Z (2001)
items.description: A Nintendo GameCube ad runs here two months before the console even launched. Dragon Ball and Dragon Ball Z do the rest, Goku, Bulma and Master Roshi, with Harry Potter cards in the breaks.

items.id: cartoon-network-toonami-2002-11-xx-dragon-ball-dragon-ball-z-he-man-transformers/Cartoon Network, Toonami - 2002-11-XX - DragonBall, DragonBall Z, He-Man, Transformers.mp4
items.title: Dragon Ball, DBZ, He-Man & Transformers (Nov. '02)
items.description: November 2002. Dragon Ball, Dragon Ball Z, He-Man, and Transformers — four pillars of the block in one sitting. The lineup card reads like a greatest hits.

items.title: Trapped in Hyperspace (Sept. '02)
items.description: The Trapped in Hyperspace event. TOM fights for control of the Absolution across two days of programming. The block becomes the story. Interactive Toonami at its most ambitious.

items.title: G Gundam, Dragon Ball & DBZ (Toonami, Sept. '02)
items.description: Scooby-Doo and Hamtaro warm up a Cartoon Network afternoon off the VCR, then Toonami takes over with G Gundam, the Gundam where the pilots fight like martial artists, plus Dragon Ball and DBZ.

items.title: Dragon Ball Z, He-Man & Transformers Armada (Toonami, Nov.)
items.description: Weekday Toonami, picked up mid-break and signing off on the Toonami card. The odd pairing: He-Man in his 2002 reboot, sharing an afternoon with Dragon Ball Z and a Harry Potter trailer.

items.title: Toonami Midnight Run (Sept. 2, '02)
items.description: Adult Swim turned one the day this aired, and an Inuyasha promo already points at Saturday night at 11. Meanwhile Midnight Run rolls Dragon Ball with Chair Flair Barbie and a Time-Life soul compilation.

items.id: ocwoc-030-toonami-justice-league-dbz-cyborg-009-yu-yu-hakusho-cn-2003/OCWOC 030 - Toonami - Justice League, DBZ, Cyborg 009, Yu Yu Hakusho (CN, 2003).ia.mp4
items.title: Toonami: Justice League, DBZ, Cyborg 009 & Yu Yu Hakusho (CN, Aug. '03)
items.description: Cyborg 009, created by Shotaro Ishinomori in the 1960s, gets its finale on a night with Justice League, Dragon Ball Z and Yu Yu Hakusho. Toonami's LATER card closes it, a Teen Titans promo in the break.

items.id: Toonami-April-2004-vhs/Toonami April 24th, 2004 Part 1 (Samsung Version, better audio).mp4
items.title: Toonami Block (April '04)
items.description: April 2004. The SARA era of the Absolution. Nearly a full block preserved — the lineup, the bumps, the ambient hum of a space station broadcasting anime to Earth.

items.title: Naruto, One Piece, Bobobo & IGPX (Toonami, July 1 '06)
items.description: IGPX, the racing anime Toonami co-produced with Production I.G, premieres its Comeback episode here, between Naruto, One Piece and Bobobo. July 1, 2006, new episodes all night, audio a little quiet.

items.title: Naruto, Zatch Bell! & MAR (Toonami, Dec. 23 '06)
items.description: Night at the Museum had opened the day before, and its trailer is still on this tape beside Eragon, a local Austin Toros ad and a McDonald's snow spot. Seven shows, two days before Christmas, ads left in.

items.title: Naruto & Dragon Ball Z (Toonami, Winter '07-'08)
items.description: Toonami's Cartoon Network run would end in September 2008, so this winter is late in the day: hours of Naruto, a cable guide floating over Dragon Ball Z at 10:56 PM, and Nerf and Walmart Christmas ads.

items.title: Blue Submarine No. 6 (Original Broadcast)
items.description: Blue Submarine No. 6 as it originally aired on Toonami. Undersea anime warfare with TOM's intros and the original commercial breaks intact. This is the broadcast version.

items.title: Dragon Ball on Toonami
items.description: The beginning of everything. Twelve episodes of Dragon Ball as they aired on Toonami — young Goku, the Dragon Balls, and every commercial break between destiny and dinner.

items.title: Giant Robot Week
items.description: Giant Robot Week. Mechs, Gundams, and machines the size of buildings — six hours of Toonami dedicated to the biggest bots in anime. TOM approved this schedule personally.

items.title: Adult Swim Premiere Night (Sept. '01)
items.description: September 2001. The first night. Home Movies, The Brak Show, Harvey Birdman, Sealab 2021, Space Ghost with Björk, Cowboy Bebop at midnight, then ToonHeads and a week of Gundam. The pool opens.

items.title: Adult Swim Block (Sept. 9, '01)
items.description: The block's second Sunday, the night Aqua Teen Hunger Force joins the lineup, and two days before September 11 made everyone stop thinking about cartoons. A tape from the last ordinary week.

items.title: Adult Swim Block (Nov. '01)
items.description: November 4, 2001. Two half-hours of a crude little cartoon with the breaks in. Linkin Park at Best Buy, Compaq, a Sleep Number bed. The pool is open. No diving.

items.title: Late Night Cartoon Network (Winter '01)
items.description: Winter 2001. Cartoon Network after the watershed. The colors change. The bumps slow down. The pool is open.

items.id: vhs-tape-letterman-adult-swim-anime/VHS Tape - Letterman, Adult Swim Anime.ia.mp4
items.title: Leno, Dragon Ball & Adult Swim ('02)
items.description: Someone set the VCR for Leno and let it run: a minute of Jay, then Goku and Krillin at the tournament, InuYasha when Adult Swim takes over near midnight, then back to Dragon Ball.

items.title: Adult Swim Block (March '02)
items.description: March 2002. Six months after launch. Adult Swim is still figuring out what it is. Two hours of a network finding its voice in the dark.

items.id: vhs-tape-tss-they-might-be-giants-09-09-2002-adult-swim/VHS Tape - TSS They Might Be Giants 09-09-2002, Adult Swim.ia.mp4
items.title: Adult Swim Block (Sept. '02)
items.description: A half-finished They Might Be Giants clip from TechTV opens the tape, then the dial lands on Cartoon Network and the Adult Swim cartoons run. Somebody keeps flipping to Comedy Central. They always come back.

items.id: vhs-tape-tss-they-might-be-giants-09-09-2002-adult-swim/VHS Tape - TSS They Might Be Giants 09-09-2002, Adult Swim.ia.mp4
items.title: Adult Swim Block (Sept. '02)
items.description: The second half of the night, for anyone who stayed up. The bumpers say 'Hi.' and mean it, and the mecha anime arrives right when you've stopped asking why you're awake.

items.title: Adult Swim Full Block (Nov. '02)
items.description: November 3, 2002. Nearly the full block. Space Ghost. Brak. Harvey Birdman. The bumps between shows last longer than they should and that's the point.

items.title: Adult Swim Block (Nov. '02)
items.description: November 24, 2002. Space Ghost Coast to Coast, Welcome to Eltingville, Sealab 2021, Aqua Teen Hunger Force, The Brak Show, The Oblongs. Treasure Planet is in theaters. The pool has a notice posted. Nobody reads it.

items.title: Adult Swim Anime Block (Nov. '02)
items.description: November 30, 2002. Toonami runs out, then Inuyasha, Yu Yu Hakusho, Cowboy Bebop, Gundam and Outlaw Star. Taped in Puerto Rico, so a toy ad or two comes in Spanish. Somebody stayed up for Outlaw Star.

items.id: classic-adult-swim-vhs-gundam-0080-ms-gundam-outlaw-star-digimon/Classic Adult Swim VHS Gundam 0080, MS Gundam, Outlaw Star, Digimon.mp4
items.title: Adult Swim Anime Block (Dec. '02)
items.description: Gundam 0080, Mobile Suit Gundam, and Outlaw Star. The 2002 anime lineup that kept you up past the point of no return.

items.title: Adult Swim and WB Night (Dec. '02)
items.description: December 2002. Two Gundam episodes, Harvey Birdman, then the dial moves to the WB for Birds of Prey. Cartoon Network after dark, with a long detour.

items.id: adult-swims-new-years-eve-bash-2002-full-episodes-with-commercials/Adult Swim's New Year's Eve Bash! ¦ 2002 ¦ Full Episodes with Commercials.ia.mp4
items.title: Adult Swim New Year's Eve (Dec. '02)
items.description: Brak in Times Square between the shows, a cartoon seeing in the new year. In January the block gets Futurama reruns, which did well enough to help bring the cancelled show back.

items.title: Adult Swim Block ('02)
items.description: 2002. Pool bumps. White text on black. Shows you've never heard of that you'll never forget. This is what the swim felt like before you knew it had a name.

items.id: adult-swim-saturday-night-2002-full-episodes-with-commercials/Adult Swim – Saturday Night   2002   Full Episodes with Commercials (360p_30fps_H264-128kbit_AAC).ia.mp4
items.title: Adult Swim Saturday Night ('02)
