items.description: This is the restored Disney Plus print, so the bones have never looked better. The only thing left to say about skeletons playing each other like xylophones is that the music is excellent.

items.title: Silly Symphony: Springtime
items.description: The third Silly Symphony ever, directed by Ub Iwerks with music by Carl W. Stalling. The series was still working out what it was for, and a frog or two was enough.

items.title: Mickey's Follies
items.description: Mickey puts on a show in the barnyard. Hens line up, a cow gets a soap box and Mickey sings and plays a saxophone that has passengers. The outhouse does not survive the finale.

items.title: Mickey Mouse: The Opry House
items.description: Ub Iwerks animated it, Carl Stalling wrote the music, and the best performance is the piano's, which gets a grin and a walk of its own. Mickey just works there, turban and all.

items.title: Mickey Mouse: When the Cat's Away
items.description: The proverb is the plot: when the cat is away the mice play, and here they do it on the player piano. The Archive's copy is the restored Disney Plus print, for a cleaner party.

items.title: Mickey Mouse: The Karnival Kid
items.description: Six animators are credited, Ub Iwerks first, with Carl Stalling on the music, all to sell hot dogs at a carnival. It is Mickey's first speaking part, and it shows.

items.title: Mickey Mouse: The Fire Fighters
items.description: Burt Gillett directed this early Mickey sound cartoon, released by Columbia Pictures, and the hoses, ladders and engines all move in time with the music. Rhythm is the whole fire department.

items.title: Puppetoon: What Ho, She Bumps
items.description: Wooden puppet sailors aboard the H.M.S. Hopeful meet a pirate ship under a skull flag and a very long table of cannons. George Pal's figures swap faces between frames. Technicolor, eight minutes.

items.title: Charley Bowers: It's a Bird
items.description: A map marks the home of the metal eating bird. It comes out from under a boulder, finds a junkyard and a Model T and gets to work. A Lowell Thomas tall story, in stop motion.

items.id: merrie-melodies-a-hatful-of-dreams/Merrie Melodies - A Hatful of Dreams.ia.mp4
items.title: Puppetoon: A Hatful of Dreams
items.description: A boy in patched pants wishes for gold and mink for a girl named Judy, in a George Pal Puppetoon where every frame swaps in a new carved wooden figure. Pal earned an honorary Oscar for the technique.

items.id: 1936LENLYETHEBIRTHOFTHEROBOT/1936 LEN LYE THE BIRTH OF THE ROBOT.mp4
items.title: The Birth of the Robot
items.description: Gasparcolor puppets play music among the stars, then a jointed metal man wakes in the desert and ends up directing traffic. The sponsor is Shell Oil and it gets the last word.

items.title: Twas the Night Before Christmas
items.description: The Archive's only note is My work, the shortest credit on the channel and not much help. The puppets perform the poem line by line, which at least makes it easy to follow along.

items.title: Puppetoon: Tubby the Tuba
items.description: Someone ran this through an AI upscaler, so a 1947 puppet tuba now looks sharper than most things you own. He still only wants a tune of his own.

items.title: Nicky Nome: Peg Leg Pedro
items.description: General Motors paid for a pirate story so that a Chevrolet could turn up at the end. Nicky Nome hosts, the gold is a decoy, and the car is the treasure.

items.title: Albert in Blunderland
items.description: A dream cartoon built as an argument against New Deal liberalism, which is a lot to ask of one worker named Albert. Politics goes down lighter in Blunderland.

items.title: A Hitch in Time
items.description: The Air Force wanted its airmen to sign up again, so it got Chuck Jones and a small fairy with a wand. The fairy makes the case for staying in. It's a recruiting film. It's better than it had to be.

items.title: So Much for So Little
items.description: A Warner Bros. cartoon for the US Public Health Service follows one baby, Johnny Jones, from the cradle to old age, and won the Documentary Short Oscar, tying with A Chance to Live.

items.title: La Joie de Vivre
items.description: Two sprites dance on power lines, a man on a bicycle chases them, and every so often everyone stops to pull a lever and switch a train. It's a tone poem by Anthony Gross and Hector Hoppin, so nobody asks why.

items.title: Your Very Good Health
items.description: Charley has the National Health Service explained to him by a narrator who is very sure of it. There is a bicycle, a tandem, an X ray and a lot of numbers. Technicolor, British and reassuring.

items.title: Dizzy Dishes
items.description: A waiter has a nightclub full of trouble, and the singer with floppy ears is the very first Betty Boop, back when she was still a poodle. The kitchen is the real danger.

items.title: Hunky and Spunky: Snubbed by a Snob
items.description: The horse's mother is the snob of the title, and the cartoon corrects her with a bull. Spunky is the donkey, and the channel is firmly on his side.

items.title: Hunky and Spunky: Always Kickin'
items.description: Spunky copies the birds precisely, nest and all, and is the only one surprised when the flying part fails. Hunky only wanted him to kick better.

items.title: Musical Memories
items.description: Stereoscopic photographs are how this old couple get back to their courtship, and the pictures obligingly move. It's 1935, and looking back is already the national pastime.

items.title: Hunky and Spunky: The Barnyard Brat
items.description: A newcomer takes over the farm and the corn, so the hens, lambs and rooster hold a meeting, which is what farms do instead of a plan. Dave Fleischer and Myron Waldman directed.

items.title: Color Classics: Ants in the Plants
items.description: The queen's warning about the anteater rhymes: "He's a menace, he's a brute, he will scoop you with his snoot." The ants' motto is make him yell uncle, and they have a poster.

items.title: Color Classics: Greedy Humpty Dumpty
items.description: Humpty Dumpty keeps building his wall higher, and every warning just makes him add a row. It is one of the 36 Color Classics, and the nursery rhyme gave away the ending first.

items.title: Hunky and Spunky: You Can't Shoe a Horsefly
items.description: The fly is doing all the work and the donkeys are doing all the suffering, which suits a cartoon whose title puns on shooing. Hunky and Spunky have had worse.

items.title: Color Classics: Bunny Mooning
items.description: Jack and Jill Rabbit get married, and the whole cartoon is puns holding hands, starting with the title. It is one of 36 Color Classics, and the wedding is set for tree o'clock.

items.title: Color Classics: The Tears of an Onion
items.description: The vegetables come out to play at harvest time. An onion does most of the crying. By the end he has a tomato beside him and a heart over their heads, which is a good result for a root.

items.title: Talkartoons: Wise Flies
items.description: The Talkartoons ran from 1929 until Betty Boop took over in 1932, and in this one the flies take a stand on wisdom. The spider has an opinion, mostly about lunch.

items.title: Noveltoons: Cilly Goose
items.description: A goose with a can of gold paint turns an egg into an act. The Square Garden books her on the strength of it. The audience takes a lively interest in the eggs. Nine minutes of poultry finance.

items.title: Dawg Gawn
items.description: The dogcatcher goes fishing for a puppy, which tells you what kind of cartoon this is: a song, a chase and a dog nobody can catch. The little girl is the only one asking nicely.

items.title: Little Lulu: A Bout with a Trout
items.description: Little Lulu is torn between school and fishing, and picks fishing, where she meets what the Archive calls "the Fish from Cartoon Hades". The classroom was the safer option.

items.title: Little Lulu: Snap Happy
items.description: Lulu is the one who is happy to be snapped, and the photographer is the one with the camera, which is the whole difficulty. He would pay good money to be elsewhere.

items.title: Casper's Spree Under the Sea
items.description: Casper was thrown out of the Society of Ghosts for not liking to scare people, which he should have mentioned on the application. He starred in 55 theatrical cartoons anyway.

items.title: Baby Huey: Starting from Hatch
items.description: A duck lays an egg the size of a bed. A fox in an apron plans dinner around it, with a pot and a knife. The cradle comes into it. So does the baby.

items.title: Magica-Lulu
items.description: Nobody asked Lulu to join the magic act, and nobody could have stopped her. The gag to watch for is the one where she is mistaken for the rabbit, who has to share the hat.

items.title: Little Lulu: Man's Pest Friend
items.description: Lulu's whole case against the pound is that Pal is hers, and it holds up well against a man with a net and a van. Grown men never do get what they want from Lulu.

items.title: Snap Happy Traps
items.description: A bear asks for a cat and gets a tiger cub, which any pest controller would call a mistake. Glow in the dark paint is the mice's idea of a reply.

items.title: Little Lulu: Beau Ties
items.description: Fatso promises marriage to get out of trouble, then gets a bump on the head and a preview of the bill: a hellish household of Lulu look-alikes. Carve your promises in smaller trees.

items.title: Tweety: A Tale of Two Kitties
items.description: This is the restored HBO Max print, so you can count every feather on the one bird two cats cannot get. The print is restored. The cats are not.

items.title: Merrie Melodies: Boulevardier from the Bronx
items.description: Restored from an HBO Max print, which is a lot of care for a rooster in a Giants uniform. The country ball team has a turtle catching, and the park is full.

items.id: 1935-buddy-the-gee-man-restored-titles/1935 buddy the gee man restored titles.ia.mp4
items.title: Buddy the Gee Man
items.description: Federal Agent Buddy goes to Sing Song Prison to check how the warden treats the inmates, and becomes warden himself. Free ice cream follows, then a pardon, and a sign that says No Vacancies.

items.title: Hamateur Night
items.description: An amateur night for animals, run by a tuxedoed dog. There is a judge with a gavel, a tuba band, a magician's trunk and a balcony scene. The last act is a house full of small men in hats.

items.title: My Green Fedora
items.description: Hat first, judgement second: a rabbit in a green fedora strolls down the road and straight into a wolf's cave, where a campfire and a sack are already set out.

items.title: Pigs in a Polka
items.description: The wolf is in white tie and introduces the three little pigs like a master of ceremonies, which in a cartoon called a polka is the correct level of formality. He is flattened more than once anyway.

items.title: Sniffles and the Bookworm
items.description: Sniffles the mouse nibbles his way into a library of living books and meets a bookworm in glasses. A character in green steps out of Ivanhoe, and Porky Pig's biography is offered on easy payments.

items.title: The Mice Will Play
items.description: Mice in a laboratory pass bacteria slides and an eye test department and find a note signed by Susie Mouse: "I'm in the next room. Save me!" A cat sleeps in a flask. A wedding is held by the test tubes.

items.title: Snowman's Land
items.description: The Archive's copy is a restored HBO Max print, so the snow has never looked cleaner. Dirty Pierre is wanted on every poster, and the only lawman who goes north for him is very small.

items.id: looney-tunes-s-1938-e-09-a-star-is-hatched/Looney Tunes - S1938E09 - A Star is Hatched.mp4
items.title: A Star Is Hatched
items.description: The hen in the bonnet leaves a town that runs three businesses off one sign, and anyone would. Ambition has never looked sillier, or been more reasonable.

items.title: Now That Summer Is Gone
items.description: Squirrels pack away nuts for the winter, with a dice game and a fence somewhere in the budget. Then it snows, and an excuse arrives about a gang of fifty bandits and a terrific struggle.

items.title: Streamlined Greta Green
items.description: A town of living cars, and a small blue one who sets out for the open road past a traffic light, a gas pump and a railroad crossing. A locomotive is involved. Someone says "Oh dear" six times.

items.title: Hare-um Scare-um
items.description: This is the restored HBO Max print, so the hat changes and the crowds of rabbits come through clean. The hunter's hound has a hard day regardless.

items.title: Daffy Duck: To Duck or Not to Duck
items.description: Elmer Fudd goes duck hunting and Daffy Duck steers the afternoon into a boxing ring, with a large duck in a bathrobe on his side. The announcer calls it: new champion, Daffy Duck.

items.title: Tea Pot Town
items.description: The Ancient Order of the Droops is sent to make everybody grouchy, and nobody tells the teapots. Ted Eshbaugh, who animated an Oz short in 1933, built the town.

items.id: binko-the-dog-in-hot-toe-mollie-1930/Binko the dog in Hot Toe Mollie (1930).mp4
items.title: Binko the Dog: Hot-Toe Mollie
items.description: The Archive says this comes from a rare Tommy Stathes CARTOON ROOTS blu ray set, so somebody saved a dog crossing a desert to a dance hall. Preservation is a calling.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: The Calico Dragon
items.description: MGM let Harman and Ising lavish Technicolor on a bedtime story: a girl's quilt becomes a patchwork country with a three-headed calico dragon, which sounds worse than it looks.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: Tale of the Vienna Woods
items.description: The fox chases the faun, the book closes at nightfall, and nobody is hurt: Happy Harmonies, MGM's answer to Disney's Silly Symphonies, made by Hugh Harman and Rudolf Ising.

items.title: Goofy Goat
items.description: A goat with a very wide grin drives a small car around a town of animals, calls at a glee club and ends the night by a lake in good company. Music and a lot of barking.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: To Spring
items.description: This is the first cartoon William Hanna ever directed, long before Tom and Jerry or The Flintstones. The gnomes' job is spring, and the cartoon takes the work seriously.

items.id: peaceonearth1939_202107/More stuffPeace On Earth (1939) - Classic MGM Cartoon (1).mp4
items.title: Peace on Earth
items.description: Hugh Harman's Christmas cartoon, from the eve of the war: two kits by the fire hear of a world without people, left to the animals. Said to be the only cartoon nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize.

items.title: Willie Whopper: Hell's Fire
items.description: Willie Whopper climbs a volcano for a story and falls into the one place where tall tales get audited. One of the devils wears a sash marked PROHIBITION.

items.title: Gran Pop Monkey: A Busy Day
items.description: Thought lost until Steve Stanchfield found fragments of it. Gran Pop survives too, barely: a folding hammock, a cold shower and a lever marked DOWN do their worst while a young monkey asks about the list.

items.title: Gran Pop Monkey: Beauty Shoppe
items.description: One of three Gran Pop Monkey cartoons, thought lost until Steve Stanchfield found fragments and uploaded them. A hippo, a badger and a penguin are the customers.

items.title: Willie Whopper: Play Ball
items.description: Willie Whopper tells the one about the time he pitched the World Series. The Statue of Liberty raises a beer. The ticker tape parade is real footage, so that part must be true. The rest is Willie.

items.title: Gran Pop Monkey: Baby Checkers
items.description: A coat check for babies, and Gran Pop is sure it eliminates any mix-up. An elephant, a skunk and a room of crying infants will test that. Another reel Steve Stanchfield saved from fragments.

items.title: Willie Whopper: Spite Flight
items.description: Ub Iwerks built Willie Whopper to fib, and the fib here is an air race against a rival with the bigger plane, plus a canyon, a train tunnel and, briefly, an angel. The exaggeration is the point.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: Hey-Hey Fever
items.description: A cereal billboard is the best hook in advertising, and a boy and his dog follow it straight into Mother Goose land. The Old Woman in the Shoe is at home. The channel has not tried the cereal.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: Good Little Monkeys
items.description: The devil puts on a whole production to corrupt three monkeys, who came with a proverb. It is a mismatch in staging if nothing else.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: Seal Skinners
items.description: MGM's Captain and the Kids came out of the old Katzenjammer comic strip, and here the Captain chases a loose million-dollar circus seal north while the reward climbs. The seals come out ahead.

items.title: Willie Whopper: Rasslin' Round
items.description: Willie Whopper reads about the Masked Marvel and tells the one about wrestling him. The Marvel lifts a thousand pounds. Willie has a girl in the front row and a bottle.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: The Wayward Pups
items.description: Two pups leave the house, which is where every dog story starts. The chained bulldog is the street's first lesson and the large black cat is the second. Neither pup takes notes.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: Petunia National Park
items.description: Put the Captain in charge of anything and the cartoon has a rule: he will be wrong about it. A national park is a lot to be wrong about, with geysers and bears.

items.title: Willie Whopper: The Cave Man
items.description: Ub Iwerks sends Willie from a museum skeleton to the Stone Age, where the cave has his name on the door and the dinosaur smiles. A tall tale that skips the explanation and goes straight to the leopard skin.

items.title: Willie Whopper: Reducing Creme
items.description: A baker's cream will not stop rising. It fills the bathroom, takes over the kitchen and swells past anyone's control. Willie, a cat and a mouse all get caught in it. Eight minutes of foam.

items.title: Willie Whopper: The Good Scout
items.description: A good deed is only as good as its follow through, and Willie Whopper's follow through is a man in a puddle. The Scouts have a motto, and he has his own reading of it.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: Little Cheeser
items.description: A mouse in blue overalls is worked on by a red devil mouse and a pale blue angel mouse, with a pipe, a matchstick bed and a jug as props. Nine minutes in Technicolor. The angel gets him to bed.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: The Winning Ticket
items.description: The Captain starts with a radio announcer and a pile of white stuff and ends up on a raft under a pirate flag with a cannon, passing a hooped gown, a boy with rockets and a fair amount of shouting. Nine minutes.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: Old Smokey
items.description: The Captain runs a fire department of one engine and one horse. A call comes in, the engine rolls through the hills, and the horse turns out to have views.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: When the Cat's Away
items.description: The proverb is the title, the plot and the closing line, which is efficient. The mice behave exactly as the proverb says, and the pantry bears it.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: Bottles
items.description: The chemist nods off and his shelf takes over: a perfume lady in red, a witch hazel witch, a skeleton guarding the poison. Harman and Ising used Technicolor like a candy counter.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: Blue Monday
items.description: The Captain's Monday starts in bed and goes downhill: a broom, a staircase, a stove and a long-bearded old man who takes most of what the house has to give. Nine minutes.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: Mama's New Hat
items.description: Nothing says a new hat can't take a horse to the roof, the bathtub and the path of a locomotive. Mama only wanted to try it on at the mirror.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: The Captain's Pup
items.description: The Captain buys a pup and loses the house to it room by room, which is the whole history of owning a dog. Pete's Pooch Palace should have posted a warning.

items.title: The Hound and the Rabbit
items.description: A football game of rabbits against a long black hound and a fox with a measuring stick, with a small rabbit in a red sweater in the middle of it. "He's going to make a touchdown."

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: Poultry Pirates
items.description: The title promises buccaneers and delivers hens. The Captain chases them with the dignity of a man leading a boarding party. The rooster has seen enough.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: What a Lion!
items.description: A cartoon jungle holds one lion and one idea, and the Captain walks in with neither a plan nor the sense to turn round. The lion, at least, is on home ground.

items.title: Willie Whopper: Stratos Fear
items.description: Stratos Fear is a stratosphere pun, and the cartoon commits: a dentist's gas, a space laboratory full of telescopes and mummies, and Willie back in the chair with no proof. Ub Iwerks made liars charming.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: Honeyland
items.description: Bees fill their pails in a flower meadow, a cook stirs a vat of honey, and a large black spider comes looking for trouble. The bees put on helmets about it.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: The Captain's Christmas
items.description: Santa Claus has more toys than sleigh, so the kids pitch in and the Captain gets drafted as well. A Christmas cartoon in which the helpers are the hazard.

items.id: mgm-cartoons-1938x-09-a-day-at-the-beach/MGM Cartoons - 1938x09 - A Day at the Beach.ia.mp4
items.title: The Captain and the Kids: A Day at the Beach
items.description: The Captain's rule at the shore is that anything that can go wrong near water will, before lunch. The lobster in the picnic basket seems to be the only one with a plan.

items.title: The Captain and the Kids: Honduras Hurricane
items.description: The title is the grandest name in the cartoon, and the fighters are roosters. The scale takes the worst of the weigh in, and the Captain is in a corner, which is all the training anyone gets.

items.title: ComiColor: Dick Whittington's Cat
items.description: Dick Whittington's rat-catching cat is an old English folk tale, here retold in Ub Iwerks's ComiColor series with a very large cheese and a top hat at the end.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: Little Buck Cheeser
items.description: Buck Rogers was a 1930s craze, so the mouse dreams him, builds a red rocket and goes to check whether the moon is cheese. He is back at home by morning.

items.title: Willie Whopper: Robin Hood Jr.
items.description: Willie's stories come with a warning built in: this one opens "Hey, did I ever tell you this one?" and ends up in Sherwood Forest and a castle full of guards, with arrows loose indoors.

items.title: Willie Whopper: Viva Willie
items.description: Willie walks into a desert cantina, picks a fight with a large bandit and wrecks the place in a cloud of stars. A girl waits on the porch at the end. She approves.

items.title: Happy Harmonies: Two Little Pups
items.description: The hen has the grudge, the pups have the free time and the vegetable garden gets no vote. Two white pups, one hen, and a lot of chasing in every direction.

items.title: Jack's Shack
items.description: Frank Moser and Paul Terry directed this one, a rhyme that adds one more thing every line, set on a farm. The scarecrow has the hardest job, and it is not scaring crows.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E01 - What a Night for a Knight.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: What a Night for a Knight
items.description: A suit of armor is up and walking at night, and Mystery Inc. looks into it. Scooby and Shaggy end up in the room with it. The gang calls this good coverage.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E02 - A Clue for Scooby-Doo.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: A Clue for Scooby-Doo
items.description: A glowing ghost diver turns up in the water, so Mystery Inc. puts on diving suits and goes under after it. Scooby-Doo takes the dive on the usual terms, which are snacks.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E03 - Hassle in the Castle.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: Hassle in the Castle
items.description: Scooby-Doo, Shaggy and the gang search a haunted castle, down its dungeon corridors and past a ghost that glows. Shaggy brings a sandwich, which is the only plan anyone had.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E04 - Mine Your Own Business.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: Mine Your Own Business
items.description: Mystery Inc. goes into an old mine to see about a ghost. Scooby and Shaggy ride a mine cart down the track, which the show considers a reasonable use of a mine.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E05 - Decoy for a Dognapper.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: Decoy for a Dognapper
items.description: Dogs are disappearing, and Scooby, to his regret, qualifies. A man in a trench coat takes him for a walk nobody approved, and Shaggy's whole investigation is getting his friend back.

items.title: The Flintstones: The Flintstone Flyer
items.description: Fred Flintstone ends up in a bandage and a headband, and Barney Rubble is nearby for all of it. Bedrock files this under a normal week between neighbors.

items.id: thejetsonsyndication/(BONUS!) The Flintstones 1x25 - In the Dough.mp4
items.title: The Flintstones: In the Dough
items.description: Bedrock holds a baking contest with a first-prize cake, and Fred Flintstone takes an interest. Barney Rubble supports him, as the situation requires. Skill is not listed among the entry rules.

items.id: the-flintstones-1961-10-20/The Flintstones - s02e06 1961-10-20 - The Rock Quarry Story [640x480] 25fps.mp4
items.title: The Flintstones: The Rock Quarry Story
items.description: Hollywood star Rock Quarry hides in Bedrock as Gus Schultz and befriends Fred and Barney, who suspect nothing. Wilma and Betty do. The alias was the only name in town that didn't sound like gravel.

items.id: the-flintstones-s-06-e-01-no-biz-like-show-biz/The Flintstones S06E01 No Biz Like Show Biz.mp4
items.title: The Flintstones: No Biz Like Show Biz
items.description: Pebbles and Bamm-Bamm get a stage, a banjo and a drum kit, and Bedrock treats it as a serious career for toddlers. Fred, who has watched a great deal of stone television, has notes.

items.id: the-flintstones-s-06-e-01-no-biz-like-show-biz/The Flintstones S06E02 The House That Fred Built.mp4
items.title: The Flintstones: The House That Fred Built
items.description: Fred takes on a home improvement job himself, with Barney helping and Wilma and Betty inspecting. There is paint, wallpaper and a lot of confidence. Bedrock's building code is not consulted.

items.title: The Jetsons: Rosey the Robot
items.description: Jane Jetson has had enough housework, so the family gets a robot maid named Rosey. Rosey takes the job seriously. The household finds out how seriously, in the usual order.

items.title: The Jetsons: A Date with Jet Screamer
items.description: Judy Jetson has a date with pop idol Jet Screamer, and her father George has views on it. The future has flying cars and orbiting schools, and the same front-door rules.

items.title: The Jetsons: The Space Car
items.description: The papers report that Knuckles Nuclear has escaped prison, and George Jetson's day involves a bag of money and a flying car. In the future, as now, the headline arrives before the plan.

items.title: The Jetsons: The Coming of Astro
items.description: The Jetsons get Astro, the family dog, in a future that has also built a mechanical one called Lectronimo and given away demonstrations. The robot has features. Astro has Elroy.

items.title: The Jetsons: Jetson's Night Out
items.description: George Jetson heads out for a night of football at the Goliseum, where the players are robots in a domed stadium. The future arrives with every convenience except an alibi.

items.title: Yogi Bear: Yogi Bear's Big Break
items.description: Yogi Bear wants his big break, and Ranger Smith wants Yogi to stay put. A parachute is involved. Jellystone regards this as ordinary park business.

items.title: Yogi Bear: Slumber Party Smarty
items.description: Yogi Bear settles in to hibernate behind a Do Not Disturb All Winter sign, and a small blue bird turns up in the bed. Yogi is smarter than the average bear. The bird is not average.

items.title: Yogi Bear: Pie Pirates
items.description: Yogi Bear and Boo-Boo go after a pie cooling on a windowsill, guarded by a fence and one bulldog. The sign says Beware of Dog. Yogi, smarter than the average bear, reads it as a suggestion.

items.title: Yogi Bear: Big Bad Bully
items.description: Yogi Bear meets a black bull behind a farm fence and plays matador with a red cape. It is a sport with rules, and nobody has told the bull.

items.title: Yogi Bear: Foxy Hound Dog
items.description: Yogi Bear takes in a little fox on the run from a monocled hunter and his hound. The fox sleeps in Yogi's bed, which Yogi counts as good hosting.

items.title: Yogi Bear: Big Brave Bear
items.description: A gangster in a fedora hides out in Yogi Bear's cave, takes Boo-Boo's bed and has Yogi drive the getaway car. Nobody asks Boo-Boo, whose bed it is.

items.title: Yogi Bear: Tally Ho Ho Ho
items.description: A little bearded hunter stalks an autumn wood. Yogi Bear steps between him and a deer, then plays dead. The plan has one move, and he commits to it.

items.title: Yogi Bear: Baffled Bear
items.description: Yogi Bear wakes from hibernation to find a freeway built around his tree. No notice was sent. The honking is a notice, in its way.

items.title: Yogi Bear: High Fly Guy
items.description: Yogi Bear sets out to teach a little bird that won't fly, with a slingshot, a cliff and a propeller. He is not a bird, which he treats as an advantage.

items.title: Yogi's Birthday Party
items.description: It is Yogi Bear's birthday, and the party is set on a TV stage with Ranger Smith in the frame. Balloons and a helicopter turn up. Jellystone sees nothing unusual in either.

items.title: Rockin' with Judy Jetson
items.description: Judy Jetson takes up rock and roll in a feature-length film, with a band, a stage and a lot of space glam. The Jetson household treats a music career as sensible.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E06 - What the Hex Going On.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: What the Hex Going On?
items.description: The gang arrives at an estate behind a cemetery gate, where a hex has everyone spooked and a blue-faced figure in a black cloak turns up. Shaggy and Scooby's plan is to be elsewhere.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E07 - Never Ape an Ape Man.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: Never Ape an Ape Man
items.description: The gang lands on the Mansion set at Starbright Films, where an ape man is spooking the production. Shaggy takes pictures, Scooby takes cover, and a pool table gets involved.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E08 - Foul Play in Funland.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: Foul Play in Funland
items.description: A robot with glowing orange eyes has taken over Funland, and Mystery Inc. investigates after dark. Shaggy and Scooby agree to help, from the nearest exit, until the bumper cars intervene.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E09 - The Backstage Rage.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: The Backstage Rage
items.description: Mystery Inc. goes backstage at an old theater after dark, where the costume trunks are full of surprises and the corridors are not lit. Shaggy and Scooby treat the building as an exit they haven't found yet.

items.id: ds-store_20260105/Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!/1/S01E10 - Bedlam in the Big Top.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!: Bedlam in the Big Top
items.description: Mystery Inc. pulls up to a circus where a clown in a red cloak has everyone nervous. Shaggy and Scooby look into it anyway, which in this show counts as a career.

items.id: the-flintstones-s-06-e-01-no-biz-like-show-biz/The Flintstones S06E03 The Return of Stony Curtis.mp4
items.title: The Flintstones: The Return of Stony Curtis
items.description: Stony Curtis, Bedrock's movie star, is back in town, and Fred Flintstone makes a plan about it. The plan is the usual kind.

items.id: the-flintstones-s-06-e-01-no-biz-like-show-biz/The Flintstones S06E04 Disorder in the Court.mp4
items.title: The Flintstones: Disorder in the Court
items.description: Fred and Barney deal with Bedrock's legal system, which runs on stone benches, a judge, a conference table and a policeman with a radar gun. It has more patience than either of them.

items.title: The Flintstones: Circus Business
items.description: Fred and Barney spend a day at the circus, where a ringmaster in a purple top hat has a proposition. Fred hears a career. Wilma and Betty hear a mistake, from the fence.

items.title: The Flintstones: Samantha
items.description: Samantha, the witch from Bewitched, moves in next to the Flintstones and ends up on the family camping trip. Fred and Barney assumed it would be quiet. Bedrock has no zoning for witches, so it adapts.

items.title: The Flintstones: The Great Gazoo
items.description: A saucer lands in the Bedrock desert and the Great Gazoo, a tiny green alien only Fred and Barney can see, steps out. Dinner at a fancy restaurant goes ahead as planned, with one floating guest.

items.title: The Jetsons: The Good Little Scouts
items.description: George Jetson leads Elroy's scout troop on a hike across the surface of the Moon. In Orbit City, a camping trip is a short commute.

items.title: The Jetsons: The Flying Suit
items.description: A flying suit turns up at Spacely Sprockets, and George Jetson is close enough to be involved. Mr. Spacely is thrilled. George spends most of the half hour looking down.

items.title: The Jetsons: Rosey's Boyfriend
items.description: Rosey, the Jetsons' robot maid, gets a boyfriend, a green robot, and her wiring shows it. George is left to manage a household appliance's love life.

items.title: The Jetsons: Elroy's TV Show
items.description: Elroy gets a TV show, and somewhere along the way George ends up on a rocky alien planet with a small green alien. In Orbit City this counts as a normal workday.

items.title: The Jetsons: Uniblab
items.description: Mr. Spacely puts a robot named Uniblab on the office floor at Spacely Sprockets, and George Jetson has to work around it. Mr. Spacely has found an employee who never asks for a raise.

items.id: a-pup-named-scooby-doo-s-03-e-03-horror-of-the-haunted-hairpiece-hdtv-1080p_202608/A Pup Named Scooby Doo/Season 01/A Pup Named Scooby-Doo - S01E01 - A Bicycle Built for Boo! SDTV.mp4
items.title: A Pup Named Scooby-Doo: A Bicycle Built for Boo
items.description: The kid Mystery Inc. and puppy Scooby-Doo look into a mystery that starts with a bicycle. The bicycle has a smaller role than the monster, which seems fair.

items.id: a-pup-named-scooby-doo-s-03-e-03-horror-of-the-haunted-hairpiece-hdtv-1080p_202608/A Pup Named Scooby Doo/Season 01/A Pup Named Scooby-Doo - S01E02 - The Sludge Monster from the Earth's Core SDTV.mp4
items.title: A Pup Named Scooby-Doo: The Sludge Monster from the Earth's Core
items.description: Scooby-Doo, Shaggy, Velma, Daphne and Fred, all children in pajamas, face a purple sludge monster from the Earth's core. Nobody asks the sludge what it is doing up this late.

items.id: a-pup-named-scooby-doo-s-03-e-03-horror-of-the-haunted-hairpiece-hdtv-1080p_202608/A Pup Named Scooby Doo/Season 01/A Pup Named Scooby-Doo - S01E03 - Wanted Cheddar Alive SDTV.mp4
items.title: A Pup Named Scooby-Doo: Wanted Cheddar Alive
items.description: A pup named Scooby-Doo, Shaggy and the kid gang chase an orange goo monster through a chocolate factory. Scooby treats the vats of syrup as a hazard of the job.

items.id: a-pup-named-scooby-doo-s-03-e-03-horror-of-the-haunted-hairpiece-hdtv-1080p_202608/A Pup Named Scooby Doo/Season 01/A Pup Named Scooby-Doo - S01E04 - The Schnook Who Took My Comic Book SDTV.mp4
items.title: A Pup Named Scooby-Doo: The Schnook Who Took My Comic Book
items.description: The kid-sized Mystery Inc. spends this one in a comic book shop, where somebody has taken a comic book and collectors are waving cash. A toad-faced doctor in a head mirror is also involved. Nobody mentions it.

items.id: a-pup-named-scooby-doo-s-03-e-03-horror-of-the-haunted-hairpiece-hdtv-1080p_202608/A Pup Named Scooby Doo/Season 01/A Pup Named Scooby-Doo - S01E05 - For Letter or Worse SDTV.mp4
items.title: A Pup Named Scooby-Doo: For Letter or Worse
items.description: Pup-sized Mystery Inc. lands in a TV game show with a bow-tied host, a studio audience of kids and a scoreboard that keeps climbing. A game show is a reasonable place to look for a mystery.

items.id: Space_Ghost_and_Dino_Boy/G:/Videos/Downloads/Space Ghost and Dino Boy/Space Ghost and Dino Boy - S01E01 - The Heat Thing, The Worm People, Zorak.mp4
items.title: Space Ghost and Dino Boy: The Heat Thing, The Worm People, Zorak
items.description: Space Ghost faces the Heat Thing and Zorak, while Dino Boy meets the Worm People in the Lost Valley. Two shows share one tape, and nobody in either finds it crowded.

items.id: Space_Ghost_and_Dino_Boy/G:/Videos/Downloads/Space Ghost and Dino Boy/Space Ghost and Dino Boy - S01E02 - The Lizard Slavers, The Moss Men, The Web.mp4
items.title: Space Ghost and Dino Boy: Creature King
items.description: Space Ghost takes on the Creature King, and Jan and Jace end up in chains. Blip the monkey is present, with no say in the creature situation.

items.id: Space_Ghost_and_Dino_Boy/G:/Videos/Downloads/Space Ghost and Dino Boy/Space Ghost and Dino Boy - S01E02 - Creature King, The Treemen, The Sandman.mp4
items.title: Space Ghost and Dino Boy
items.description: A double bill. Space Ghost takes on a rogues' gallery in deep space, and Dino Boy rides a dinosaur across the Lost Valley as if it were a commute.

items.id: Space_Ghost_and_Dino_Boy/G:/Videos/Downloads/Space Ghost and Dino Boy/Space Ghost and Dino Boy - S01E04 - The Evil Collector, The Fire God, The Drone.mp4
items.title: Space Ghost and Dino Boy: The Drone
items.description: Space Ghost goes underwater after something called The Drone, with Jan and Jace in tow. Dino Boy and his caveman Ugh get the middle of the tape. Two cartoons, one noticeably wetter.

items.id: Space_Ghost_and_Dino_Boy/G:/Videos/Downloads/Space Ghost and Dino Boy/Space Ghost and Dino Boy - S01E05 - Homing Device, The Mighty Snow Creature, The Robot Master.mp4
items.title: Space Ghost and Dino Boy: The Robot Master
items.description: Space Ghost meets the Robot Master and a fleet of missile ships, with Jan, Jace and Blip along. Then Dino Boy and Ugh face the Lost Valley, crocodile included. Space Ghost brings a cape to a robot problem.

items.id: Space_Ghost_and_Dino_Boy/G:/Videos/Downloads/Space Ghost and Dino Boy/Space Ghost and Dino Boy - S01E06 - The Iceman, The Wolf People, Hi-Jackers.mp4
items.title: Space Ghost and Dino Boy: Hi-Jackers
items.description: Space Ghost's sidekicks Jan and Jace end up in a cell while Blip the monkey stays loose. Dino Boy's Lost Valley segment follows, with giant insects, which the valley treats as ordinary.

items.id: the-richie-rich-scooby-doo-show-ep-1/The Richie Rich & Scooby-Doo Show ep1.ia.mp4
items.title: The Richie Rich/Scooby-Doo Show: Swamp Witch
items.description: Scooby-Doo and Shaggy end up in a haunted house where a witch is netting ghosts. Richie Rich gets the other half of the hour, plus a vault of gold. The butterfly net is a sensible tool and nobody questions it.

items.id: the-richie-rich-scooby-doo-show-ep-1/The Richie Rich & Scooby-Doo Show ep2.ia.mp4
items.title: The Richie Rich/Scooby-Doo Show
items.description: Richie Rich and his dog Dollar share the bill with Scooby-Doo, Shaggy and Scrappy-Doo. One side has the family fortune. The other has a van, and the van sees more action.

items.id: the-richie-rich-scooby-doo-show-ep-1/The Richie Rich & Scooby-Doo Show ep3.ia.mp4
items.title: The Richie Rich/Scooby-Doo Show: Mummy's the Word
items.description: Shaggy, Scooby-Doo and Scrappy-Doo meet mummies in the Scooby half; the Richie Rich half has the mansion, the butler Cadbury and the dog Dollar. One show worries about dinner, the other owns it.

items.id: the-real-adventures-of-jonny-quest-the-complete-series_202304/The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest Season 01 Episode 01 – The Darkest Fathoms.mp4
items.title: The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest: The Darkest Fathoms
items.description: Jonny Quest and Hadji take a submersible after a ship called the Ivory Web. The sea is dark and the stakes are higher. Lights are optional at that depth.

items.id: the-real-adventures-of-jonny-quest-the-complete-series_202304/The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest Season 01 Episode 02 – Escape to Questworld.mp4
items.title: The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest: Escape to Questworld
items.description: Jonny Quest, Jessie and Race Bannon deal with trouble in Questworld, the series' virtual-reality world. The Quest family treats cyberspace as a routine commute.

items.id: the-real-adventures-of-jonny-quest-the-complete-series_202304/The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest Season 01 Episode 03 – In the Realm of the Condor.mp4
items.title: The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest: In the Realm of the Condor
items.description: Jonny Quest, Hadji and Jessie Bannon trek through the jungle to a hidden city of spear-carrying guards and a great stone wall. Nobody on this team has ever taken a day off.

items.id: the-real-adventures-of-jonny-quest-the-complete-series_202304/The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest Season 01 Episode 04 – Rages Burning Wheel.mp4
items.title: The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest: Rages Burning Wheel
items.description: Team Quest leaves the jungle for orbit: space suits, a shuttle launch, and somebody in a wide-brimmed hat who seems interested. It opens on green wireframe, the way cartoons pictured computers then.

items.id: the-real-adventures-of-jonny-quest-the-complete-series_202304/The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest Season 01 Episode 05 – Ndovu’s Last Journey.mp4
items.title: The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest: Ndovu's Last Journey
items.description: Jonny Quest and Dr. Quest meet an old man and an elephant on the African savanna, and then the grass catches fire. In this family, that counts as a normal afternoon.

items.id: a-pup-named-scooby-doo-s-03-e-03-horror-of-the-haunted-hairpiece-hdtv-1080p_202608/A Pup Named Scooby Doo/Season 01/A Pup Named Scooby-Doo - S01E06 - The Babysitter from Beyond SDTV.mp4
items.title: A Pup Named Scooby-Doo: The Babysitter from Beyond
items.description: Daphne, Fred, Velma, Shaggy and the pup Scooby-Doo are kids in this one, home with a babysitter who may be from beyond. She has the one quality the gang respects in a suspect: she was in the house.

items.title: Super Friends: The Power Pirate
items.description: A pirate who takes power is loose, and the Super Friends are called in. Wendy, Marvin and Wonder Dog come along, so the Justice League has backup. The dog's role is noted.

items.title: Super Friends: The Baffles Puzzle
items.description: Wendy, Marvin and Wonder Dog run into trouble that takes Aquaman and Robin from a library to a circus tent. Wonder Dog wears a cape throughout, and nobody asks.

items.title: Super Friends: Professor Goodfellow's G.E.E.C.
items.description: Professor Goodfellow's G.E.E.C. is a blue robot, and Superman, Batman, Robin, Aquaman and the kids spend the half hour dealing with it. The office has a WARNING sign, which feels like an admission.

items.id: the-richie-rich-scooby-doo-show-ep-1/The Richie Rich & Scooby-Doo Show ep4.ia.mp4
items.title: The Richie Rich/Scooby-Doo Show: Scooby's Three Ding-A-Ling Circus
items.description: Half the hour is Richie Rich, his dog Dollar and a lot of money. The other half is a circus with Scooby and Scrappy-Doo in it. The show sees no conflict between these.

items.id: the-richie-rich-scooby-doo-show-ep-1/The Richie Rich & Scooby-Doo Show ep5.ia.mp4
items.title: The Richie Rich/Scooby-Doo Show: Scooby's Bull Fright
items.description: Scooby-Doo, Shaggy and Scrappy-Doo enter a bullring and the bull objects. A Richie Rich snowstorm follows on the same tape. Given the circumstances, the bull's reaction is proportionate.

items.id: the-richie-rich-scooby-doo-show-ep-1/The Richie Rich & Scooby-Doo Show ep6.ia.mp4
items.title: The Richie Rich/Scooby-Doo Show
items.description: Richie Rich solves problems with money. Scooby-Doo, Shaggy and Scrappy-Doo solve theirs by running, safari included. The tape does not say which method is better, which is the honest position.

items.id: the-real-adventures-of-jonny-quest-the-complete-series_202304/The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest Season 01 Episode 06 – Manhattan Maneater.mp4
items.title: The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest: Manhattan Maneater
items.description: A white tiger is loose in Manhattan. Jonny, Hadji and Jessie follow it into the dark while the news crews follow them. The tiger has the most reasonable plan on screen: leave the city.

items.title: The 13 Ghosts of Scooby-Doo: To All the Ghouls I've Loved Before
items.description: Vincent Van Ghoul consults his crystal ball while Shaggy and Scooby-Doo cross a snowy mountain town after a plane goes down. Only Vincent gets the crystal ball. The rest get the weather.

items.title: The 13 Ghosts of Scooby-Doo: Scoobra Kadoobra
items.description: Scooby-Doo, Shaggy, Scrappy-Doo and Flim-Flam chase the thirteen ghosts back toward the Chest of Demons, this time through the Himalayas. Ghost-hunting is a profession here, with a job description.

items.title: The 13 Ghosts of Scooby-Doo: Me and My Shadow Demon
items.description: Flip Maloney, Shaggy, Daphne and Scooby-Doo chase a shadow demon while Vincent Van Ghoul watches from a crystal ball. It is, sensibly, the safest seat in the house.

items.title: The 13 Ghosts of Scooby-Doo: Reflections in a Ghoulish Eye
items.description: Daphne, Shaggy, Scooby and Flim-Flam attend a paranormal convention in a desert city, where a Vacuu Spook booth does brisk business and a stage mirror takes an interest in Shaggy and Scooby. Standard trade show.

items.title: The 13 Ghosts of Scooby-Doo: That's Monstertainment
items.description: A monster turns up on the television, and Scooby-Doo, Shaggy and Flim-Flam follow it into the set, Scooby wearing a doctor's coat. Nobody asks why, which is fair.

items.title: Super Friends: The Weather Maker
items.description: The Super Friends take on a weather-making scheme that runs from an iceberg to a nuclear power plant, with Wendy, Marvin and Wonder Dog along. Superman handles the plant. The forecast was not consulted.

items.title: Super Friends: Dr. Pelagian's War
items.description: Dr. Pelagian declares a war, and Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman and Aquaman answer it, Wendy and Marvin in tow. The Super Friends' response to a declared war is, as always, to show up.

items.title: Super Friends: The Shamon U
items.description: Batman, Robin, Wendy, Marvin and Wonder Dog arrive at Shamon U, a campus that announces itself with one enormous letter U. A robot arm and a scientist follow. Nobody asks about tuition.

items.title: The New Scooby-Doo Movies: Ghastly Ghost Town
items.description: Mystery Inc. drives into an abandoned Western town where a giant lizard is on the loose. The saloon and the livery stable are still standing, so whoever left town left it in good order.

items.title: The New Scooby-Doo Movies: The Dynamic Scooby-Doo Affair
items.description: Batman and Robin cross over into Mystery Inc.'s case, Batmobile and all. Batman, the world's greatest detective, accepts help from a Great Dane who is afraid of everything.

items.title: The New Scooby-Doo Movies: Wednesday Is Missing
items.description: The gang baby-sits Wednesday and Pugsley at the Addams mansion, and Wednesday goes missing. Lurch, Fester and a man-eating plant are all in the house, so the haunting is the least unusual thing there.

items.id: WackyR/G:/Videos/Downloads/Wacky Races/Wacky Races - S01E01 - See-Saw to Arkansas, Creepy Trip to Lemon Twist.ia.mp4
items.title: Wacky Races: See-Saw to Arkansas / Creepy Trip to Lemon Twist
items.description: Two races on one tape. Dick Dastardly and Muttley cheat in both, and in the second the course runs through a house full of ghosts. The ghosts are treated as a road condition.

items.id: WackyR/G:/Videos/Downloads/Wacky Races/Wacky Races - S01E02 - Why Oh Why Wyoming, Beat the Clock to Yellow Rock.ia.mp4
items.title: Wacky Races: Why Oh Why Wyoming / Beat the Clock to Yellow Rock
items.description: Dick Dastardly and Muttley take the Mean Machine across Wyoming to Yellow Rock Park, where a ranger waits at the gate. Dastardly follows the rules of the race, none of them.

items.id: WackyR/G:/Videos/Downloads/Wacky Races/Wacky Races - S01E03 - Mish Mash Missouri Dash, Idaho a Go Go.ia.mp4
items.title: Wacky Races: Mish Mash Missouri Dash / Idaho a Go-Go
items.description: Eleven cars race through Missouri, then Idaho. Dick Dastardly gets a boulder, a bull and a detour sign to work with, and regards all of it as a driving strategy.

items.id: WackyR/G:/Videos/Downloads/Wacky Races/Wacky Races - S01E04 - The Baja-Ha-Ha Race, Real Gone Ape.ia.mp4
items.title: Wacky Races: The Baja-Ha-Ha Race / Real Gone Ape
items.description: Two races. The field crosses Baja, then a gorilla from a King Klong truck picks up Penelope Pitstop's car and carries it. Dick Dastardly cheats in both, and the rules seem to have budgeted for that.

items.id: WackyR/G:/Videos/Downloads/Wacky Races/Wacky Races - S01E05 - Scout Scatter, Free Wheeling to Wheeling.ia.mp4
items.title: Wacky Races: Scout Scatter / Free Wheeling to Wheeling
items.description: Two Wacky Races heats: one through a scout camp, one toward Wheeling. Dick Dastardly and Muttley bring dynamite to both. The plans are finished before the start and wrong by the first turn.

items.title: The 13 Ghosts of Scooby-Doo: Ship of Ghouls
items.description: Scooby, Shaggy, Scrappy, Daphne and Flim-Flam board a ship to recapture another of the thirteen ghosts, advised by Vincent Van Ghoul from inside a glass globe. A haunted ship counts as a cruise.

items.title: Super Friends: Too Hot to Handle
items.description: A scientist and a general bring the Super Friends a space problem that ends up pointing at the sun. Wendy, Marvin and Wonder Dog come along. The sun is not consulted.

items.title: Super Friends: The Androids
items.description: Androids turn up near a rocket launch, and the Super Friends have to work out who is who. Superman ends up slumped in a chair while an elderly woman looks on, which is not how he usually attends a meeting.

items.title: Super Friends: The Balloon People
items.description: A small saucer settles into tall grass, and Wendy, Marvin and Wonder Dog bring in the Super Friends. Aquaman takes the underwater half, in the matter-of-fact way he takes everything underwater.

items.title: The New Scooby-Doo Movies: The Frickert Fracas
items.description: Mystery Inc. spends this one on a farm with a man in a blue suit, an elderly woman and a henhouse. Scooby rides a rooster at one point, and the episode treats it as transport.

items.title: The New Scooby-Doo Movies: Guess Who's Knott Coming to Dinner?
items.description: The gang is invited to dinner at a mansion with a butler, suits of armor and a green creature in the hall, with Don Knotts as guest star. Everyone stays the night, as the house clearly intended.

items.title: The New Scooby-Doo Movies: A Good Medium Is Rare
items.description: The gang joins a brash comedienne at a haunted mansion with a seance, a magician and a fortune teller. The elephant in the cellar is the one detail the haunting never bothers to explain.

items.id: WackyR/G:/Videos/Downloads/Wacky Races/Wacky Races - S01E06 - By Rollercoaster to Ups and Downs, The Speedy Arkansas Traveler.ia.mp4
items.title: Wacky Races: By Rollercoaster to Upsan Downs
items.description: Dick Dastardly's plan involves a sign reading STOP ALL RIDES and an amusement park. A second race follows, with Muttley and a butterfly net. The rules remain, as always, optional.

items.title: The Scooby-Doo Show: High Rise Hair Raiser
items.description: Shaggy and Scooby-Doo sign on to a skyscraper construction crew to look into the spooky goings-on. Scooby's cover is a hard hat, and it holds up.

items.id: 20240727_20240727_0523/02 The Fiesta Host Is An Aztec Ghost.mp4
items.title: The Scooby-Doo Show: The Fiesta Host Is an Aztec Ghost
items.description: A fiesta host is reported to be an Aztec ghost, so Scooby-Doo, Shaggy and the gang follow the trail by boat to a stone temple. Scooby's objection is noted and overruled.

items.id: 20240727_20240727_0523/03 The Gruesome Game Of The Gator Goul.mp4
items.title: The Scooby-Doo Show: The Gruesome Game of the Gator Ghoul
items.description: Mystery Inc. drives into Hokeyfenokee Swamp to see about a gator ghoul. Scooby-Dum is there too, so Scooby now has someone to be afraid next to. Nobody finds this out of the ordinary.

items.title: The Scooby-Doo Show: Watt a Shocking Ghost
items.description: A glowing orange ghost is haunting a snowbound power station, and the gang arrives in earmuffs. A ghost that shocks people is, at least, in the right building.

items.title: The Scooby-Doo Show: The Headless Horseman of Halloween
items.description: Mystery Inc. goes to a Halloween costume party, and a headless rider has not been told it is only a costume party. Scooby-Doo and Scooby-Dum meet it together, which halves the courage and doubles the volume.

items.title: Super Friends: The Fantastic Frerps
items.description: A king, a queen and a jester turn up around a loading dock, and Wonder Woman, Batman and Robin take the case. The costumes are not discussed, which is the professional thing to do.

items.id: top-cat-s-01-e-27-dibble-breaks-the-rec/Top Cat S01E01 Hawaii Here We Come.mp4
items.title: Top Cat: Hawaii, Here We Come
items.description: Top Cat and the gang go to sea in pursuit of Hawaii. Top Cat works a lifeboat and a waiter's apron on the way, and Officer Dibble is aboard. The ocean makes no difference to the plan.

items.id: top-cat-s-01-e-27-dibble-breaks-the-rec/Top Cat S01E02 The Maharajah of Pookajee.mp4
items.title: Top Cat: The Maharajah of Pookajee
items.description: Top Cat moves into a hotel suite as the Maharajah of Pookajee, turban and all, and two men with guns take an interest. He accepts this as the price of royalty.

items.title: Top Cat: All That Jazz
items.description: Top Cat, Benny and the gang have the alley, a pool hall and Officer Dibble, who watches the alley professionally. In the logic of this show, that makes the gang the stable party.

items.title: Top Cat: The $1,000,000 Derby
items.description: Top Cat spots a million-dollar derby and a horse and does the math, and the Alley gang goes along, in robes and a jockey's silks. The plan is sound until the horse is consulted.

items.title: Top Cat: The Violin Player
items.description: Benny the Ball picks up the violin, and Top Cat picks up management, with Officer Dibble patrolling the alley. The cat has never met a talent he couldn't take a cut of.

items.title: The Jetsons: Microchip Chumps
items.description: Mr. Spacely hires Uniblab, a robot efficiency expert whose whole job is reporting on the staff, and George Jetson is on the staff. Spacely Sprockets considers tattling a form of management.

items.title: The Scooby-Doo Show: Scared a Lot in Camelot
items.description: The mystery moves into a castle with a wizard in a red robe and a suit of armor that is not always where it was. Shaggy and Scooby find this alarming, which is consistent of them.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E01 - The Mystery of the Lizard Men.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: The Mystery of the Lizard Men
items.description: Ships keep vanishing in the Sargasso Sea, so Dr. Quest takes a speedboat out to ask who is taking them. The suspects are reportedly amphibious. He notes this and keeps going.

items.title: Jonny Quest: Arctic Splashdown
items.description: Dr. Quest has work to do on the Arctic ice, and the submarine offshore has plans of its own. Jonny and Hadji are along in parkas, which the episode treats as full preparation.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E03 - The Curse of Anubis.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: The Curse of Anubis
items.description: Dr. Quest goes to Egypt to look into an old curse, and a mummy turns up almost at once to back it. He asks to see the paperwork.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E04 - The Curse of Anubis.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Pursuit of the Po-Ho
items.description: A jungle research hut sends a radio call, and Dr. Quest and Race Bannon take Jonny and Hadji up the river to answer it. The Quests treat every distress call as a house call.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E05 - Riddle of the Gold.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Riddle of the Gold
items.description: A scrap of gold gets the acid test, and the Quests follow it by plane, truck and mountain train to a place with a chained leopard. Dr. Quest packs a camera. Race Bannon packs patience.

items.title: Top Cat: The Missing Heir
items.description: A newspaper says an eccentric millionaire's fortune goes to his missing pet, with a reward for whoever returns it. Top Cat reads this as a job posting. A mansion, a bulldog and a piano are involved.

items.id: top-cat-s-01-e-27-dibble-breaks-the-rec/Top Cat S01E07 Top Cat Falls in Love.mp4
items.title: Top Cat: Top Cat Falls in Love
items.description: Top Cat is laid up in a hospital bed at Christmas, and a nurse is the main reason he doesn't mind. The gang visits with scarves and concern. Medicine has met few more willing patients.

items.id: top-cat-s-01-e-27-dibble-breaks-the-rec/Top Cat S01E08 A Visit from Mom.mp4
items.title: Top Cat: A Visit from Mom
items.description: Benny's mother is visiting, so Top Cat borrows Officer Dibble's squad car to make the gang look important, and leaves Dibble a note about it. In the alley, a note counts as a signed lease.

items.title: Top Cat: Naked Town
items.description: Officer Dibble ends up at a podium holding an Oscar, and the gang ends up near the Ajax warehouse. Top Cat is somewhere between the two, and the show sees no reason to explain how.

items.title: Top Cat: Sergeant Top Cat
items.description: Officer Dibble's sergeant comes by the alley, and Top Cat, as the title says, takes up a rank of his own. The chain of command in this alley has never been so crowded.

items.id: captain-caveman-and-the-teen-angels_202608/Captain Caveman and the Teen Angels E01 - The Scarifying Seaweed Secret.ia.mp4
items.title: Captain Caveman: The Kooky Case of the Cryptic Keys
items.description: Captain Caveman and the Teen Angels hunt for a set of keys in an old mansion while a man in a trench coat gets to them first. Cavey spends part of it inside a dresser drawer, which the case allows for.

items.id: captain-caveman-and-the-teen-angels_202608/Captain Caveman and the Teen Angels E02 - The Dummy.ia.mp4
items.title: Captain Caveman: The Mixed Up Mystery of Deadman's Reef
items.description: The Teen Angels and Captain Caveman look into a ghost ship off Dead Man's Reef. A skeleton gives chase, and so does the sheriff. Neither is welcome, and only one of them has a badge.

items.id: captain-caveman-and-the-teen-angels_202608/Captain Caveman and the Teen Angels E03 - Cavey and the Volcanic Villain.ia.mp4
items.title: Captain Caveman: What a Flight for a Fright
items.description: At Tri-State Airport, the Teen Angels and Captain Caveman try to protect a rich woman's jewels. Airport security was apparently busy, and a caveman was available.

items.id: captain-caveman-and-the-teen-angels_202608/Captain Caveman and the Teen Angels E05 - Cavey and the Baffling Buffalo Man.ia.mp4
items.title: Captain Caveman: Big Scare in the Big Top
items.description: A painting is stolen and the trail ends at a circus with a tiger on the loose. The Teen Angels take the case, and Captain Caveman crosses the high wire, as the investigation requires.

items.id: captain-caveman-and-the-teen-angels_202608/Captain Caveman and the Teen Angels E06 - Dragonhead.ia.mp4
items.title: Captain Caveman: Double Dribble Riddle
items.description: Captain Caveman and the Teen Angels go after a black panther loose in an arena, with a basketball player and two nervous men tied to the case. The panther is the only one not acting suspicious.

items.id: captain-caveman-and-the-teen-angels_202608/Captain Caveman and the Teen Angels E07 - Cavey and the Murky Mississippi Mystery.ia.mp4
items.title: Captain Caveman: The Crazy Case of the Tell-Tale Tape
items.description: The Teen Angels follow a list of tapes and cities into a TV studio, where a green monster is loose. Captain Caveman ends the episode in a top hat, and no one asks.

items.id: hong-kong-phooey-s-01-e-08-mirror-mirror-on-the-wall-great-movie-mystery/Hong Kong Phooey - S01E01 - Car Thieves; Zoo Story.mp4
items.title: Hong Kong Phooey: Car Thieves / Zoo Story
items.description: Hong Kong Phooey, station janitor Penry by day, chases a stolen-car crew in the Phooey-mobile. Sgt. Flint, one room over, regards this as a normal use of the janitor's time.

items.id: hong-kong-phooey-s-01-e-08-mirror-mirror-on-the-wall-great-movie-mystery/Hong Kong Phooey - S01E02 - Iron Head the Robot; Cotton Pickin' Pocket Picker.mp4
items.title: Hong Kong Phooey: Iron Head the Robot
items.description: Penry Pooch, the station janitor, becomes Hong Kong Phooey to chase a delivery van. The Phooey-mobile reaches water, and Spot, his cat, gets out and pushes. This is what the car is for.

items.id: hong-kong-phooey-s-01-e-08-mirror-mirror-on-the-wall-great-movie-mystery/Hong Kong Phooey - S01E03 - Grandma Goody (Cat Burglar); Candle Power.mp4
items.title: Hong Kong Phooey: Grandma Goody / Candle Power
items.description: A burglary gang hides behind a sweet old woman and her cat, and Hong Kong Phooey takes the case. Rosemary works the switchboard. Back at the station, the mop waits, the most dependable character in the episode.

items.id: hong-kong-phooey-s-01-e-08-mirror-mirror-on-the-wall-great-movie-mystery/Hong Kong Phooey - S01E04 - The Penthouse Burglaries; Batty Bank Mob.mp4
items.title: Hong Kong Phooey: The Penthouse Burglaries / Batty Bank Mob
items.description: A gorilla is burgling the city's penthouses, and Hong Kong Phooey is on it, all the way to the harbor, where a diving mask and a boat take the case underwater. Sgt. Flint stays at the desk, as the department intends.

items.id: hong-kong-phooey-s-01-e-08-mirror-mirror-on-the-wall-great-movie-mystery/Hong Kong Phooey - S01E05 - The Voltage Villain; The Giggler.mp4
items.title: Hong Kong Phooey: The Voltage Villain / The Giggler
items.description: Hong Kong Phooey has an electric villain to deal with, then a clown who robs a society party. Spot rides along for both. A clown is the only thief who arrives already entertaining the guests.

items.id: hong-kong-phooey-s-01-e-08-mirror-mirror-on-the-wall-great-movie-mystery/Hong Kong Phooey - S01E06 - The Gumdrop Kid; Professor Presto (The Malevolent Magician).mp4
items.title: Hong Kong Phooey: The Gumdrop Kid / Professor Presto
items.description: Hong Kong Phooey chases candy-truck thieves, then calls on stage magician Professor Presto in his shop. By the end a crocodile is after Sgt. Flint, which the station files under Tuesday.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E06 - Treasure of the Temple.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Treasure of the Temple
items.description: Dr. Quest and Race Bannon find a stone chamber of gold idols under a jungle pyramid, and a man in a white hat arrives with a pistol. Bandit meets a lizard and keeps his composure.

items.title: Jonny Quest: Calcutta Adventure
items.description: In Calcutta, Bandit meets a mongoose, a snake charmer holds court on the street and a turbaned pilot takes off. The chase then moves to skis in the mountains, because the plot required it.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E08 - The Robot Spy.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: The Robot Spy
items.description: A flying saucer settles over a remote research base and a spider-legged robot with one red eye goes to work, while Jonny and Hadji sit up in bed to watch. The robot has no doubts about its job.

items.title: Jonny Quest: Double Danger
items.description: The Quests begin on a beach and Dr. Quest ends in a dungeon, with a flight, a monkey and a stone hall in between. As itineraries go, it covers a lot of ground.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E10 - Shadow of the Condor.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Shadow of the Condor
items.description: An old airman in a red biplane is still flying as if the First World War never ended, and the Quests turn up in the middle of his sky. Bandit meets another dog, which counts as a dogfight.

items.id: jabberjaw_complete_collection/01 - Dr. Lo Has Got to Go.mp4
items.title: Jabberjaw: Dr. Lo Has Got to Go
items.description: Dr. Lo sends a monster and a squad of men to put Jabberjaw, the Neptunes' fifteen-foot great white drummer, in a tube. As collector's items go, a shark who talks and plays drums is hard to argue with.

items.id: jabberjaw_complete_collection/02 - There's No Place Like Outer Space.mp4
items.title: Jabberjaw: There's No Place Like Outer Space
items.description: The Neptunes take a gig at a flying saucer convention, and insect-like aliens lock the whole band in a cage. Jabberjaw's booking agent should have asked more about the crowd.

items.title: Jabberjaw: Atlantis, Get Lost!
items.description: The Neptunes visit Atlantis, where the prime minister has staged an attack on the city to fool the queen. Atlantis's counterintelligence turns out to be a drumming shark and his band.

items.title: Jabberjaw: Run, Jabber, Run
items.description: The Neptunes go to an Olympic-style games, where Jabberjaw is pushed into a footrace and masked doctors cause trouble. The rulebook says nothing about sharks, and the officials take that as a yes.

items.title: Jabberjaw: The Sourpuss Octopuss
items.description: The Neptunes, an undersea teen band with a great white shark on drums, cross paths with a grumpy octopus and a pink robot. Jabberjaw is not the one who needs explaining here.

items.id: jabberjaw_complete_collection/06 - Hang Onto Your Hat, Jabber.mp4
items.title: Jabberjaw: Hang Onto Your Hat, Jabber
items.description: Jabberjaw buys a hat, and hooded cultists chase him around their temple over it. The receipt does not appear to have covered any of this.

items.id: josie_and_the_pussycats/01 Episode 1, The Nemo’s A No-No Affair.ia.mp4
items.title: Josie and the Pussycats: The Nemo's a No-No Affair
items.description: A caped villain plays a giant organ aboard a submarine, and Josie and the Pussycats are captured. Sebastian the cat supervises. A submarine with an organ is a decision, and the villain stands by it.

items.id: josie_and_the_pussycats/02 Episode 2, A Greenthumb Is Not A Goldfinger.ia.mp4
items.title: Josie and the Pussycats: A Greenthumb Is Not a Goldfinger
items.description: A man keeps a greenhouse full of living purple plants, and Josie and the Pussycats trace the trouble as far as a jungle village. No gardening advice is offered.

items.id: josie_and_the_pussycats/03 Episode 3, The Secret Six Secret.ia.mp4
items.title: Josie and the Pussycats: The Secret Six Secret
items.description: Josie and the Pussycats fly to a desert kingdom, where guards seize them on arrival. A secret society needs stopping, and a yellow car is available. Customs was the least of it.

items.title: Josie and the Pussycats: Swap Plot Flop
items.description: Josie and the Pussycats play the Oasis Club and are soon held by a sultan and a blue-faced schemer. Nothing in the booking mentioned a sultan.

items.title: Josie and the Pussycats: Midas Mix-Up
items.description: Josie and the Pussycats check into an Alpine ski hotel and chase a bald villain who is turning things to gold.

items.id: josie_and_the_pussycats/06 Episode 6, X Marks The Spot.ia.mp4
items.title: Josie and the Pussycats: X Marks the Spot
items.description: In London, Josie and the Pussycats get tangled in a professor's laboratory and a masked schemer, and a suit of armour and a green potion join the chase. London supplies the armour.

items.id: magillagorillas1/Magilla Gorilla [S01xE02] Gridiren Gorilla - Good Little Bad Boy - Small Change.ia.mp4
items.title: The Magilla Gorilla Show: Gridiron Gorilla
items.description: Magilla Gorilla finds himself on a football field, an outcome the pet shop window did not predict. Ricochet Rabbit chases outlaws, and Punkin Puss and Mushmouse feud with a dog. Nobody checked the roster.

items.id: magillagorillas1/Magilla Gorilla [S01xE03] Private Magilla - Cradle Robber - Hornswoggled.ia.mp4
items.title: The Magilla Gorilla Show: Private Magilla
items.description: The Army enlists Magilla Gorilla, and the soldiers' routine gives way to chaos. Ricochet Rabbit tracks an outlaw to a bank, and Punkin Puss tries to catch Mushmouse. The Army has a regulation for everything but this.

items.id: magillagorillas1/Magilla Gorilla [S01xE04] Bank Pranks - West Point - Muscle Tussle.ia.mp4
items.title: The Magilla Gorilla Show: Bank Pranks
items.description: Magilla Gorilla is for sale on the sidewalk outside Peebles Pet Shop while a drum and a bank pull focus. Ricochet Rabbit rescues a kidnapped woman from Rocky Rattler, and Punkin Puss chases Mushmouse. Nobody questions the sign.

items.id: magillagorillas1/Magilla Gorilla [S01xE06] Airlift - Annie Hoaxly - Army vs. Nervy Game.ia.mp4
items.title: The Magilla Gorilla Show: Airlift
items.description: Mr. Peebles argues with a customer while Magilla Gorilla is flung around the shop and then some. Ricochet Rabbit watches a bank and a widows' club, and Punkin Puss and Mushmouse stray into Army war games. Normal business hours apply.

items.id: magillagorillas1/Magilla Gorilla [S01xE01] Big Game - Atchison, Topeka And San Jose - Calling All Kin.ia.mp4
items.title: The Magilla Gorilla Show: Big Game
items.description: Mr. Peebles keeps Magilla Gorilla in the pet shop window with a sale sign, and a hunter with a rifle has noticed. Ricochet Rabbit and Punkin Puss share the bill. Nobody calls the city about the gorilla.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E11 - Skull and Double Crossbones.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Skull and Double Crossbones
items.description: The Quests go diving from a ship whose crew has an interest in what is down there. Jonny and Hadji ride a sea turtle, which is the least suspicious thing out there.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E12 - The Dreadful Doll.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: The Dreadful Doll
items.description: Dr. Quest and Race Bannon dive off a tropical island where painted warriors would rather not have visitors. Jonny and Hadji wait on the boat, a plan with one flaw: the island knows where the boat is.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E14 - Dragons of Ashida.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Dragons of Ashida
items.description: The Quests come ashore at an island where the scientist Dr. Ashida raises very large lizards and keeps a sumo guard. Dr. Quest takes this as a hobby. Race Bannon puts on a gi and takes it as a challenge.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E15 - Turu the Terrible.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Turu the Terrible
items.description: Dr. Quest goes into the jungle to look into a creature the locals call Turu, and someone there would rather he didn't. Bandit finds a fish and counts the trip a success.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E16 - The Fraudulent Volcano.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: The Fraudulent Volcano
items.description: A volcano stands beside an oil field where nothing volcanic ought to be, and Dr. Quest wants to know why. He brings Jonny and Hadji, which is how field trips work in this family.

items.id: scoobys-laff-a-lympics-18-new-york-turkey/Scooby's Laff-A-Lympics - 01 The Swiss Alps & Tokyo, Japan.mp4
items.title: Laff-A-Lympics
items.description: The Yogi Yahooeys, Really Rottens and Scooby Doobies race to the top of a pyramid, then hold a medieval tournament at a castle. The venue budget appears to have no ceiling.

items.title: Laff-A-Lympics
items.description: The three teams start from a hot-air balloon, race through the canals of an Italian city, then fly and parachute. Gravity is the one competitor nobody put on a team.

items.title: Laff-A-Lympics
items.description: The Yogi Yahooeys, Really Rottens and Scooby Doobies are in the middle of a stadium event when a flying saucer interrupts. A river race follows. A visitor from space is not grounds for a delay.

items.title: Laff-A-Lympics
items.description: The three teams climb a tower with Captain Caveman, then run a kangaroo race. The scoreboard ends close enough that every event counted, kangaroos included.

items.title: Laff-A-Lympics
items.description: The Yogi Yahooeys, Really Rottens and Scooby Doobies race dune buggies across a desert, then compete in kilts. Nobody explains the kilts, and the rules do not require it.

items.id: 1995-cartoon-network-vhs-scooby-doo-a-halloween-hassle-at-draculas-castle/1995 - Cartoon Network VHS - Scooby-Doo - A Halloween Hassle At Dracula's Castle.ia.mp4
items.title: Scooby-Doo: A Halloween Hassle at Dracula's Castle
items.description: Scooby-Doo and Shaggy spend Halloween at Dracula's castle, where the monsters are many and the exits are few. The tape opens with an FBI warning, which is the first scare.

items.title: Speed Buggy: Speed Buggy Went That-a-Way
items.description: Two crooks in a cloak and a robe take Speed Buggy to a mad scientist, whose lab includes a robot. Tinker, Debbie and Mark want him back. A fair request, given the robot.

items.title: Speed Buggy
items.description: A villain in red, with a trophy and a purple blimp, is after Speed Buggy. Tinker, Debbie and Mark follow into a cave. The blimp is purple, which is to say committed.

items.title: Speed Buggy
items.description: A helicopter and a masked man in a jeep chase Speed Buggy across desert ranch country, and the trail ends at a rancher's door. Pursuit by air and by jeep is a reasonable response to one buggy.

items.title: Speed Buggy: Speed Buggy Falls in Love
items.description: Speed Buggy meets a pink car at the track and falls for her, while Tinker, Debbie and Mark chase crooks into a castle. The courtship is conducted entirely in engine noises, and it is sincere.

items.title: Speed Buggy
items.description: A couple in white and blue furs freeze a beach, and Speed Buggy with it, using a snow machine and an ice lair. Tinker, Debbie and Mark go in after him. The beach was not consulted.

items.title: The Herculoids: The Pirates
items.description: Masked raiders in flying saucers land on Zandor's planet, home to Tara, Igoo, Gloop, Gleep and Zok the ray-firing dragon. Their plan has no line for the dragon, which seems the wrong line to skip.

items.id: the-herculoids_202608/The Herculoids E02 - Sarko the Arkman.ia.mp4
items.title: The Herculoids: Sarko, the Arkman
items.description: Tara and Dorno go to look into a strange sound on a purple planet, with the Herculoids' creatures along as chaperones. Pod-shaped craft are involved.

items.id: the-herculoids_202608/The Herculoids E03 - The Pod Creatures.ia.mp4
items.title: The Herculoids: The Pod Creatures
items.description: Winged orange raiders arrive with a robot ship and a fleet of canister-shaped machines, and Zandor's family answers with stun rays and creature powers. The raiders planned for everything except the creatures.

items.title: The Herculoids: Mekkor
items.description: A fanged alien in a purple cape bears down on the Herculoids, who respond by befriending a small bald alien boy. Tundro and Igoo handle the cape. Adoption comes first, defense second.

items.id: the-herculoids_202608/The Herculoids E05 - The Beaked People.ia.mp4
items.title: The Herculoids: The Beaked People
items.description: Zandor, Tara and Dorno meet red, insectlike aliens whose idea of hospitality is a swirling-light trap. The creatures are on hand. Nobody on this planet checks the guest list.

items.title: The Herculoids: Defeat of Ogron
items.description: Green alien raiders and a metal-faced crew come in saucers and put Tara, Dorno and Zandor in bubbles. The creatures take it from there. Bubbles are a poor containment choice for a family with a slingshot.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E17 - Werewolf of the Timberland.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Werewolf of the Timberland
items.description: Jonny and Hadji camp in pine country where werewolf talk goes around, and a man in a sling keeps working a radio he has not explained. Dr. Quest has to decide which one to worry about.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E18 - Pirates from Below.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Pirates from Below
items.description: Black-suited divers take Jonny into their underwater craft, and Dr. Quest works the island phone and a wall map. Eventually the whole household is under guard together, which saves on search parties.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E19 - Attack of the Tree People.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: Attack of the Tree People
items.description: A rough passage at sea lands the Quests on a jungle island, where an armed camp has no wish for visitors. Jonny and Hadji spend much of it staying out of reach. Altitude is the plan.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E20 - The Invisible Monster.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: The Invisible Monster
items.description: Jungle huts get flattened and a purple shimmer crackles on the trail, so Race Bannon, Jonny and Hadji strap on jet packs and look from above. Dr. Quest stays on the radio, a sensible place to stay.

items.id: jonny-quest-e-07-calcutta-adventure/Jonny Quest E21 - The Devils Tower.ia.mp4
items.title: Jonny Quest: The Devils Tower
items.description: A balloon brings in a canister, and Race Bannon flies out in a yellow biplane to learn where it came from. The answer is a rock tower, and the rest of the team goes up it single file.

items.title: Laff-A-Lympics
items.description: The Yogi Yahooeys, Really Rottens and Scooby Doobies run a swamp race, a rickshaw race and a ping-pong match. The ping-pong is scored with exactly the same seriousness as the swamp.

items.title: Speed Buggy
items.description: Tinker, Debbie and Mark meet a bespectacled man in a tomb, enter Speed Buggy in a track meet, and lose his wheels to crooks. It is a full day for a dune buggy.

items.id: the-secret-squirrel-show/The Secret Squirrel Show E02 - Way Out Squiddly.mp4
items.title: The Secret Squirrel Show: Masked Granny
